CHAPTER 01

样本空间与概率

Sample spaces and probability

先把随机问题说清楚：可能发生什么、关心哪些结果、信息怎样改变判断。

Start by defining possible outcomes, events of interest, and how information changes a probability.

1.1

离散样本空间

Discrete sample spaces

随机试验的结果无法事先确定，但可能结果的集合可以事先规定，这个集合称为样本空间 Ω。一个样本点应描述一次试验中需要保留的全部信息。两枚骰子的点数和虽然只有 11 种取值，两个有序点数却有 36 种；选择哪种表示会影响后续计数。离散空间既可以有限，也可以可数无限，例如一直抛硬币直到首次正面。

A random experiment has an uncertain outcome, but its possible outcomes can be specified in advance. Their set is the sample space Ω. An elementary outcome should retain all information needed for the question. Two ordered dice have 36 outcomes, whereas their sum has only 11 possible values. A discrete space may be finite or countably infinite, as with the trial number of a first success.

Ω={(i,j):1≤i,j≤6},X(i,j)=i+j\Omega=\{(i,j):1\le i,j\le6\},\qquad X(i,j)=i+jΩ={(i,j):1≤i,j≤6},X(i,j)=i+j
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
\Omega=\{(i,j):1\le i,j\le6\},\qquad X(i,j)=i+j

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 先确定基本结果。给两枚骰子加上第一枚、第二枚的标签，每个有序点数对都对应唯一基本结果。独立且公平使每对的概率相同。

    Label the dice first and second. Each ordered pair is one elementary outcome. Fairness and independence make all ordered pairs equally likely.

    ∣Ω∣=6⋅6=36,P({(i,j)})=1616=136|\Omega|=6\cdot6=36,\qquad P(\{(i,j)\})=\frac16\frac16=\frac1{36}∣Ω∣=6⋅6=36,P({(i,j)})=61​61​=361​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    |\Omega|=6\cdot6=36,\qquad P(\{(i,j)\})=\frac16\frac16=\frac1{36}

  2. 把数值条件拉回样本空间。点数和是基本结果的函数，因此一个和的概率等于所有映射到该和的基本结果概率之和。

    Pull a numerical condition back to the sample space. A sum is a function of the elementary outcome, so its probability adds the probabilities of every pair mapped to it.

    P(X=s)=∑(i,j): i+j=sP({(i,j)})P(X=s)=\sum_{(i,j):\,i+j=s}P(\{(i,j)\})P(X=s)=(i,j):i+j=s∑​P({(i,j)})
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(X=s)=\sum_{(i,j):\,i+j=s}P(\{(i,j)\})
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

两枚公平骰子的点数和为 4，对应 (1,3)、(2,2)、(3,1)，因此概率为 3/36 = 1/12。

For two fair dice, a sum of 4 corresponds to three ordered outcomes, giving probability 3/36 = 1/12.

  1. 要求和为 4，先解整数方程 i+j=4，同时保留骰子取值 1 到 6 的限制。

    For a sum of four, solve i+j=4 subject to both die values lying between one and six.

    A={(1,3),(2,2),(3,1)}A=\{(1,3),(2,2),(3,1)\}A={(1,3),(2,2),(3,1)}
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    A=\{(1,3),(2,2),(3,1)\}

  2. 三个结果互斥，每个概率 1/36，所以直接相加。

    The three outcomes are disjoint, each with probability 1/36, so add them.

    P(X=4)=136+136+136=112P(X=4)=\frac1{36}+\frac1{36}+\frac1{36}=\boxed{\frac1{12}}P(X=4)=361​+361​+361​=121​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(X=4)=\frac1{36}+\frac1{36}+\frac1{36}=\boxed{\frac1{12}}

  3. 检查：和为 2 只有一个有序对，概率是 1/36。这也验证了不同点数和并不等可能。

    Check against a sum of two, which has only one ordered pair and probability 1/36. This confirms that possible sums are not equally likely.

    P(X=2)=136≠P(X=4)P(X=2)=\frac1{36}\ne P(X=4)P(X=2)=361​=P(X=4)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(X=2)=\frac1{36}\ne P(X=4)
!

不同结果不一定等可能；“共有 11 个和”不意味着每个和的概率都是 1/11。

Different outcomes need not be equally likely. Eleven possible sums do not imply probability 1/11 for each sum.

1.2

事件与概率公理

Events and probability axioms

事件是样本空间的一个子集。A∪B 表示至少一个发生，A∩B 表示两个都发生，Aᶜ 表示 A 不发生。概率是赋予事件的数值，必须满足非负性、整个空间的概率为 1，以及可列互斥事件的可加性。公理的作用是确保各种计算彼此一致，而不是规定所有模型都要均匀分配概率。

An event is a subset of the sample space. The union A∪B means at least one event occurs; the intersection A∩B means both occur; the complement Aᶜ means A does not occur. A probability measure is nonnegative, assigns probability one to the whole space, and is countably additive over disjoint events. These rules enforce consistency without requiring a uniform model.

P(Ω)=1,P(A)≥0,P ⁣(⋃i=1∞Ai)=∑i=1∞P(Ai)  (Ai∩Aj=∅)P(\Omega)=1,\quad P(A)\ge0,\quad P\!\left(\bigcup_{i=1}^\infty A_i\right)=\sum_{i=1}^\infty P(A_i)\ \ (A_i\cap A_j=\varnothing)P(Ω)=1,P(A)≥0,P(i=1⋃∞​Ai​)=i=1∑∞​P(Ai​)  (Ai​∩Aj​=∅)
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
P(\Omega)=1,\quad P(A)\ge0,\quad P\!\left(\bigcup_{i=1}^\infty A_i\right)=\sum_{i=1}^\infty P(A_i)\ \ (A_i\cap A_j=\varnothing)

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 加法公理只对互斥事件直接成立。把整个空间拆成 A 和其补事件，就得到补事件规则。

    Additivity applies directly to disjoint events. Partition the whole space into A and its complement to obtain the complement rule.

    Ω=A∪˙Ac⟹1=P(A)+P(Ac)\Omega=A\mathbin{\dot\cup}A^c\quad\Longrightarrow\quad1=P(A)+P(A^c)Ω=A∪˙Ac⟹1=P(A)+P(Ac)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \Omega=A\mathbin{\dot\cup}A^c\quad\Longrightarrow\quad1=P(A)+P(A^c)

  2. 空事件可与自身并起来而不改变集合。由可加性，空事件的概率只能是零。

    The empty event is disjoint from itself and its union with itself is unchanged. Additivity forces its probability to be zero.

    P(∅)=P(∅)+P(∅)⟹P(∅)=0P(\varnothing)=P(\varnothing)+P(\varnothing)\quad\Longrightarrow\quad P(\varnothing)=0P(∅)=P(∅)+P(∅)⟹P(∅)=0
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(\varnothing)=P(\varnothing)+P(\varnothing)\quad\Longrightarrow\quad P(\varnothing)=0
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

掷一次骰子，A={2,4,6}，B={5,6}，则 A∩B={6}，A∪B={2,4,5,6}。

For one die, let A={2,4,6} and B={5,6}. Their intersection is {6}, and their union is {2,4,5,6}.

  1. 公平骰子中，先按集合定义列出偶数事件 A 与大于 4 的事件 B。

    For a fair die, list the even event A and the event B of a value exceeding four.

    A={2,4,6},B={5,6}A=\{2,4,6\},\qquad B=\{5,6\}A={2,4,6},B={5,6}
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    A=\{2,4,6\},\qquad B=\{5,6\}

  2. 交集只保留两个集合都出现的点，故为 {6}；并集把两个集合合并且不重复。

    The intersection keeps outcomes appearing in both sets, giving {6}. The union combines outcomes without duplicating them.

    A∩B={6},A∪B={2,4,5,6}A\cap B=\{6\},\quad A\cup B=\{2,4,5,6\}A∩B={6},A∪B={2,4,5,6}
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    A\cap B=\{6\},\quad A\cup B=\{2,4,5,6\}

  3. 按基本结果数计算，得到交集与并集的概率。由于交集非空，A 与 B 不互斥。

    Count elementary outcomes to obtain both probabilities. Since the intersection is nonempty, A and B are not disjoint.

    P(A∩B)=16,P(A∪B)=46=23P(A\cap B)=\boxed{\frac16},\qquad P(A\cup B)=\boxed{\frac46=\frac23}P(A∩B)=61​​,P(A∪B)=64​=32​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(A\cap B)=\boxed{\frac16},\qquad P(A\cup B)=\boxed{\frac46=\frac23}
!

互斥表示不能同时发生；独立表示知道一个事件发生不改变另一个的概率。

Mutually exclusive means impossible to occur together. Independent means observing one does not change the probability of the other.

1.3

从公理推出计算规则

Consequences of the axioms

补事件公式常把“至少一次”转换成“零次”，加法公式则纠正重复计数。若 A 包含于 B，B 至少具有 A 的概率。多个事件的并集可以用容斥原理逐步修正交集；如果只需要上界，直接把各事件概率相加即可，这称为并集上界。选择恰当事件通常比套用复杂公式更有效。

Complements turn “at least once” into “never,” while the addition rule corrects double counting. If A is contained in B, then its probability cannot exceed that of B. Inclusion–exclusion extends the addition rule to more events. When only an upper bound is needed, summing individual probabilities gives the union bound. A good event representation often simplifies a problem more than a complicated formula does.

P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B),P(Ac)=1−P(A)P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B),\qquad P(A^c)=1-P(A)P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B),P(Ac)=1−P(A)
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B),\qquad P(A^c)=1-P(A)

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 将并集拆成互不相交的三块：只有 A、只有 B、两者同时。这样每块恰好计一次。

    Partition the union into A only, B only, and both. Each disjoint piece is counted exactly once.

    A∪B=(A∖B)∪˙(B∖A)∪˙(A∩B)A\cup B=(A\setminus B)\mathbin{\dot\cup}(B\setminus A)\mathbin{\dot\cup}(A\cap B)A∪B=(A∖B)∪˙(B∖A)∪˙(A∩B)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    A\cup B=(A\setminus B)\mathbin{\dot\cup}(B\setminus A)\mathbin{\dot\cup}(A\cap B)

  2. P(A)+P(B) 把交集计了两遍，减去一遍就得到并集。由于交集概率非负，顺便得到并集上界。

    Adding P(A) and P(B) counts the intersection twice. Subtract one copy; nonnegativity also gives the union bound.

    P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B)≤P(A)+P(B)P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B)\le P(A)+P(B)P(A∪B)=P(A)+P(B)−P(A∩B)≤P(A)+P(B)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B)\le P(A)+P(B)
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

若 P(A)=0.4、P(B)=0.3、P(A∩B)=0.1，则至少一个发生的概率是 0.6，两者都不发生的概率是 0.4。

With probabilities 0.4, 0.3, and intersection 0.1, the probability of at least one event is 0.6; the probability of neither is 0.4.

  1. 已知两个事件概率分别为 0.4 和 0.3，交集概率为 0.1。先计算只发生 A 或只发生 B 的概率。

    Given event probabilities 0.4 and 0.3 and intersection 0.1, calculate the two exclusive pieces first.

    P(A∖B)=0.4−0.1=0.3,P(B∖A)=0.3−0.1=0.2P(A\setminus B)=0.4-0.1=0.3,\quad P(B\setminus A)=0.3-0.1=0.2P(A∖B)=0.4−0.1=0.3,P(B∖A)=0.3−0.1=0.2
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(A\setminus B)=0.4-0.1=0.3,\quad P(B\setminus A)=0.3-0.1=0.2

  2. 把三个互斥部分相加，得到至少一个发生的概率。

    Add the three disjoint pieces to find the chance that at least one occurs.

    P(A∪B)=0.3+0.2+0.1=0.6P(A\cup B)=0.3+0.2+0.1=\boxed{0.6}P(A∪B)=0.3+0.2+0.1=0.6​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(A\cup B)=0.3+0.2+0.1=\boxed{0.6}

  3. 两个都不发生是并集的补事件，所以再从 1 中扣除。四个互斥区域的概率相加为 1，可作检查。

    Neither event is the complement of the union. Subtract from one; the probabilities of all four regions then sum to one.

    P(Ac∩Bc)=1−0.6=0.4P(A^c\cap B^c)=1-0.6=\boxed{0.4}P(Ac∩Bc)=1−0.6=0.4​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(A^c\cap B^c)=1-0.6=\boxed{0.4}
!

仅在事件互斥时，才能省略交集项。

The intersection term disappears only when the events are disjoint.

1.4

条件概率、贝叶斯与独立性

Conditioning, Bayes, and independence

已知 B 发生后，只在 B 内重新分配概率，就得到条件概率。全概率公式按互斥且穷尽的原因分组；贝叶斯公式把“原因导致证据的概率”倒转成“看到证据后的原因概率”。独立性等价于联合概率可分解成乘积；三个以上事件必须检查所有相关子集，成对独立并不保证相互独立。

Conditioning restricts attention to B and renormalizes probabilities inside it. The law of total probability groups outcomes by an exhaustive, disjoint partition. Bayes’ rule reverses the direction from evidence given a cause to a cause given evidence. Independence factorizes a joint probability. For three or more events, pairwise independence alone does not establish mutual independence.

P(Aj∣B)=P(B∣Aj)P(Aj)∑iP(B∣Ai)P(Ai)P(A_j\mid B)=\frac{P(B\mid A_j)P(A_j)}{\sum_iP(B\mid A_i)P(A_i)}P(Aj​∣B)=∑i​P(B∣Ai​)P(Ai​)P(B∣Aj​)P(Aj​)​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
P(A_j\mid B)=\frac{P(B\mid A_j)P(A_j)}{\sum_iP(B\mid A_i)P(A_i)}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 条件概率把 B 当作新的参照总体。把定义交叉相乘，可用两种顺序写同一个交集概率。

    Conditional probability uses B as the reference population. Rearranging the definition expresses the same intersection in either order.

    P(A∩B)=P(A∣B)P(B)=P(B∣A)P(A)P(A\cap B)=P(A\mid B)P(B)=P(B\mid A)P(A)P(A∩B)=P(A∣B)P(B)=P(B∣A)P(A)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(A\cap B)=P(A\mid B)P(B)=P(B\mid A)P(A)

  2. 若 Aᵢ 构成互斥且穷尽的分组，B 就被各个 B∩Aᵢ 分割。应用可加性与乘法规则，得到全概率公式。

    If the events Aᵢ form a disjoint exhaustive partition, the intersections B∩Aᵢ partition B. Additivity and the multiplication rule give total probability.

    P(B)=∑iP(B∩Ai)=∑iP(B∣Ai)P(Ai)P(B)=\sum_iP(B\cap A_i)=\sum_iP(B\mid A_i)P(A_i)P(B)=i∑​P(B∩Ai​)=i∑​P(B∣Ai​)P(Ai​)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(B)=\sum_iP(B\cap A_i)=\sum_iP(B\mid A_i)P(A_i)

  3. 把上一行代回条件概率定义，就得到贝叶斯公式。分母必须为正；它是证据的总体发生率。

    Substitute total probability into the conditional definition to obtain Bayes’ rule. The denominator must be positive and is the overall evidence rate.

    P(Aj∣B)=P(Aj∩B)P(B)P(A_j\mid B)=\frac{P(A_j\cap B)}{P(B)}P(Aj​∣B)=P(B)P(Aj​∩B)​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(A_j\mid B)=\frac{P(A_j\cap B)}{P(B)}

两台机器产量占比为 70% 和 30%，次品率为 1% 和 4%。随机取到次品，它来自第二台的概率为 0.3×0.04/(0.7×0.01+0.3×0.04)=12/19≈63.16%。

Two machines supply 70% and 30% of production with defect rates 1% and 4%. Given a defective item, the probability it came from machine two is 12/19, about 63.16%.

  1. 令 M₁、M₂ 表示来源机器，D 表示次品。把题目数据翻译成先验占比和条件次品率。

    Let M₁ and M₂ denote source machines and D a defect. Translate output shares and defect rates into probabilities.

    P(M1)=0.7, P(M2)=0.3, P(D∣M1)=0.01, P(D∣M2)=0.04P(M_1)=0.7,\ P(M_2)=0.3,\ P(D\mid M_1)=0.01,\ P(D\mid M_2)=0.04P(M1​)=0.7, P(M2​)=0.3, P(D∣M1​)=0.01, P(D∣M2​)=0.04
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

    P(M1∩D)=0.007,P(M2∩D)=0.012P(M_1\cap D)=0.007,\qquad P(M_2\cap D)=0.012P(M1​∩D)=0.007,P(M2​∩D)=0.012

    P(D)=0.007+0.012=0.019P(D)=0.007+0.012=0.019P(D)=0.007+0.012=0.019
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

    The fraction of all defects attributable to machine two is the posterior. Check by imagining 70 and 120 defects among ten thousand products.

    P(M2∣D)=0.0120.019=1219≈0.631579P(M_2\mid D)=\frac{0.012}{0.019}=\boxed{\frac{12}{19}\approx0.631579}P(M2​∣D)=0.0190.012​=1912​≈0.631579​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(M_2\mid D)=\frac{0.012}{0.019}=\boxed{\frac{12}{19}\approx0.631579}

P(A|B) 与 P(B|A) 的分母不同，不能直接互换。

P(A|B) and P(B|A) use different reference populations and cannot be interchanged.

1.5

反直觉问题：生日与模式

Surprising examples: birthdays and patterns

生日问题不是比较某个人和其他人，而是在所有人对之间寻找至少一次匹配。随着人数增加，人对的数量近似按人数的平方增长。另一类反直觉来自模式等待：HH 与 TH 都是长度为 2 的序列，但失败后保留的信息不同，导致首次出现时间不同。概率取决于试验过程，不能只比较最终字符串。

The birthday problem searches for a match among every pair of people, not just matches with one designated person. The number of pairs grows quadratically. Pattern problems produce another surprise: HH and TH both have length two, but failed attempts leave different useful partial matches. Their first-occurrence times therefore differ. Probability depends on the sampling process, not merely on the final string.

P(a birthday match)=1−∏k=0n−1(1−k365)P(\text{a birthday match})=1-\prod_{k=0}^{n-1}\left(1-\frac{k}{365}\right)P(a birthday match)=1−k=0∏n−1​(1−365k​)
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
P(\text{a birthday match})=1-\prod_{k=0}^{n-1}\left(1-\frac{k}{365}\right)

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 直接列出至少一组同生日容易重复计数。改求所有生日互异：第一人任意，第二人避开一个日期，第三人避开两个日期，依此类推。

    Counting at least one match directly creates overlap. Instead require all birthdays to differ: the first is unrestricted, the second avoids one date, the third two, and so on.

    P(all distinct)=1⋅364365⋅363365⋯365−n+1365P(\text{all distinct})=1\cdot\frac{364}{365}\cdot\frac{363}{365}\cdots\frac{365-n+1}{365}P(all distinct)=1⋅365364​⋅365363​⋯365365−n+1​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(\text{all distinct})=1\cdot\frac{364}{365}\cdot\frac{363}{365}\cdots\frac{365-n+1}{365}

  2. 相乘使用条件概率链式法则，不是说“互异事件”本身独立。最后取补集。

    The product uses the chain rule for conditional probabilities; the distinctness events themselves are not independent. Take the complement at the end.

    P(match)=1−P(all distinct)P(\text{match})=1-P(\text{all distinct})P(match)=1−P(all distinct)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(\text{match})=1-P(\text{all distinct})

忽略闰日、假定生日独立且均匀，23 人中至少两人同生日的概率约为 0.5073。

Ignoring leap days and assuming independent uniform birthdays, 23 people have a matching-birthday probability of about 0.5073.

  1. 取 n=23，采用一年 365 天、生日独立均匀的模型，一共乘 23 个因子，其中首个为 1。

    Set n=23 under independent uniform birthdays on 365 days. There are twenty-three factors, the first equal to one.

    q=∏k=022365−k365q=\prod_{k=0}^{22}\frac{365-k}{365}q=k=0∏22​365365−k​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    q=\prod_{k=0}^{22}\frac{365-k}{365}

  2. 计算互异概率；手算近似时可取对数，将乘积转为求和以提高稳定性。

    Evaluate the distinctness probability. Logarithms turn the product into a sum for stable numerical computation.

    log⁡q=∑k=022log⁡(1−k365),q≈0.492703\log q=\sum_{k=0}^{22}\log\left(1-\frac{k}{365}\right),\quad q\approx0.492703logq=k=0∑22​log(1−365k​),q≈0.492703
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \log q=\sum_{k=0}^{22}\log\left(1-\frac{k}{365}\right),\quad q\approx0.492703

    Take the complement. There are 253 pairs of people, explaining why a modest group can have a substantial collision probability.

    P(match)=1−q≈0.507297,(232)=253P(\text{match})=1-q\approx\boxed{0.507297},\quad \binom{23}{2}=253P(match)=1−q≈0.507297​,(223​)=253
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(\text{match})=1-q\approx\boxed{0.507297},\quad \binom{23}{2}=253
!

真实生日并非严格均匀；这里的结论针对明确给定的简化模型。

Real birthdays are not perfectly uniform; the result belongs to the stated simplified model.

1.6

系统可靠性

System reliability

把“部件正常”看作事件，就可以用集合运算描述系统结构。串联系统要求所有部件正常，因此可靠性是各可靠性的乘积；并联系统只要一个部件正常，因此先计算全部失效再取补集。桥式等复杂结构可以对某个关键部件是否正常进行条件分解。下面的乘积公式要求部件状态独立。

Represent a functioning component by an event. A series system requires every component to work; a parallel system needs at least one working component. Under independent component states, series reliability is a product, and parallel reliability is one minus the probability of total failure. More complicated networks can be decomposed by conditioning on a pivotal component.

Rseries=∏iri,Rparallel=1−∏i(1−ri)R_{\rm series}=\prod_i r_i,\qquad R_{\rm parallel}=1-\prod_i(1-r_i)Rseries​=i∏​ri​,Rparallel​=1−i∏​(1−ri​)
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
R_{\rm series}=\prod_i r_i,\qquad R_{\rm parallel}=1-\prod_i(1-r_i)

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 令 Aᵢ 表示部件 i 正常，串联系统正常恰好是所有 Aᵢ 的交集。独立性把交集概率变成乘积。

    Let Aᵢ denote working component i. A series system works exactly on their intersection; independence converts its probability into a product.

    P ⁣(⋂iAi)=∏iP(Ai)P\!\left(\bigcap_i A_i\right)=\prod_iP(A_i)P(i⋂​Ai​)=i∏​P(Ai​)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P\!\left(\bigcap_i A_i\right)=\prod_iP(A_i)

  2. 并联系统只有在全部部件失效时才失效。先乘各失效概率，再取补事件；独立性也传递到补事件。

    A parallel system fails only if all components fail. Multiply failure probabilities and take a complement; independence also holds for the complementary events.

    P ⁣(⋃iAi)=1−P ⁣(⋂iAic)=1−∏i(1−ri)P\!\left(\bigcup_i A_i\right)=1-P\!\left(\bigcap_i A_i^c\right)=1-\prod_i(1-r_i)P(i⋃​Ai​)=1−P(i⋂​Aic​)=1−i∏​(1−ri​)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P\!\left(\bigcup_i A_i\right)=1-P\!\left(\bigcap_i A_i^c\right)=1-\prod_i(1-r_i)

三个独立部件的可靠性都为 0.9，串联可靠性为 0.729，并联可靠性为 0.999。

Three independent components with reliability 0.9 yield series reliability 0.729 and parallel reliability 0.999.

  1. 三个独立部件可靠性均为 0.9，因此每个失效概率为 0.1。串联要求三个同时正常。

    Each of three independent components has reliability 0.9 and failure probability 0.1. A series connection needs all three.

    Rs=0.9×0.9×0.9=0.729R_s=0.9\times0.9\times0.9=\boxed{0.729}Rs​=0.9×0.9×0.9=0.729​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    R_s=0.9\times0.9\times0.9=\boxed{0.729}

    For a parallel connection, compute total failure first and complement it.

    Rp=1−0.13=0.999R_p=1-0.1^3=\boxed{0.999}Rp​=1−0.13=0.999​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    R_p=1-0.1^3=\boxed{0.999}

  3. 检查：串联的可靠性不应大于任一必要部件，并联的可靠性不应小于任一可独立支撑系统的部件。

    Check that series reliability does not exceed a required component’s reliability, and parallel reliability is at least each individually sufficient component’s reliability.

    Rs≤0.9≤RpR_s\le0.9\le R_pRs​≤0.9≤Rp​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

共同供电或共同环境可造成相关失效，不能直接使用独立乘积。

Shared power or environmental conditions can create dependent failures, invalidating the simple products.

1.7

排列、组合与计数

Permutations, combinations, and counting

分步选择使用乘法原理；互斥方案使用加法原理。有顺序且不放回时是排列，无顺序且不放回时是组合。重复元素的排列要除以各重复次数的阶乘。等可能模型中，事件概率等于有利结果数除以总结果数，但分子与分母必须使用同一种计数粒度。

Use the product rule for sequential choices and the sum rule for disjoint alternatives. Ordered sampling without replacement gives permutations; unordered sampling gives combinations. Arrangements with repeated items require division by factorials of multiplicities. In an equally likely model, probability is a ratio of counts, provided numerator and denominator use the same level of detail.

P(n,k)=n!(n−k)!,(nk)=n!k!(n−k)!P(n,k)=\frac{n!}{(n-k)!},\qquad\binom nk=\frac{n!}{k!(n-k)!}P(n,k)=(n−k)!n!​,(kn​)=k!(n−k)!n!​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
P(n,k)=\frac{n!}{(n-k)!},\qquad\binom nk=\frac{n!}{k!(n-k)!}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 有顺序不放回选 k 个：第一位置 n 种，第二位置 n−1 种，最后 n−k+1 种，使用乘法原理。

    For ordered sampling without replacement, successive positions have n, n−1, …, n−k+1 choices. Multiply them.

    P(n,k)=n(n−1)⋯(n−k+1)=n!(n−k)!P(n,k)=n(n-1)\cdots(n-k+1)=\frac{n!}{(n-k)!}P(n,k)=n(n−1)⋯(n−k+1)=(n−k)!n!​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(n,k)=n(n-1)\cdots(n-k+1)=\frac{n!}{(n-k)!}

  2. 每个无序 k 元集合对应 k! 个有序排列，因此除以 k! 消除顺序。该操作要求每个集合被重复计算相同次数。

    Each unordered k-element set corresponds to k! ordered arrangements. Divide by k! to remove order; the multiplicity is the same for every set.

    (nk)=P(n,k)k!\binom nk=\frac{P(n,k)}{k!}(kn​)=k!P(n,k)​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \binom nk=\frac{P(n,k)}{k!}

Selecting a three-person committee from ten gives 120 possibilities. Assigning three distinct roles gives 720 possibilities.

先问顺序是否重要、能否重复、是否放回，再决定公式。

Before choosing a formula, ask whether order matters, repetition is allowed, and sampling uses replacement.

CHAPTER 02

离散随机变量与分布

Discrete random variables and distributions

用数值描述结果，再用分布、期望和方差总结随机性，并连接到抽样与检验。

Turn outcomes into numerical variables, summarize their distributions, and connect probability to sampling and testing.

2.1

随机变量与概率质量函数

Random variables and probability mass functions

随机变量是从样本空间到实数的函数。它把复杂的结果压缩成问题关心的数值，例如两骰点数和、样品中的次品数。离散随机变量的概率质量函数 p(x) 给出每个取值的概率。先列清楚支持集，再验证每个概率非负、总和为 1，最后才计算事件概率。

A random variable is a real-valued function on the sample space. It compresses an outcome into a useful quantity, such as a dice sum or a defect count. Its probability mass function p(x) assigns probabilities to individual values. Specify the support first, check nonnegativity and normalization, and then obtain event probabilities by summation.

pX(x)=P(X=x),pX(x)≥0,∑xpX(x)=1p_X(x)=P(X=x),\quad p_X(x)\ge0,\quad\sum_xp_X(x)=1pX​(x)=P(X=x),pX​(x)≥0,x∑​pX​(x)=1
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
p_X(x)=P(X=x),\quad p_X(x)\ge0,\quad\sum_xp_X(x)=1

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 随机变量把样本点映射到数值，同一个数值可以对应多个基本结果。其概率必须把所有原像的概率加起来。

    A random variable maps outcomes to numbers, and several outcomes may map to the same value. Sum their probabilities.

    pX(x)=∑ω: X(ω)=xP({ω})p_X(x)=\sum_{\omega:\,X(\omega)=x}P(\{\omega\})pX​(x)=ω:X(ω)=x∑​P({ω})
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    p_X(x)=\sum_{\omega:\,X(\omega)=x}P(\{\omega\})

  2. 不同取值的原像互斥且覆盖整个样本空间，所以质量函数非负且总和为 1。

    Preimages of different values are disjoint and exhaust the sample space, giving nonnegative masses summing to one.

    ∑xpX(x)=P(Ω)=1\sum_xp_X(x)=P(\Omega)=1x∑​pX​(x)=P(Ω)=1
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \sum_xp_X(x)=P(\Omega)=1

For the number of heads in two fair tosses, p(0)=1/4, p(1)=1/2, and p(2)=1/4.

    Count the preimages for each value and divide by four to obtain the complete law.

    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

    P(X≥1)=24+14=34,∑xpX(x)=1P(X\ge1)=\frac24+\frac14=\boxed{\frac34},\quad\sum_xp_X(x)=1P(X≥1)=42​+41​=43​​,x∑​pX​(x)=1

随机变量 X 是一个函数；观察值 x 是它的一次实现。

The random variable X is a function; an observed value x is one realization.

2.2

累积分布函数

Cumulative distribution functions

累积分布函数 F(x) 把左侧全部概率累积起来，因此适用于离散和连续两种情况。它单调不减、右连续，左右极限分别趋于 0 和 1。离散分布中，台阶的跳跃高度就是该点概率。求区间概率时要注意端点：F(b)−F(a) 表示 a<X≤b，而不是自动包含 a。

The cumulative distribution function collects all probability at or below x. It works for both discrete and continuous variables, is nondecreasing and right-continuous, and approaches zero and one at the two extremes. In a discrete distribution, each jump equals a point probability. Endpoint conventions matter: F(b)−F(a) describes a<X≤b.

F(x)=P(X≤x),P(a<X≤b)=F(b)−F(a)F(x)=P(X\le x),\quad P(a<X\le b)=F(b)-F(a)F(x)=P(X≤x),P(a<X≤b)=F(b)−F(a)
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
F(x)=P(X\le x),\quad P(a<X\le b)=F(b)-F(a)

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 当 a<b，{X≤a} 是 {X≤b} 的子事件。把大事件拆成左边一块与区间一块，直接使用互斥可加性。

    For a<b, {X≤a} is contained in {X≤b}. Partition the latter into the left piece and the interval piece.

    {X≤b}={X≤a}∪˙{a<X≤b}\{X\le b\}=\{X\le a\}\mathbin{\dot\cup}\{a<X\le b\}{X≤b}={X≤a}∪˙{a<X≤b}
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \{X\le b\}=\{X\le a\}\mathbin{\dot\cup}\{a<X\le b\}

  2. 减去左侧累计概率得到区间公式。若要包括 a，还要加回该点的跳跃概率。

    Subtract the left cumulative probability. To include a itself, add its jump probability back.

    P(a≤X≤b)=F(b)−F(a−),P(X=a)=F(a)−F(a−)P(a\le X\le b)=F(b)-F(a^-),\quad P(X=a)=F(a)-F(a^-)P(a≤X≤b)=F(b)−F(a−),P(X=a)=F(a)−F(a−)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(a\le X\le b)=F(b)-F(a^-),\quad P(X=a)=F(a)-F(a^-)
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

上一节的 X 在 x<0 时 F=0，在 0≤x<1 时 F=1/4，在 1≤x<2 时 F=3/4，在 x≥2 时 F=1。

For the two-toss head count, F equals 0 below 0, 1/4 on [0,1), 3/4 on [1,2), and 1 from 2 onward.

  1. 沿用两次抛币的正面次数分布。在 0 之前没有质量，在 0 点先累加 1/4。

    Use the two-toss head count. No mass lies below zero; the mass at zero raises the CDF to one quarter.

    F(x)=0 (x<0),F(x)=14 (0≤x<1)F(x)=0\ (x<0),\qquad F(x)=\frac14\ (0\le x<1)F(x)=0 (x<0),F(x)=41​ (0≤x<1)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    F(x)=0\ (x<0),\qquad F(x)=\frac14\ (0\le x<1)

    At one add one half, and at two add one quarter, producing the remaining steps.

    F(x)=34 (1≤x<2),F(x)=1 (x≥2)F(x)=\frac34\ (1\le x<2),\qquad F(x)=1\ (x\ge2)F(x)=43​ (1≤x<2),F(x)=1 (x≥2)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    F(x)=\frac34\ (1\le x<2),\qquad F(x)=1\ (x\ge2)

  3. 计算区间 0<X≤1，端点 0 不包含，所以应减去 F(0)，而不是减去 F(0⁻)。

    For 0<X≤1, zero is excluded, so subtract F(0), not F(0⁻).

    P(0<X≤1)=F(1)−F(0)=34−14=12P(0<X\le1)=F(1)-F(0)=\frac34-\frac14=\boxed{\frac12}P(0<X≤1)=F(1)−F(0)=43​−41​=21​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(0<X\le1)=F(1)-F(0)=\frac34-\frac14=\boxed{\frac12}

右连续表示每个台阶点采用跳跃后的函数值。

Right continuity means the value at a jump is the value after the jump.

2.3

期望、方差与切比雪夫不等式

Expectation, variance, and Chebyshev’s inequality

期望是按概率加权的平均值，描述重复试验中的长期中心。方差衡量对期望的平方偏离，标准差回到原变量的单位。线性变换对期望和方差的影响不同：平移不改变方差，放大 a 倍使方差放大 a² 倍。切比雪夫不等式不限定分布形状，只要求均值和有限方差存在。

Expectation is a probability-weighted average and a long-run center. Variance measures squared deviations from the mean; standard deviation restores the original unit. Translation changes the mean but not the variance, while scaling by a multiplies variance by a². Chebyshev’s inequality applies without a distributional shape assumption, provided the mean and finite variance exist.

Var⁡(X)=E[X2]−μ2,P(∣X−μ∣≥kσ)≤1k2\operatorname{Var}(X)=E[X^2]-\mu^2,\quad P(|X-\mu|\ge k\sigma)\le\frac1{k^2}Var(X)=E[X2]−μ2,P(∣X−μ∣≥kσ)≤k21​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
\operatorname{Var}(X)=E[X^2]-\mu^2,\quad P(|X-\mu|\ge k\sigma)\le\frac1{k^2}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 展开平方并利用 E[X]=μ，就得到方差的计算公式。期望存在并且二阶矩有限是这些运算的条件。

    Expand the square and use E[X]=μ. A finite second moment justifies the calculation.

    E[(X−μ)2]=E[X2]−2μE[X]+μ2=E[X2]−μ2E[(X-\mu)^2]=E[X^2]-2\mu E[X]+\mu^2=E[X^2]-\mu^2E[(X−μ)2]=E[X2]−2μE[X]+μ2=E[X2]−μ2
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[(X-\mu)^2]=E[X^2]-2\mu E[X]+\mu^2=E[X^2]-\mu^2

  2. 令 Y=(X−μ)²≥0。在 Y≥a 的事件上，Y 至少为 a，因此 E[Y]≥aP(Y≥a)。代入 a=k²σ² 得切比雪夫不等式。

    Set Y=(X−μ)². On {Y≥a}, Y contributes at least a, so E[Y]≥aP(Y≥a). Substitute a=k²σ².

    σ2≥k2σ2P(∣X−μ∣≥kσ)\sigma^2\ge k^2\sigma^2P(|X-\mu|\ge k\sigma)σ2≥k2σ2P(∣X−μ∣≥kσ)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \sigma^2\ge k^2\sigma^2P(|X-\mu|\ge k\sigma)
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

公平骰子的均值是 3.5，方差是 35/12。若奖金为 10X−20，则均值为 15，方差为 100×35/12。

A fair die has mean 3.5 and variance 35/12. A payoff 10X−20 has mean 15 and variance 100×35/12.

  1. 公平骰子各点概率为 1/6，先分别计算一阶与二阶矩。

    For a fair die, calculate the first and second moments using mass 1/6 at each value.

    E[X]=1+2+3+4+5+66=72,E[X2]=916E[X]=\frac{1+2+3+4+5+6}{6}=\frac72,\quad E[X^2]=\frac{91}{6}E[X]=61+2+3+4+5+6​=27​,E[X2]=691​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[X]=\frac{1+2+3+4+5+6}{6}=\frac72,\quad E[X^2]=\frac{91}{6}

  2. 将均值平方扣除，得到方差。

    Subtract the squared mean to obtain variance.

    Var⁡(X)=916−494=3512\operatorname{Var}(X)=\frac{91}{6}-\frac{49}{4}=\boxed{\frac{35}{12}}Var(X)=691​−449​=1235​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \operatorname{Var}(X)=\frac{91}{6}-\frac{49}{4}=\boxed{\frac{35}{12}}

  3. 奖金 Y=10X−20 的平移只改变均值，乘数 10 使方差乘 100。

    For payoff Y=10X−20, translation changes only the mean, while scaling by ten multiplies variance by one hundred.

    E[Y]=1072−20=15,Var⁡(Y)=8753E[Y]=10\frac72-20=\boxed{15},\quad\operatorname{Var}(Y)=\boxed{\frac{875}{3}}E[Y]=1027​−20=15​,Var(Y)=3875​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[Y]=10\frac72-20=\boxed{15},\quad\operatorname{Var}(Y)=\boxed{\frac{875}{3}}

E[g(X)] 通常不等于 g(E[X])；尤其 E[X²] 与 E[X]² 不同。

Generally E[g(X)] is not g(E[X]); in particular, E[X²] differs from E[X]².

2.4

二项分布

The binomial distribution

固定进行 n 次独立试验，每次只有成功与失败，而且成功概率始终为 p，成功总次数服从二项分布。一个指定顺序有 k 次成功的概率是 pᵏ(1−p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ，能产生该次数的顺序有 C(n,k) 个。把每次成功写成指示变量相加，可以直接得到均值与方差。

A binomial count records successes in a fixed number n of independent trials with a constant success probability p. Each particular sequence with k successes has probability pᵏ(1−p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ, and there are C(n,k) such sequences. Writing the count as a sum of Bernoulli indicators gives its mean and variance immediately.

P(X=k)=(nk)pk(1−p)n−k,E[X]=np,Var⁡(X)=np(1−p)P(X=k)=\binom nkp^k(1-p)^{n-k},\quad E[X]=np,\quad\operatorname{Var}(X)=np(1-p)P(X=k)=(kn​)pk(1−p)n−k,E[X]=np,Var(X)=np(1−p)
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
P(X=k)=\binom nkp^k(1-p)^{n-k},\quad E[X]=np,\quad\operatorname{Var}(X)=np(1-p)

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 任何指定的 n 次序列若恰有 k 次成功，由独立性，其概率为 pᵏ(1−p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ；成功位置可从 n 个位置选 k 个。

    Any particular sequence with k successes has probability pᵏ(1−p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ by independence; choose its success positions in C(n,k) ways.

    P(X=k)=(nk)pk(1−p)n−kP(X=k)=\binom nkp^k(1-p)^{n-k}P(X=k)=(kn​)pk(1−p)n−k
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(X=k)=\binom nkp^k(1-p)^{n-k}

  2. 写 X 为成功指示变量之和。每项均值 p、方差 p(1−p)；独立性让协方差为零。

    Write X as a sum of success indicators. Each has mean p and variance p(1−p); independence removes cross-covariances.

    X=∑i=1nIi,E[X]=∑ip=np,Var⁡(X)=∑ip(1−p)X=\sum_{i=1}^nI_i,\quad E[X]=\sum_i p=np,\quad\operatorname{Var}(X)=\sum_i p(1-p)X=i=1∑n​Ii​,E[X]=i∑​p=np,Var(X)=i∑​p(1−p)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    X=\sum_{i=1}^nI_i,\quad E[X]=\sum_i p=np,\quad\operatorname{Var}(X)=\sum_i p(1-p)
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

10 件独立产品的次品率为 0.1，恰有 2 件次品的概率是 C(10,2)×0.1²×0.9⁸≈0.1937。

Among ten independent items with defect probability 0.1, exactly two defects have probability about 0.1937.

  1. 10 件独立产品，每件为次品的概率 0.1；令 X 为次品数量，识别 n=10、p=0.1、k=2。

    Let X count defects among ten independent items with defect rate 0.1. Identify n=10, p=0.1, k=2.

    X∼Bin⁡(10,0.1)X\sim\operatorname{Bin}(10,0.1)X∼Bin(10,0.1)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    X\sim\operatorname{Bin}(10,0.1)

  2. 先选哪两件是次品，再乘这两件次品和其余八件合格的概率。

    Choose the defective pair, then multiply the probabilities of two defects and eight good items.

    P(X=2)=(102)(0.1)2(0.9)8=45(0.01)(0.43046721)P(X=2)=\binom{10}{2}(0.1)^2(0.9)^8=45(0.01)(0.43046721)P(X=2)=(210​)(0.1)2(0.9)8=45(0.01)(0.43046721)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

    Complete the arithmetic. A mean of one does not imply that exactly one defect must occur.

    P(X=2)=0.1937102445,E[X]=1P(X=2)=\boxed{0.1937102445},\qquad E[X]=1P(X=2)=0.1937102445​,E[X]=1
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

有限总体的不放回抽样一般不是二项模型；总体足够大时才可能近似。

Sampling without replacement from a finite population is generally not binomial, though an approximation may be reasonable.

2.5

用递推计算二项概率

Recursively computing binomial probabilities

直接计算大阶乘容易溢出；相邻概率的比值常更方便。由 pₖ 推出 pₖ₊₁，可以填出整张概率表，也可以找出概率上升转为下降的位置。n 很大且 p 极端时，从 p₀ 开始仍可能下溢，更稳健的方法是从众数附近计算对数概率，再向两侧递推并归一化。

Large factorials can overflow, so adjacent-probability ratios are useful. A recurrence builds the probability table and identifies where probabilities switch from increasing to decreasing. For large n or extreme p, starting at p₀ may still underflow. A more robust strategy starts near a mode using logarithms, recurs in both directions, and normalizes.

pk+1pk=n−kk+1p1−p,p0=(1−p)n\frac{p_{k+1}}{p_k}=\frac{n-k}{k+1}\frac{p}{1-p},\quad p_0=(1-p)^npk​pk+1​​=k+1n−k​1−pp​,p0​=(1−p)n
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
\frac{p_{k+1}}{p_k}=\frac{n-k}{k+1}\frac{p}{1-p},\quad p_0=(1-p)^n

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 将二项质量函数的相邻两项相除，分别消去幂与组合数的公共因子。

    Divide adjacent binomial masses, canceling common powers and factorial factors.

    pk+1pk=(nk+1)(nk)p1−p\frac{p_{k+1}}{p_k}=\frac{\binom n{k+1}}{\binom nk}\frac{p}{1-p}pk​pk+1​​=(kn​)(k+1n​)​1−pp​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \frac{p_{k+1}}{p_k}=\frac{\binom n{k+1}}{\binom nk}\frac{p}{1-p}

  2. 展开组合数的比值，得到不涉及大阶乘的递推。比值大于 1 时概率递增，小于 1 时递减。

    Expand the combination ratio to get a recurrence without large factorials. A ratio above one means increasing masses, and below one decreasing masses.

    (nk+1)(nk)=n−kk+1\frac{\binom n{k+1}}{\binom nk}=\frac{n-k}{k+1}(kn​)(k+1n​)​=k+1n−k​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \frac{\binom n{k+1}}{\binom nk}=\frac{n-k}{k+1}

n=5、p=0.2 时，p₀=0.32768，p₁=0.4096，p₂=0.2048。相邻比值分别为 1.25 和 0.5。

For n=5 and p=0.2, the first three probabilities are 0.32768, 0.4096, and 0.2048; adjacent ratios are 1.25 and 0.5.

  1. n=5、p=0.2，从零成功的概率开始。

    For n=5 and p=0.2, start with the probability of zero successes.

    p0=0.85=0.32768p_0=0.8^5=0.32768p0​=0.85=0.32768
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    p_0=0.8^5=0.32768

  2. 从 k=0 到 k=1 的比值为 5×0.2/0.8=1.25。

    The ratio from k=0 to k=1 is 5×0.2/0.8=1.25.

    p1=1.25p0=0.4096p_1=1.25p_0=\boxed{0.4096}p1​=1.25p0​=0.4096​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    p_1=1.25p_0=\boxed{0.4096}

  3. 下一项比值是 (4/2)×(0.2/0.8)=0.5，得到 k=2 的概率。

    The next ratio is (4/2)×(0.2/0.8)=0.5, yielding the mass at two.

    p2=0.5p1=0.2048p_2=0.5p_1=\boxed{0.2048}p2​=0.5p1​=0.2048​

p=0 或 p=1 是退化分布，应直接处理，避免除以零。

Handle p=0 and p=1 as degenerate distributions instead of dividing by zero.

2.6

从概率模型走向统计推断

From probability to statistical inference

概率问题假定参数已知，推算数据的行为；统计问题拿到数据，反推未知参数。对二项模型，样本比例是自然的 p 估计。点估计提供一个数字，区间估计同时表达抽样不确定性。正态近似区间适合样本量足够、成功失败数都不太少的情形，小样本或边界附近应采用更合适的二项方法。

Probability starts with a known parameter and predicts data; inference starts with data and learns about an unknown parameter. The sample proportion naturally estimates p in a binomial model. A point estimate supplies one number, while an interval also expresses sampling uncertainty. A normal approximation interval needs adequate expected success and failure counts; small samples or boundary estimates need a better binomial method.

p^±z1−α/2p^(1−p^)n\widehat p\pm z_{1-\alpha/2}\sqrt{\frac{\widehat p(1-\widehat p)}n}p​±z1−α/2​np​(1−p​)​​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
\widehat p\pm z_{1-\alpha/2}\sqrt{\frac{\widehat p(1-\widehat p)}n}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 由二项均值与方差得样本比例的均值 p、方差 p(1−p)/n。样本足够大时，将标准化比例近似为标准正态。

    Binomial moments give the sample proportion mean p and variance p(1−p)/n. For an adequate sample, approximate its standardization by a standard normal.

    P ⁣(−z≤p^−pp(1−p)/n≤z)≈1−αP\!\left(-z\le\frac{\widehat p-p}{\sqrt{p(1-p)/n}}\le z\right)\approx1-\alphaP(−z≤p(1−p)/n​p​−p​≤z)≈1−α
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P\!\left(-z\le\frac{\widehat p-p}{\sqrt{p(1-p)/n}}\le z\right)\approx1-\alpha

  2. 用样本比例替换未知标准误中的 p，再把不等式改写为对 p 的区间。这得到常用 Wald 近似，不是小样本精确区间。

    Plug the estimate into the unknown standard error and rearrange for p. This gives the Wald approximation, not an exact small-sample interval.

    p∈[p^−zSE^, p^+zSE^]p\in\left[\widehat p-z\widehat{\mathrm{SE}},\ \widehat p+z\widehat{\mathrm{SE}}\right]p∈[p​−zSE, p​+zSE]
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

With 120 successes in 200 trials, p̂=0.6 and the estimated standard error is about 0.0346. A normal 95% interval is approximately [0.532,0.668].

    Calculate the estimated standard error and use the two-sided 95% critical value 1.96.

    SE^=0.6(0.4)200≈0.034641,e=1.96SE^≈0.067896\widehat{\mathrm{SE}}=\sqrt{\frac{0.6(0.4)}{200}}\approx0.034641,\quad e=1.96\widehat{\mathrm{SE}}\approx0.067896SE=2000.6(0.4)​​≈0.034641,e=1.96SE≈0.067896

    Add and subtract the margin to obtain about [0.532,0.668]. The 120 successes and 80 failures are well away from the boundaries.

    [0.532104, 0.667896]\boxed{[0.532104,\ 0.667896]}[0.532104, 0.667896]​

95% 置信描述区间构造方法的长期覆盖率，不是给固定参数分配 95% 的频率学派概率。

A 95% confidence level describes long-run coverage of the procedure, not a frequentist probability assigned to the fixed parameter.

2.7

二项模型中的假设检验

Hypothesis testing with binomial counts

先写出零假设、备择假设和拒绝域，再计算错误概率。第一类错误是在零假设为真时拒绝它；第二类错误是在指定备择值下没有拒绝零假设。检验功效等于 1−β，随备择参数改变。离散性意味着拒绝域通常无法恰好达到指定显著性水平。

Specify the null hypothesis, alternative, and rejection region before computing errors. A type I error rejects a true null; a type II error fails to reject at a specified alternative parameter. Power is 1−β and varies across alternative values. Because a binomial count is discrete, a rejection threshold often cannot attain an exact target significance level.

α=Pp0(X≥c),β(p1)=Pp1(X<c),power=1−β\alpha=P_{p_0}(X\ge c),\quad\beta(p_1)=P_{p_1}(X<c),\quad\text{power}=1-\betaα=Pp0​​(X≥c),β(p1​)=Pp1​​(X<c),power=1−β
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
\alpha=P_{p_0}(X\ge c),\quad\beta(p_1)=P_{p_1}(X<c),\quad\text{power}=1-\beta

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 拒绝域固定后，第一类错误就是在零假设分布下落入该区域的概率。计算前先确定检验是单侧还是双侧。

    Once the rejection region is fixed, type I error is its probability under the null distribution. Specify a one- or two-sided test first.

    α=∑k=cn(nk)p0k(1−p0)n−k\alpha=\sum_{k=c}^n\binom nkp_0^k(1-p_0)^{n-k}α=k=c∑n​(kn​)p0k​(1−p0​)n−k
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \alpha=\sum_{k=c}^n\binom nkp_0^k(1-p_0)^{n-k}

  2. 换成某个指定备择 p₁，把非拒绝区域的概率相加得 β。功效是拒绝域在该备择下的概率。

    At a specified alternative p₁, sum the nonrejection probabilities to obtain β. Power is the alternative probability of rejection.

    β(p1)=∑k=0c−1(nk)p1k(1−p1)n−k\beta(p_1)=\sum_{k=0}^{c-1}\binom nkp_1^k(1-p_1)^{n-k}β(p1​)=k=0∑c−1​(kn​)p1k​(1−p1​)n−k

2.8

样本比例的抽样分布

The sampling distribution of a proportion

样本比例本身也是随机变量：重复抽取 n 个观察会得到不同的比例。它的均值等于总体比例，方差随 n 的增大按 1/n 缩小。若试验独立且成功失败都足够常见，标准化后的比例近似标准正态。误差界要减半，样本量通常需要扩大到原来的四倍。

A sample proportion is random: repeated samples of size n yield different values. Its mean equals the population proportion, and its variance shrinks as 1/n. With independent trials and sufficiently common successes and failures, the standardized proportion is approximately standard normal. Halving the margin of error generally requires four times the sample size.

E[p^]=p,Var⁡(p^)=p(1−p)n,n≳z2p(1−p)e2E[\widehat p]=p,\quad\operatorname{Var}(\widehat p)=\frac{p(1-p)}n,\quad n\gtrsim\frac{z^2p(1-p)}{e^2}E[p​]=p,Var(p​)=np(1−p)​,n≳e2z2p(1−p)​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
E[\widehat p]=p,\quad\operatorname{Var}(\widehat p)=\frac{p(1-p)}n,\quad n\gtrsim\frac{z^2p(1-p)}{e^2}

  1. 比例是二项计数除以 n，期望按 1/n 缩放，方差按 1/n² 缩放。

    A proportion divides a binomial count by n, scaling its mean by 1/n and its variance by 1/n².

    E[X/n]=npn=p,Var⁡(X/n)=np(1−p)n2E[X/n]=\frac{np}{n}=p,\quad\operatorname{Var}(X/n)=\frac{np(1-p)}{n^2}E[X/n]=nnp​=p,Var(X/n)=n2np(1−p)​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

2.9

几何分布与负二项分布

Geometric and negative binomial distributions

二项分布固定试验次数，几何分布固定成功次数为 1，随机的是等到成功所需次数。负二项分布把目标扩展为第 r 次成功。最后一次必须成功，前 k−1 次中要有 r−1 次成功，因此出现一个组合系数。这里采用包含成功试验的次数定义，而非成功前的失败数。

The binomial model fixes the trial count. A geometric variable instead counts trials until the first success, and a negative binomial counts trials until the rth success. In the latter case, the final trial must succeed and the preceding k−1 trials must contain exactly r−1 successes. Our convention counts all trials, including successful ones.

P(Tr=k)=(k−1r−1)pr(1−p)k−r,E[Tr]=rp,Var⁡(Tr)=r(1−p)p2P(T_r=k)=\binom{k-1}{r-1}p^r(1-p)^{k-r},\quad E[T_r]=\frac rp,\quad\operatorname{Var}(T_r)=\frac{r(1-p)}{p^2}P(Tr​=k)=(r−1k−1​)pr(1−p)k−r,E[Tr​]=pr​,Var(Tr​)=p2r(1−p)​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
P(T_r=k)=\binom{k-1}{r-1}p^r(1-p)^{k-r},\quad E[T_r]=\frac rp,\quad\operatorname{Var}(T_r)=\frac{r(1-p)}{p^2}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 第 r 次成功恰好在第 k 次试验，要求最后一次成功，且前 k−1 次中恰有 r−1 次成功。两部分相乘得到质量函数。

    For the rth success at trial k, the last trial must succeed and the first k−1 must contain r−1 successes. Multiply the two probabilities.

    P(Tr=k)=(k−1r−1)pr−1(1−p)k−r pP(T_r=k)=\binom{k-1}{r-1}p^{r-1}(1-p)^{k-r}\,pP(Tr​=k)=(r−1k−1​)pr−1(1−p)k−rp
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(T_r=k)=\binom{k-1}{r-1}p^{r-1}(1-p)^{k-r}\,p

  2. 把第 r 次成功的总等待拆成 r 个独立几何等待。几何均值可由尾和求得，方差由幂级数求导得到。

    Decompose the wait into r independent geometric waits. A geometric mean follows from survival sums and its variance from differentiated geometric series.

    E[T1]=∑k=0∞(1−p)k=1p,Var⁡(T1)=1−pp2E[T_1]=\sum_{k=0}^\infty(1-p)^k=\frac1p,\quad\operatorname{Var}(T_1)=\frac{1-p}{p^2}E[T1​]=k=0∑∞​(1−p)k=p1​,Var(T1​)=p21−p​

With success probability 0.25, the expected waiting times to the first and third successes are 4 and 12 trials.

  1. 取 p=0.25，首次成功等待包含成功那次，所以最小值是 1。

    Set p=0.25 and count the successful trial itself, so the first-success wait starts at one.

几何分布具有无记忆性，但已发生次数不会让下一次成功更“应该”出现。

The geometric law is memoryless; a long wait does not make a success “due” on the next independent trial.

2.10

超几何分布与验收抽样

Hypergeometric sampling and lot acceptance

从 N 件产品中不放回抽取 n 件，已知总体中 D 件次品。样本中的次品数服从超几何分布。分子分别从次品和合格品中组合选择，分母是所有样本组合。与二项模型相比，不放回抽样降低方差，因为一次抽到次品会减少剩余总体中的次品比例。

Sample n items without replacement from N items containing D defects. The defect count is hypergeometric. Its numerator chooses defects and nondefects separately; its denominator counts all possible samples. Compared with independent binomial sampling, sampling without replacement reduces variance because each observed defect changes the remaining population.

P(X=k)=(Dk)(N−Dn−k)(Nn),Var⁡(X)=np(1−p)N−nN−1P(X=k)=\frac{\binom Dk\binom{N-D}{n-k}}{\binom Nn},\quad\operatorname{Var}(X)=np(1-p)\frac{N-n}{N-1}P(X=k)=(nN​)(kD​)(n−kN−D​)​,Var(X)=np(1−p)N−1N−n​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
P(X=k)=\frac{\binom Dk\binom{N-D}{n-k}}{\binom Nn},\quad\operatorname{Var}(X)=np(1-p)\frac{N-n}{N-1}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 所有大小为 n 的无序样本等可能，总数 C(N,n)。恰有 k 件次品，须从 D 件次品中选 k 件，再从其余产品中选 n−k 件。

    All unordered samples of size n are equally likely. Choose k defects from D and n−k good items from N−D.

    #favorable=(Dk)(N−Dn−k)\#\text{favorable}=\binom Dk\binom{N-D}{n-k}#favorable=(kD​)(n−kN−D​)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \#\text{favorable}=\binom Dk\binom{N-D}{n-k}

  2. 写成 n 个抽取位置上的次品指示变量。无放回使不同位置负相关，这正产生有限总体修正因子。

    Write the count as indicators for sampled positions. Sampling without replacement creates negative covariance and the finite-population correction.

    Cov⁡(Ii,Ij)=−p(1−p)N−1,Var⁡(X)=np(1−p)+n(n−1)Cov⁡(I1,I2)\operatorname{Cov}(I_i,I_j)=-\frac{p(1-p)}{N-1},\quad\operatorname{Var}(X)=np(1-p)+n(n-1)\operatorname{Cov}(I_1,I_2)Cov(Ii​,Ij​)=−N−1p(1−p)​,Var(X)=np(1−p)+n(n−1)Cov(I1​,I2​)

With three defects among twenty items, a sample of four has zero defects with probability C(17,4)/C(20,4), about 0.4912.

2.11

验收曲线、风险与双重抽样

Operating characteristics and double sampling

验收方案以样本量 n 和最大允许次品数 c 决定是否接收整批。接收概率随总体次品率变化形成 OC 曲线。生产者风险对应好批被拒，消费者风险对应坏批被收，必须分别在指定质量水平下评价。双重抽样先看第一份样本：明显好则收、明显坏则拒，中间区域再追加样本。

A single sampling plan accepts a lot when the sample defect count is at most c. The acceptance probability as quality changes is the operating characteristic, or OC, curve. Producer’s risk is rejection at a designated good quality; consumer’s risk is acceptance at a designated poor quality. Double sampling accepts or rejects clear first-stage results and takes a second sample only for an intermediate region.

L(p)=Pp(X≤c),ASN=n1+n2P(second sample)L(p)=P_p(X\le c),\quad\mathrm{ASN}=n_1+n_2P(\text{second sample})L(p)=Pp​(X≤c),ASN=n1​+n2​P(second sample)
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
L(p)=P_p(X\le c),\quad\mathrm{ASN}=n_1+n_2P(\text{second sample})

  1. 验收曲线 L(p) 是固定方案在不同质量 p 下的接收概率，不是已接收批次质量的后验概率。二项近似下可直接累加质量函数。

    The OC curve L(p) gives acceptance probability at quality p for a fixed plan, not a posterior quality probability after acceptance. Under a binomial approximation, sum the masses.

    L(p)=∑k=0c(nk)pk(1−p)n−kL(p)=\sum_{k=0}^c\binom nkp^k(1-p)^{n-k}L(p)=k=0∑c​(kn​)pk(1−p)n−k
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    L(p)=\sum_{k=0}^c\binom nkp^k(1-p)^{n-k}

    Total sample size is the unavoidable first sample plus the second size times an indicator of entering stage two. Take expectations.

    Ns=n1+n2I2⟹E[Ns]=n1+n2P(I2=1)N_s=n_1+n_2I_2\quad\Longrightarrow\quad E[N_s]=n_1+n_2P(I_2=1)Ns​=n1​+n2​I2​⟹E[Ns​]=n1​+n2​P(I2​=1)

If a plan samples 20 items first and adds 30 with probability 0.4, its average sample number is 32.

2.12

超几何模型的扩展

Further hypergeometric examples

抽牌、有限总体调查和多类别抽样都能用同一计数框架。多个类别时，分别从每类选择指定数量，再除以总样本数，得到多元超几何分布。需要区分类别的排列与类别内物品的选择：问题如果只问抽到的集合，抽取顺序会在分子分母中相消。

Cards, finite-population surveys, and multitype samples share the same counting structure. For several categories, choose the required number from each category and divide by the total sample count. This gives the multivariate hypergeometric distribution. Distinguish category arrangements from item selection: if only the sampled set matters, ordering factors cancel.

P(X1=x1,…,Xr=xr)=∏i(Nixi)(Nn),∑ixi=nP(X_1=x_1,\ldots,X_r=x_r)=\frac{\prod_i\binom{N_i}{x_i}}{\binom Nn},\quad\sum_i x_i=nP(X1​=x1​,…,Xr​=xr​)=(nN​)∏i​(xi​Ni​​)​,i∑​xi​=n

  1. 多种类别不放回抽样时，每个样本可按类别唯一拆开。按乘法原理，从各类选取指定件数的方案数相乘。

    A sample without replacement can be uniquely partitioned by category. Multiply the category-specific combination counts.

    #favorable=∏i(Nixi)\#\text{favorable}=\prod_i\binom{N_i}{x_i}#favorable=i∏​(xi​Ni​​)

Check that each subset is equally likely; deliberate selection or weighted sampling changes the model.

2.13

泊松分布

The Poisson distribution

泊松分布描述给定区间内的稀疏事件数，以 λ 表示平均次数。它的均值与方差相等。当二项试验次数很大、单次成功率很小而 np 适中时，可用 λ=np 的泊松分布近似。独立泊松变量相加仍是泊松变量，参数相加。

The Poisson distribution models a count of events in an interval, with λ as its expected count. Mean and variance are equal. A binomial count can be approximated by Poisson(λ=np) when there are many trials and a small success probability. Independent Poisson counts add to another Poisson count whose parameter is the sum.

P(X=k)=e−λλkk!,E[X]=Var⁡(X)=λP(X=k)=e^{-\lambda}\frac{\lambda^k}{k!},\quad E[X]=\operatorname{Var}(X)=\lambdaP(X=k)=e−λk!λk​,E[X]=Var(X)=λ
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
P(X=k)=e^{-\lambda}\frac{\lambda^k}{k!},\quad E[X]=\operatorname{Var}(X)=\lambda

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 从二项分布出发，令 p=λ/n，固定 k 后使 n 趋于无穷。组合数与 n 的幂相抵，余下指数极限。

    Start with a binomial count with p=λ/n and fixed k. As n grows, factorial ratios cancel the powers of n, leaving an exponential limit.

    (nk)(λn)k(1−λn)n−k⟶e−λλkk!\binom nk\left(\frac\lambda n\right)^k\left(1-\frac\lambda n\right)^{n-k}\longrightarrow e^{-\lambda}\frac{\lambda^k}{k!}(kn​)(nλ​)k(1−nλ​)n−k⟶e−λk!λk​

  2. 利用 k/k!=1/(k−1)! 对均值求和；类似得到阶乘二阶矩 λ²，再换成方差。

    Use k/k!=1/(k−1)! to sum the mean. The second factorial moment is λ², which yields the variance.

A count variance much larger than its mean may signal heterogeneity or dependence missing from a single Poisson model.

2.14

泊松过程

The Poisson process

泊松过程把一个区间的计数扩展到整个时间轴。齐次模型要求不相交区间的增量独立，计数分布只依赖区间长度，单位时间速率固定。长度为 t 的区间具有参数 λt。等待首次事件的时间由“t 之前没有事件”得到，因而服从指数分布。

A Poisson process extends an interval count to a time-indexed model. The homogeneous version has independent increments, stationary increments, and a constant event rate. A time interval of length t has a Poisson count with mean λt. The first arrival exceeds t exactly when the count by t is zero, connecting counts to exponential waiting times.

N(t)∼Pois⁡(λt),P(T1>t)=e−λt,E[T1]=1/λN(t)\sim\operatorname{Pois}(\lambda t),\quad P(T_1>t)=e^{-\lambda t},\quad E[T_1]=1/\lambdaN(t)∼Pois(λt),P(T1​>t)=e−λt,E[T1​]=1/λ
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

  1. 齐次泊松过程在长度 t 的区间内平均 λt 次事件。把单区间泊松公式的参数换成 λt，就得到计数分布。

    A homogeneous Poisson process has mean λt events in an interval of length t. Substitute λt into the Poisson mass function.

    P(N(t)=k)=e−λt(λt)kk!P(N(t)=k)=e^{-\lambda t}\frac{(\lambda t)^k}{k!}P(N(t)=k)=e−λtk!(λt)k​

    The first arrival exceeds t exactly when no event occurs by t. This gives survival; differentiation gives an exponential density and integrating survival gives its mean.

    P(T1>t)=e−λt,E[T1]=∫0∞e−λt dt=1λP(T_1>t)=e^{-\lambda t},\quad E[T_1]=\int_0^\infty e^{-\lambda t}\,dt=\frac1\lambdaP(T1​>t)=e−λt,E[T1​]=∫0∞​e−λtdt=λ1​

At six arrivals per hour, ten minutes contain one expected arrival. The probability of no arrival in that interval is e⁻¹.

    The rate is six per hour. Convert ten minutes to one sixth of an hour first.

    No arrival is equivalent to a first wait over ten minutes. The mean first wait is one sixth of an hour, also ten minutes.

速率 λ 的单位必须与时间 t 相匹配；每小时和每分钟不能直接相乘。

Match the time units of λ and t; an hourly rate cannot be multiplied by a minute count without conversion.

CHAPTER 03

连续随机变量与分布

Continuous random variables and distributions

把求和换成积分，理解密度、寿命模型以及正态近似的适用条件。

Replace sums with integrals and understand densities, lifetime models, and normal approximations.

3.1

密度、分布与积分

Densities, distributions, and integration

连续随机变量在单个点上的概率为零，区间概率由密度曲线下的面积给出。密度是概率对长度的集中程度，数值可以大于 1，但总面积必须为 1。分布函数是密度的累计积分；在可导点，密度是分布函数的导数。均值与方差的离散求和公式相应变为积分。

For a continuous variable, a single point has probability zero; interval probabilities are areas under a density. A density measures probability per unit length and can exceed one, but its total area must be one. The CDF is the cumulative integral of the density, and its derivative recovers the density where differentiable. Expectations use integrals in place of sums.

F(x)=∫−∞xf(t) dt,E[g(X)]=∫−∞∞g(x)f(x) dxF(x)=\int_{-\infty}^x f(t)\,dt,\quad E[g(X)]=\int_{-\infty}^\infty g(x)f(x)\,dxF(x)=∫−∞x​f(t)dt,E[g(X)]=∫−∞∞​g(x)f(x)dx
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
F(x)=\int_{-\infty}^x f(t)\,dt,\quad E[g(X)]=\int_{-\infty}^\infty g(x)f(x)\,dx

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 密度通过区间面积定义概率，因此把所有小区间从负无穷累积到 x 就是分布函数。密度在支持外取零。

    A density assigns probabilities by interval area. Accumulating intervals from negative infinity to x gives the CDF, with density zero outside its support.

    F(b)−F(a)=∫abf(x) dxF(b)-F(a)=\int_a^b f(x)\,dxF(b)−F(a)=∫ab​f(x)dx
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    F(b)-F(a)=\int_a^b f(x)\,dx

  2. 加权求和的连续极限给出期望积分。计算前检查密度非负、总积分为 1，所求期望还要求相应积分存在。

    A limit of weighted sums gives the expectation integral. First check nonnegativity and total area one; the desired expectation also requires integrability.

    ∫−∞∞f(x) dx=1,E[X]=∫−∞∞xf(x) dx\int_{-\infty}^\infty f(x)\,dx=1,\qquad E[X]=\int_{-\infty}^\infty xf(x)\,dx∫−∞∞​f(x)dx=1,E[X]=∫−∞∞​xf(x)dx
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \int_{-\infty}^\infty f(x)\,dx=1,\qquad E[X]=\int_{-\infty}^\infty xf(x)\,dx

    Take f(x)=2x on (0,1). Check normalization and calculate the interior CDF.

连续型下 P(X=x)=0 不表示 x 不可能出现；概率零与逻辑不可能并非同一概念。

A point probability of zero does not make that value logically impossible.

3.2

均匀分布

The uniform distribution

均匀分布表示相同长度的子区间获得相同概率。它不是让无限多个点各分到某个正概率，而是让密度恒定。端点 a、b 决定支持区间、中心与尺度。均匀变量也可作为生成其他分布的基础：如果 F 严格递增，令 X=F⁻¹(U) 就把均匀随机数转换成目标分布。

A uniform distribution assigns equal probability to subintervals of equal length. It does not assign the same positive probability to individual points; instead it has constant density. Endpoints determine support, center, and scale. Uniform variables also generate other distributions: when F is strictly increasing, the transformation X=F⁻¹(U) produces CDF F.

f(x)=1b−a,E[X]=a+b2,Var⁡(X)=(b−a)212f(x)=\frac1{b-a},\quad E[X]=\frac{a+b}{2},\quad\operatorname{Var}(X)=\frac{(b-a)^2}{12}f(x)=b−a1​,E[X]=2a+b​,Var(X)=12(b−a)2​

“没有额外信息”本身不足以证明均匀分布；均匀性依赖所选择的变量与尺度。

Lack of information alone does not establish a uniform law; uniformity depends on the chosen variable and scale.

3.3

指数分布与无记忆性

The exponential distribution and memorylessness

指数分布是齐次泊松过程的相邻到达等待时间模型，也用于常数风险率的寿命。采用速率 λ 参数时，均值为 1/λ。无记忆性说明已经等待 s 后，额外等待超过 t 的概率与从零开始一样。它是对整个分布的严格性质，不是所有寿命都能近似满足的普遍规律。

The exponential distribution models interarrival times in a homogeneous Poisson process and lifetimes with a constant hazard. With rate λ, its mean is 1/λ. Memorylessness means that after waiting s, the probability of waiting at least another t is unchanged. This is a strong property of the distribution, not a universal rule for lifetimes.

f(t)=λe−λt,R(t)=e−λt,E[T]=1λ,Var⁡(T)=1λ2f(t)=\lambda e^{-\lambda t},\quad R(t)=e^{-\lambda t},\quad E[T]=\frac1\lambda,\quad\operatorname{Var}(T)=\frac1{\lambda^2}f(t)=λe−λt,R(t)=e−λt,E[T]=λ1​,Var(T)=λ21​

f(t)=\lambda e^{-\lambda t},\quad R(t)=e^{-\lambda t},\quad E[T]=\frac1\lambda,\quad\operatorname{Var}(T)=\frac1{\lambda^2}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 常数风险率 λ 表示生存函数满足 R′(t)=−λR(t)，初始 R(0)=1。分离变量求解。

    Conditional survival is a ratio of survival probabilities. The exponential form cancels elapsed time s, while its tail integral gives the mean.

    R(s+t)R(s)=e−λt,E[T]=∫0∞R(t) dt=1λ\frac{R(s+t)}{R(s)}=e^{-\lambda t},\qquad E[T]=\int_0^\infty R(t)\,dt=\frac1\lambdaR(s)R(s+t)​=e−λt,E[T]=∫0∞​R(t)dt=λ1​

平均等待 5 分钟，λ=0.2/分钟。再等超过 3 分钟的概率为 e⁻⁰·⁶≈0.5488，不因先前已等 8 分钟而改变。

With mean wait five minutes, the rate is 0.2 per minute. Waiting over three additional minutes has probability e⁻⁰·⁶≈0.5488, even after an eight-minute wait.

  1. 平均等待 5 分钟意味着速率 λ=1/5 每分钟，而不是 λ=5。

    A mean wait of five minutes means rate λ=1/5 per minute, not five.

    λ=0.2 min−1\lambda=0.2\ \mathrm{min}^{-1}λ=0.2 min−1
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \lambda=0.2\ \mathrm{min}^{-1}

  2. 已经等了 8 分钟，再等超过 3 分钟对应 T>11，条件是 T>8。

    After eight minutes, waiting more than three additional minutes means T>11 conditional on T>8.

    P(T>11∣T>8)=P(T>11)P(T>8)P(T>11\mid T>8)=\frac{P(T>11)}{P(T>8)}P(T>11∣T>8)=P(T>8)P(T>11)​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(T>11\mid T>8)=\frac{P(T>11)}{P(T>8)}

  3. 代入生存函数，消去已经经过的 8 分钟。

    Substitute the survival function and cancel the elapsed eight minutes.

    e−0.2(11)e−0.2(8)=e−0.6=0.548812…\frac{e^{-0.2(11)}}{e^{-0.2(8)}}=e^{-0.6}=\boxed{0.548812\ldots}e−0.2(8)e−0.2(11)​=e−0.6=0.548812…​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \frac{e^{-0.2(11)}}{e^{-0.2(8)}}=e^{-0.6}=\boxed{0.548812\ldots}
!

有的教材用尺度 θ=1/λ；看到参数先确认它表示速率还是平均时间。

Some texts use the scale θ=1/λ. Check whether a parameter denotes rate or mean time.

3.4

生存函数与风险率

Survival functions and hazard rates

可靠性函数 R(t) 表示部件到时间 t 仍正常的概率。风险率是在已活到 t 的条件下，接下来极短时间内失效的瞬时速率。它不是“在 t 时失效的概率”。对风险率积分后取负指数，可以恢复生存函数。独立串联系统的风险率相加，因为其可靠性相乘。

The survival or reliability function R(t) is the chance a component lasts beyond t. The hazard is an instantaneous failure rate conditional on survival to t, not a point probability. Integrating the hazard and exponentiating its negative recovers survival. Independent series components have additive hazards because their survival probabilities multiply.

h(t)=f(t)R(t),R(t)=exp⁡ ⁣(−∫0th(u) du)h(t)=\frac{f(t)}{R(t)},\qquad R(t)=\exp\!\left(-\int_0^th(u)\,du\right)h(t)=R(t)f(t)​,R(t)=exp(−∫0t​h(u)du)
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
h(t)=\frac{f(t)}{R(t)},\qquad R(t)=\exp\!\left(-\int_0^th(u)\,du\right)

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 由条件概率定义，已活到 t 后在 [t,t+Δt] 失效的概率，约等于 f(t)Δt/R(t)。除以 Δt 再取极限得到风险率。

    Conditional failure over [t,t+Δt] is approximately f(t)Δt/R(t). Divide by Δt and take a limit to define the hazard.

    h(t)=lim⁡Δt↓0P(t<T≤t+Δt∣T>t)Δth(t)=\lim_{\Delta t\downarrow0}\frac{P(t<T\le t+\Delta t\mid T>t)}{\Delta t}h(t)=Δt↓0lim​ΔtP(t<T≤t+Δt∣T>t)​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    h(t)=\lim_{\Delta t\downarrow0}\frac{P(t<T\le t+\Delta t\mid T>t)}{\Delta t}

  2. 因为 R′=−f，所以对数生存函数的导数为 −h。积分并用 R(0)=1，得到生存函数。

    Since R′=−f, the derivative of log survival is −h. Integrate and use R(0)=1.

    ddtlog⁡R(t)=−h(t)⟹log⁡R(t)=−∫0th(u) du\frac d{dt}\log R(t)=-h(t)\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\log R(t)=-\int_0^th(u)\,dudtd​logR(t)=−h(t)⟹logR(t)=−∫0t​h(u)du
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \frac d{dt}\log R(t)=-h(t)\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\log R(t)=-\int_0^th(u)\,du
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

若 h(t)=0.02/小时，则存活 50 小时的概率为 e⁻¹≈0.3679。若风险率随时间上升，不能再用单一常数 λ 描述。

A constant hazard of 0.02 per hour gives survival e⁻¹≈0.3679 at fifty hours. An increasing hazard requires a different model.

  1. 假设风险率始终为 0.02 每小时，时间为 50 小时。累计风险是风险率在这段时间上的积分。

    Take a constant hazard 0.02 per hour over fifty hours. Cumulative hazard is its time integral.

    H(50)=∫0500.02 du=1H(50)=\int_0^{50}0.02\,du=1H(50)=∫050​0.02du=1
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    H(50)=\int_0^{50}0.02\,du=1

  2. 取累计风险的负指数，得到可靠性。

    Exponentiate the negative cumulative hazard to obtain reliability.

    R(50)=e−H(50)=e−1≈0.367879R(50)=e^{-H(50)}=\boxed{e^{-1}\approx0.367879}R(50)=e−H(50)=e−1≈0.367879​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    R(50)=e^{-H(50)}=\boxed{e^{-1}\approx0.367879}

  3. 50 小时内失效的概率是其补事件。如果求已存活 50 小时后的下 10 小时失效概率，则要用条件生存比。

    Failure within fifty hours is the complement. For failure in the next ten hours after surviving fifty, use conditional survival.

    P(T≤50)=0.632121…,P(T≤60∣T>50)=1−R(60)R(50)=1−e−0.2P(T\le50)=0.632121\ldots,\quad P(T\le60\mid T>50)=1-\frac{R(60)}{R(50)}=1-e^{-0.2}P(T≤50)=0.632121…,P(T≤60∣T>50)=1−R(50)R(60)​=1−e−0.2
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(T\le50)=0.632121\ldots,\quad P(T\le60\mid T>50)=1-\frac{R(60)}{R(50)}=1-e^{-0.2}
!

风险率具有“每单位时间”的量纲，可以大于 1；它不是 0 到 1 的概率。

A hazard has units of inverse time and may exceed one; it is not a probability bounded by one.

3.5

正态分布与标准化

The normal distribution and standardization

正态分布的钟形由均值 μ 定位、标准差 σ 控制宽度。标准化 Z=(X−μ)/σ 把不同正态问题统一到标准正态分布。概率计算依赖标准正态累积分布 Φ；对称性给出 Φ(−z)=1−Φ(z)。这里的正态假设应来自模型或数据依据，不能仅凭变量是连续的就采用。

A normal density is centered at μ, with spread controlled by σ. Standardization converts every normal probability calculation to the standard normal CDF Φ. Symmetry gives Φ(−z)=1−Φ(z). Normality should follow from a model or evidence; continuity alone does not justify it.

Z=X−μσ∼N(0,1),P(a<X≤b)=Φ ⁣(b−μσ)−Φ ⁣(a−μσ)Z=\frac{X-\mu}{\sigma}\sim N(0,1),\qquad P(a<X\le b)=\Phi\!\left(\frac{b-\mu}{\sigma}\right)-\Phi\!\left(\frac{a-\mu}{\sigma}\right)Z=σX−μ​∼N(0,1),P(a<X≤b)=Φ(σb−μ​)−Φ(σa−μ​)
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
Z=\frac{X-\mu}{\sigma}\sim N(0,1),\qquad P(a<X\le b)=\Phi\!\left(\frac{b-\mu}{\sigma}\right)-\Phi\!\left(\frac{a-\mu}{\sigma}\right)

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 令 x=μ+σz，密度变换中的 dx=σdz 恰好抵消正态密度分母的 σ。标准化后的密度与 μ、σ 无关。

    Set x=μ+σz. The Jacobian dx=σdz cancels the density’s factor 1/σ, removing both parameters.

    fZ(z)=12πe−z2/2f_Z(z)=\frac1{\sqrt{2\pi}}e^{-z^2/2}fZ​(z)=2π​1​e−z2/2
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    f_Z(z)=\frac1{\sqrt{2\pi}}e^{-z^2/2}

  2. 由于 σ>0，标准化保持不等式方向。区间概率转成标准正态 CDF 的差；偶对称密度给出负值对称公式。

    Since σ>0, standardization preserves inequalities. Interval probabilities become CDF differences, and the even density gives symmetry.

    Φ(−z)=1−Φ(z)\Phi(-z)=1-\Phi(z)Φ(−z)=1−Φ(z)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \Phi(-z)=1-\Phi(z)

若 X∼N(100,15²)，则 P(X≤130)=Φ(2)≈0.97725。第二个参数在此明确写为方差 15²。

If X∼N(100,15²), then P(X≤130)=Φ(2)≈0.97725. The second parameter here is explicitly the variance.

  1. X 的均值为 100，标准差为 15。要求 X≤130，把边界减均值并除以标准差。

    X has mean one hundred and standard deviation fifteen. Standardize the boundary 130.

    z=130−10015=2z=\frac{130-100}{15}=2z=15130−100​=2
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    z=\frac{130-100}{15}=2

    Rewrite the original event as an equivalent standard-normal event.

    P(X≤130)=P ⁣(X−10015≤2)=Φ(2)P(X\le130)=P\!\left(\frac{X-100}{15}\le2\right)=\Phi(2)P(X≤130)=P(15X−100​≤2)=Φ(2)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(X\le130)=P\!\left(\frac{X-100}{15}\le2\right)=\Phi(2)

    P(X≤130)≈0.977250,P(X>130)≈0.022750\boxed{P(X\le130)\approx0.977250},\quad P(X>130)\approx0.022750P(X≤130)≈0.977250​,P(X>130)≈0.022750
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

Check whether the second normal parameter denotes variance or standard deviation.

3.6

二项分布的正态近似

Normal approximation to a binomial count

二项分布在 n 足够大、p 不太靠近 0 或 1 时近似钟形。近似正态变量取相同均值 np 与方差 np(1−p)。离散点 k 对应连续区间 [k−0.5,k+0.5]，由此得到连续性修正。边界尾部概率往往对近似误差更敏感；条件不足时应直接计算二项概率。

A binomial distribution becomes approximately bell-shaped for sufficiently large n with p away from zero and one. Match the mean np and variance np(1−p). Continuity correction represents a discrete value k by the interval [k−0.5,k+0.5]. Tail probabilities are particularly sensitive to approximation error; use exact binomial calculations when the conditions are poor.

P(X≤k)≈Φ ⁣(k+1/2−npnp(1−p))P(X\le k)\approx\Phi\!\left(\frac{k+1/2-np}{\sqrt{np(1-p)}}\right)P(X≤k)≈Φ(np(1−p)​k+1/2−np​)
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
P(X\le k)\approx\Phi\!\left(\frac{k+1/2-np}{\sqrt{np(1-p)}}\right)

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 二项计数的均值 np、方差 np(1−p) 决定匹配正态。可从独立伯努利和的中心极限定理得到这个近似。

    Match the binomial mean np and variance np(1−p). The CLT for independent Bernoulli sums motivates the approximation.

    Y∼N ⁣(np,np(1−p))Y\sim N\!\left(np,np(1-p)\right)Y∼N(np,np(1−p))
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    Y\sim N\!\left(np,np(1-p)\right)

  2. 离散质量位于整数点，用每个整数周围宽度为 1 的连续区间代表。事件 X≤k 的右边界因而变成 k+0.5。

    Represent each integer mass by a continuous interval of width one centered there. The upper boundary for X≤k becomes k+0.5.

    P(X≤k)≈P(Y≤k+0.5)P(X\le k)\approx P(Y\le k+0.5)P(X≤k)≈P(Y≤k+0.5)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(X\le k)\approx P(Y\le k+0.5)

3.7

伽马分布与卡方分布

Gamma and chi-square distributions

泊松过程等待第 r 次事件的时间是 r 个独立指数等待时间之和，因此服从形状 r 的伽马分布。伽马函数把阶乘推广到正实数。卡方分布是形状 ν/2、速率 1/2 的伽马分布，也等于 ν 个独立标准正态的平方和，是方差推断与拟合优度检验的基础。

Waiting for the rth event in a Poisson process sums r independent exponential times, giving a gamma distribution with shape r. The gamma function extends factorials to positive real arguments. A chi-square distribution is gamma with shape ν/2 and rate 1/2; for integer ν it is the sum of ν independent squared standard normals. This connects it to variance inference and goodness-of-fit tests.

f(x)=λαΓ(α)xα−1e−λx,E[X]=αλ,Var⁡(X)=αλ2f(x)=\frac{\lambda^\alpha}{\Gamma(\alpha)}x^{\alpha-1}e^{-\lambda x},\quad E[X]=\frac\alpha\lambda,\quad\operatorname{Var}(X)=\frac\alpha{\lambda^2}f(x)=Γ(α)λα​xα−1e−λx,E[X]=λα​,Var(X)=λ2α​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
f(x)=\frac{\lambda^\alpha}{\Gamma(\alpha)}x^{\alpha-1}e^{-\lambda x},\quad E[X]=\frac\alpha\lambda,\quad\operatorname{Var}(X)=\frac\alpha{\lambda^2}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 伽马函数的积分定义给出密度的归一化。令 u=λx，把 x 的积分换成标准伽马积分。

    The gamma integral normalizes the density. Substitute u=λx to reduce it to the defining gamma integral.

    Γ(α)=∫0∞uα−1e−u du\Gamma(\alpha)=\int_0^\infty u^{\alpha-1}e^{-u}\,duΓ(α)=∫0∞​uα−1e−udu
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \Gamma(\alpha)=\int_0^\infty u^{\alpha-1}e^{-u}\,du

  2. 乘上 xʳ 后，积分中的形状参数变为 α+r。再用 Γ(α+1)=αΓ(α) 求一阶与二阶矩。

    Multiplying by xʳ changes the shape in the integral to α+r. Use the gamma recurrence for the first two moments.

    E[Xr]=Γ(α+r)λrΓ(α),E[X2]=α(α+1)λ2E[X^r]=\frac{\Gamma(\alpha+r)}{\lambda^r\Gamma(\alpha)},\quad E[X^2]=\frac{\alpha(\alpha+1)}{\lambda^2}E[Xr]=λrΓ(α)Γ(α+r)​,E[X2]=λ2α(α+1)​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

At two arrivals per hour, the waiting time to the third arrival has mean 1.5 hours and variance 0.75 hours squared.

3.8

威布尔寿命分布

The Weibull lifetime distribution

威布尔分布通过形状参数 k 描述随年龄变化的失效率，通过尺度 η 控制时间单位。k=1 时退化为指数分布；k<1 的风险率递减，可描述早期失效；k>1 的风险率递增，可描述磨损。它的生存函数形式简单，因此适合可靠性分析和寿命概率计算。

The Weibull law uses shape k to control how failure risk changes with age and scale η to set the time scale. It reduces to an exponential law at k=1. A shape below one gives decreasing hazard; above one gives increasing hazard. Its simple survival function is useful for reliability calculations.

R(t)=e−(t/η)k,h(t)=kη(tη)k−1R(t)=e^{-(t/\eta)^k},\quad h(t)=\frac{k}{\eta}\left(\frac t\eta\right)^{k-1}R(t)=e−(t/η)k,h(t)=ηk​(ηt​)k−1
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
R(t)=e^{-(t/\eta)^k},\quad h(t)=\frac{k}{\eta}\left(\frac t\eta\right)^{k-1}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 从累计风险 H(t)=(t/η)ᵏ 出发，生存函数为 exp(−H)。风险率是累计风险的导数。

    Start with cumulative hazard H(t)=(t/η)ᵏ. Survival is exp(−H), and hazard is H′.

    h(t)=H′(t)=kη(tη)k−1h(t)=H^\prime(t)=\frac{k}{\eta}\left(\frac t\eta\right)^{k-1}h(t)=H′(t)=ηk​(ηt​)k−1
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    h(t)=H^\prime(t)=\frac{k}{\eta}\left(\frac t\eta\right)^{k-1}

  2. 密度为 hR；均值用尾积分，代换 u=(t/η)ᵏ 后得到伽马函数。

    The density is hR. For the mean, integrate survival and substitute u=(t/η)ᵏ.

    E[T]=ηkΓ(1/k)=ηΓ(1+1/k)E[T]=\frac\eta k\Gamma(1/k)=\eta\Gamma(1+1/k)E[T]=kη​Γ(1/k)=ηΓ(1+1/k)

例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

k=2、η=100 小时，R(50)=e⁻⁰·²⁵≈0.7788；t 翻倍时累计风险变成原来的四倍。

For k=2 and η=100 hours, survival at fifty hours is e⁻⁰·²⁵≈0.7788. Doubling time quadruples cumulative hazard.

  1. k=2、η=100 小时、t=50 小时，先计算无量纲比值 t/η。

    With k=2, η=100 hours, and t=50 hours, first form the dimensionless ratio.

    tη=50100=0.5,H(50)=0.52=0.25\frac t\eta=\frac{50}{100}=0.5,\quad H(50)=0.5^2=0.25ηt​=10050​=0.5,H(50)=0.52=0.25
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \frac t\eta=\frac{50}{100}=0.5,\quad H(50)=0.5^2=0.25

  2. 取负指数得到生存概率。风险率同时可求，但它有每小时单位，不是概率。

    Exponentiate the negative to get survival. The hazard can also be calculated, but it is a per-hour rate rather than a probability.

    R(50)=e−0.25≈0.778801,h(50)=2100(0.5)=0.01 h−1R(50)=\boxed{e^{-0.25}\approx0.778801},\quad h(50)=\frac2{100}(0.5)=0.01\ \mathrm h^{-1}R(50)=e−0.25≈0.778801​,h(50)=1002​(0.5)=0.01 h−1
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    R(50)=\boxed{e^{-0.25}\approx0.778801},\quad h(50)=\frac2{100}(0.5)=0.01\ \mathrm h^{-1}

  3. 时间翻倍为 100 小时后，累计风险是原来的四倍，生存概率并非原来的一半。

    At one hundred hours the cumulative hazard quadruples; survival is not simply halved.

    H(100)=1=4H(50),R(100)=e−1≈0.367879H(100)=1=4H(50),\qquad R(100)=e^{-1}\approx0.367879H(100)=1=4H(50),R(100)=e−1≈0.367879
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    H(100)=1=4H(50),\qquad R(100)=e^{-1}\approx0.367879
!

形状和尺度是不同概念；相同均值的寿命分布可以有完全不同的老化行为。

Shape and scale play different roles; lifetimes with the same mean can have very different aging behavior.

CHAPTER 04

变量变换、生成函数与统计应用

Transformations, generating functions, and inference

研究随机量的函数和总和，再把抽样分布用于均值、方差、回归与质量控制。

Study functions and sums of variables, then apply sampling distributions to estimation, tests, regression, and process control.

4.1

为什么研究统计量的分布

Why distributions of statistics matter

数据分析通常不直接使用单个观察，而使用均值、样本方差、比例或回归系数。这些都是样本的函数，因此本身随机。为了衡量估计误差或构造拒绝域，需要知道这些统计量在假定模型下怎样变化。变量变换、卷积和生成函数正是建立抽样分布的工具。

Data analysis often uses a mean, sample variance, proportion, or regression coefficient rather than a single observation. Each is a function of the sample and is therefore random. To quantify estimation error or construct rejection regions, we need its distribution under an assumed model. Transformations, convolution, and generating functions provide the needed tools.

T=g(X1,…,Xn),X‾=1n∑iXi,SE⁡(X‾)=σnT=g(X_1,\ldots,X_n),\quad \overline X=\frac1n\sum_iX_i,\quad\operatorname{SE}(\overline X)=\frac\sigma{\sqrt n}T=g(X1​,…,Xn​),X=n1​i∑​Xi​,SE(X)=n​σ​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
T=g(X_1,\ldots,X_n),\quad \overline X=\frac1n\sum_iX_i,\quad\operatorname{SE}(\overline X)=\frac\sigma{\sqrt n}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 样本向量在抽样前是随机的。对它应用固定函数得到统计量，其分布由整个抽样机制决定。

    The sample vector is random before sampling. Applying a fixed function gives a statistic whose law depends on the full sampling mechanism.

    P(T≤t)=P(g(X1,…,Xn)≤t)P(T\le t)=P\bigl(g(X_1,\ldots,X_n)\le t\bigr)P(T≤t)=P(g(X1​,…,Xn​)≤t)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(T\le t)=P\bigl(g(X_1,\ldots,X_n)\le t\bigr)

  2. 以均值为例，独立同分布使方差为 n 个方差相加再除以 n²。其平方根叫均值的标准误。

    For a sample mean, iid sampling adds n variances and divides by n². The square root is the mean’s standard error.

    Var⁡(X‾)=1n2∑iσ2=σ2n\operatorname{Var}(\overline X)=\frac1{n^2}\sum_i\sigma^2=\frac{\sigma^2}{n}Var(X)=n21​i∑​σ2=nσ2​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \operatorname{Var}(\overline X)=\frac1{n^2}\sum_i\sigma^2=\frac{\sigma^2}{n}
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

抽样前 X̄ 是随机变量；抽样后得到的 x̄ 是固定观测值。标准误描述前者的波动。

Before sampling, X̄ is random. After sampling, the observed x̄ is fixed. A standard error describes the sampling variation of the former.

  1. 补充一个数值例子：总体标准差 12，独立抽取 36 次，关心平均值精度。

    As a numerical example, take population standard deviation twelve and thirty-six independent observations.

    σ=12,n=36\sigma=12,\quad n=36σ=12,n=36
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \sigma=12,\quad n=36

  2. 先计算均值的方差，然后开平方，避免把方差与标准误混淆。

    Compute the variance of the mean first and then take its square root.

    Var⁡(X‾)=14436=4,SE⁡(X‾)=2\operatorname{Var}(\overline X)=\frac{144}{36}=4,\quad\operatorname{SE}(\overline X)=\boxed2Var(X)=36144​=4,SE(X)=2​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \operatorname{Var}(\overline X)=\frac{144}{36}=4,\quad\operatorname{SE}(\overline X)=\boxed2

  3. 实际抽样后若均值观测为 50，50 是固定结果，2 则描述重复抽样时均值的波动。总体正态时还有精确正态抽样分布。

    If the observed mean is fifty, fifty is a fixed result while two describes its repeated-sampling variation. A normal population also gives an exact normal sampling law.

    Xi∼N(μ,144) ⟹ X‾∼N(μ,4)X_i\sim N(\mu,144)\ \Longrightarrow\ \overline X\sim N(\mu,4)Xi​∼N(μ,144) ⟹ X∼N(μ,4)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

!

总体标准差 σ 描述个体差异；均值的标准误 σ/√n 描述估计精度。

Population standard deviation describes individual variation; the mean’s standard error describes estimation precision.

4.2

函数的期望与非线性

Expectations of transformed variables

计算 g(X) 的期望不一定要先求出它的完整分布，直接按 X 的概率加权即可。非线性函数不能随意移到期望符号外。平方函数尤其重要：它与方差的差额刚好是 E[X²]−E[X]²。在线性函数下则可以直接使用期望的线性性，不需要独立性。

To find E[g(X)], one need not derive the entire distribution of g(X); weight g(x) using the original distribution of X. Nonlinear functions cannot generally be moved outside expectation. For squaring, the discrepancy is exactly the variance. Linearity of expectation, unlike multiplication of expectations, does not require independence.

E[g(X)]=∫g(x)fX(x) dx,E[X2]=Var⁡(X)+E[X]2E[g(X)]=\int g(x)f_X(x)\,dx,\qquad E[X^2]=\operatorname{Var}(X)+E[X]^2E[g(X)]=∫g(x)fX​(x)dx,E[X2]=Var(X)+E[X]2
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
E[g(X)]=\int g(x)f_X(x)\,dx,\qquad E[X^2]=\operatorname{Var}(X)+E[X]^2

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 把各个 x 对应的函数值 g(x) 按原分布加权，就已经在统计所有可能的变换后取值，不必先求新密度。

    Weight g(x) by the original law of X. This already accounts for all transformed values without first deriving their density.

    E[g(X)]=∑xg(x)pX(x)or∫g(x)fX(x) dxE[g(X)]=\sum_xg(x)p_X(x)\quad\text{or}\quad\int g(x)f_X(x)\,dxE[g(X)]=x∑​g(x)pX​(x)or∫g(x)fX​(x)dx
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[g(X)]=\sum_xg(x)p_X(x)\quad\text{or}\quad\int g(x)f_X(x)\,dx

  2. 非线性不能与期望交换。对平方函数，差额恰好是非负方差；只有方差为零时两种平均才相等。

    Nonlinear transformations do not commute with expectation. For squaring, the discrepancy is the nonnegative variance, vanishing only for a constant variable almost surely.

    E[X2]−E[X]2=E[(X−E[X])2]≥0E[X^2]-E[X]^2=E[(X-E[X])^2]\ge0E[X2]−E[X]2=E[(X−E[X])2]≥0
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[X^2]-E[X]^2=E[(X-E[X])^2]\ge0
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

X∼U(0,1)，边长 X 的正方形平均面积为 E[X²]=1/3，而平均边长的平方为 1/4。

For X uniform on (0,1), a square with side X has mean area 1/3, whereas the square of its mean side is 1/4.

  1. 边长 X 在 (0,1) 均匀，正方形面积 A=X²。写出密度 f_X=1。

    A square has side X uniform on (0,1), so area A=X² and f_X=1.

    A=X2,fX(x)=1  (0<x<1)A=X^2,\qquad f_X(x)=1\ \ (0<x<1)A=X2,fX​(x)=1  (0<x<1)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    A=X^2,\qquad f_X(x)=1\ \ (0<x<1)

  2. 直接对面积加权积分，不先把平均边长平方。

    Integrate the area directly rather than squaring the average side.

    E[A]=∫01x2 dx=[x33]01=13E[A]=\int_0^1x^2\,dx=\left[\frac{x^3}{3}\right]_0^1=\boxed{\frac13}E[A]=∫01​x2dx=[3x3​]01​=31​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[A]=\int_0^1x^2\,dx=\left[\frac{x^3}{3}\right]_0^1=\boxed{\frac13}

    The mean side is one half and its square one quarter. The discrepancy 1/12 is the uniform variable’s variance.

    E[X]=12,E[X2]−E[X]2=13−14=112E[X]=\frac12,\quad E[X^2]-E[X]^2=\frac13-\frac14=\frac1{12}E[X]=21​,E[X2]−E[X]2=31​−41​=121​
