“先取平均再变换”与“先变换再取平均”通常回答不同的问题。

Transforming an average and averaging a transformation usually answer different questions.

4.3

分布函数法与密度变换

CDF and density transformation methods

先把事件 {Y≤y} 改写成关于 X 的事件，再求导，是最通用的一维变换方法。若 y=g(x) 单调且可微，可以使用反函数导数的绝对值调整密度。非单调时，同一个 y 可能有多个原像，必须把所有分支加起来，并单独处理新支持区间。

The CDF method rewrites {Y≤y} in terms of X and differentiates the resulting probability. For a smooth monotone transformation, the inverse derivative adjusts the density. A nonmonotone transformation may give several preimages of one y; include every valid branch and determine the new support explicitly.

fY(y)=∑xi: g(xi)=yfX(xi)∣g′(xi)∣f_Y(y)=\sum_{x_i:\,g(x_i)=y}\frac{f_X(x_i)}{|g^\prime(x_i)|}fY​(y)=xi​:g(xi​)=y∑​∣g′(xi​)∣fX​(xi​)​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
f_Y(y)=\sum_{x_i:\,g(x_i)=y}\frac{f_X(x_i)}{|g^\prime(x_i)|}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 单调变换先通过反函数改写累计事件，再按链式法则求导。若递减，不等式反向，但绝对值统一了结果。

    For a monotone transformation, rewrite the CDF with the inverse and differentiate by the chain rule. A decreasing map reverses inequalities, and an absolute value unifies both cases.

    fY(y)=fX(g−1(y))∣ddyg−1(y)∣f_Y(y)=f_X(g^{-1}(y))\left|\frac d{dy}g^{-1}(y)\right|fY​(y)=fX​(g−1(y))​dyd​g−1(y)​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    f_Y(y)=f_X(g^{-1}(y))\left|\frac d{dy}g^{-1}(y)\right|

  2. 非单调变换应把定义域分成若干单调分支。每个分支给出一份密度贡献，再求和；支持边界另行确定。

    For a nonmonotone map, partition the domain into monotone branches. Add each branch’s density contribution and determine support boundaries separately.

    g(xi)=y⟹∣dxidy∣=1∣g′(xi)∣g(x_i)=y\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\left|\frac{dx_i}{dy}\right|=\frac1{|g^\prime(x_i)|}g(xi​)=y⟹​dydxi​​​=∣g′(xi​)∣1​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    g(x_i)=y\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\left|\frac{dx_i}{dy}\right|=\frac1{|g^\prime(x_i)|}
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

X∼U(−1,1)，Y=X²。对 0<y<1，F_Y(y)=P(−√y≤X≤√y)=√y，所以 f_Y(y)=1/(2√y)。

For X uniform on (−1,1) and Y=X², F_Y(y)=√y and f_Y(y)=1/(2√y) on (0,1).

  1. X 在 (−1,1) 均匀，密度为 1/2，Y=X² 只能落在 (0,1)。

    X is uniform on (−1,1) with density one half; Y=X² lies in (0,1).

    0<y<1,{X2≤y}={−y≤X≤y}0<y<1,\quad \{X^2\le y\}=\{-\sqrt y\le X\le\sqrt y\}0<y<1,{X2≤y}={−y​≤X≤y​}
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    0<y<1,\quad \{X^2\le y\}=\{-\sqrt y\le X\le\sqrt y\}

  2. 区间长度 2√y 乘密度 1/2，得到分布函数，再求导。

    Multiply interval length 2√y by density one half for the CDF and then differentiate.

    FY(y)=y,fY(y)=12yF_Y(y)=\sqrt y,\quad f_Y(y)=\boxed{\frac1{2\sqrt y}}FY​(y)=y​,fY​(y)=2y​1​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    F_Y(y)=\sqrt y,\quad f_Y(y)=\boxed{\frac1{2\sqrt y}}

  3. 用两个反函数分支复算：每支贡献 1/(4√y)。最后积分确认归一化。

    Check using both inverse branches, each contributing 1/(4√y), and verify normalization.

    fY(y)=1212y+1212y,∫01fY(y) dy=1f_Y(y)=\frac12\frac1{2\sqrt y}+\frac12\frac1{2\sqrt y},\qquad\int_0^1f_Y(y)\,dy=1fY​(y)=21​2y​1​+21​2y​1​,∫01​fY​(y)dy=1
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    f_Y(y)=\frac12\frac1{2\sqrt y}+\frac12\frac1{2\sqrt y},\qquad\int_0^1f_Y(y)\,dy=1
!

平方变换会合并正负两个分支，只处理正根会漏掉概率。

Squaring merges positive and negative branches; keeping only the positive root loses probability.

4.4

独立随机变量之和：卷积

Sums of independent variables: convolution

要求 X+Y 的分布，可以固定一个变量的值，再对另一个变量积分或求和。独立性把联合密度分解成两个边缘密度乘积，得到卷积。积分上下限由两个变量的支持集共同决定。例如两个 U(0,1) 相加，结果在 [0,2] 上呈三角形，而不是均匀。

To find the distribution of X+Y, condition on one variable and sum or integrate over its values. Independence factorizes the joint law and produces convolution. Integration limits must satisfy both supports. The sum of two independent U(0,1) variables, for example, has a triangular rather than uniform density on [0,2].

fX+Y(s)=∫−∞∞fX(x)fY(s−x) dxf_{X+Y}(s)=\int_{-\infty}^\infty f_X(x)f_Y(s-x)\,dxfX+Y​(s)=∫−∞∞​fX​(x)fY​(s−x)dx
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
f_{X+Y}(s)=\int_{-\infty}^\infty f_X(x)f_Y(s-x)\,dx

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 令 S=X+Y，先固定 X=x。若两者独立，给定 X 不改变 Y 的分布，因此 S 的条件密度是平移后的 Y 密度。

    Fix X=x. Independence leaves Y’s distribution unchanged, so the conditional density of S is the density of Y shifted by x.

    fS∣X(s∣x)=fY(s−x)f_{S\mid X}(s\mid x)=f_Y(s-x)fS∣X​(s∣x)=fY​(s−x)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    f_{S\mid X}(s\mid x)=f_Y(s-x)

  2. 对 X 的所有取值加权积分，得到卷积。支持集要求 x 和 s−x 同时落在各自允许范围内。

    Average over X to obtain convolution. Both x and s−x must lie within their respective supports.

    fS(s)=∫fS∣X(s∣x)fX(x) dxf_S(s)=\int f_{S\mid X}(s\mid x)f_X(x)\,dxfS​(s)=∫fS∣X​(s∣x)fX​(x)dx
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    f_S(s)=\int f_{S\mid X}(s\mid x)f_X(x)\,dx
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

两个独立 U(0,1) 之和 S：0<s<1 时 f_S(s)=s；1≤s<2 时 f_S(s)=2−s。

For two independent uniform (0,1) variables, their sum has density s on (0,1) and 2−s on [1,2).

  1. X、Y 独立且均为 U(0,1)。被积函数在 0<x<1 且 0<s−x<1 时为 1。

    Take independent uniform (0,1) variables. The integrand is one where 0<x<1 and 0<s−x<1.

    max⁡(0,s−1)<x<min⁡(1,s)\max(0,s-1)<x<\min(1,s)max(0,s−1)<x<min(1,s)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \max(0,s-1)<x<\min(1,s)

  2. 当 0<s<1，积分区间为 (0,s)；当 1≤s<2，区间为 (s−1,1)。

    For 0<s<1 the integration interval is (0,s); for 1≤s<2 it is (s−1,1).

    fS(s)={s,0<s<1,2−s,1≤s<2,0,otherwise.f_S(s)=\begin{cases}s,&0<s<1,\\2-s,&1\le s<2,\\0,&\text{otherwise}.\end{cases}fS​(s)=⎩⎨⎧​s,2−s,0,​0<s<1,1≤s<2,otherwise.​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    f_S(s)=\begin{cases}s,&0<s<1,\\2-s,&1\le s<2,\\0,&\text{otherwise}.\end{cases}

  3. 密度曲线是总面积为 1 的三角形。例如和不超过 1/2 的概率是左侧小三角面积。

    The density is a triangle of total area one. For example, a sum at most one half corresponds to a smaller left triangle.

    P(S≤1/2)=∫01/2s ds=18P(S\le1/2)=\int_0^{1/2}s\,ds=\boxed{\frac18}P(S≤1/2)=∫01/2​sds=81​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(S\le1/2)=\int_0^{1/2}s\,ds=\boxed{\frac18}
!

变量不独立时应使用联合分布；仅知道两个边缘分布不足以决定和的分布。

Without independence, use the joint law. Marginal distributions alone do not determine the distribution of a sum.

4.5

概率生成函数

Probability generating functions

非负整数随机变量可以把所有概率打包成一个幂级数 G(z)。zᵏ 的系数就是 P(X=k)，因此生成函数是一种编码方式。它将卷积转成乘法，将递推关系转成函数方程。先注意变量必须取非负整数；一般连续随机变量不能直接套用同一幂级数解释。

For a nonnegative integer-valued variable, the probability generating function packages all probabilities into a power series. The coefficient of zᵏ is P(X=k). This encoding turns convolutions into products and recurrences into functional equations. The coefficient interpretation relies on nonnegative integer support.

GX(z)=E[zX]=∑k=0∞pkzk,pk=GX(k)(0)k!G_X(z)=E[z^X]=\sum_{k=0}^\infty p_kz^k,\qquad p_k=\frac{G_X^{(k)}(0)}{k!}GX​(z)=E[zX]=k=0∑∞​pk​zk,pk​=k!GX(k)​(0)​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
G_X(z)=E[z^X]=\sum_{k=0}^\infty p_kz^k,\qquad p_k=\frac{G_X^{(k)}(0)}{k!}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 非负整数支持使 zˣ 是普通幂级数。k 次求导后在零点代入，只有原本 zᵏ 项保留，系数变成 k!。

    Nonnegative integer support makes zˣ an ordinary power series. After k derivatives at zero, only the zᵏ term survives with factor k!.

    dkdzkzj∣z=0={k!,j=k,0,j≠k.\left.\frac{d^k}{dz^k}z^j\right|_{z=0}=\begin{cases}k!,&j=k,\\0,&j\ne k.\end{cases}dzkdk​zj​z=0​={k!,0,​j=k,j=k.​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \left.\frac{d^k}{dz^k}z^j\right|_{z=0}=\begin{cases}k!,&j=k,\\0,&j\ne k.\end{cases}

  2. 在 z=1 时，每项幂都是 1，所以 G(1)=1 检查归一化；在零点 G(0)=P(X=0)。

    At z=1 every power is one, giving the normalization check G(1)=1; at zero G(0)=P(X=0).

    G(1)=∑kpk=1,G(0)=p0G(1)=\sum_kp_k=1,\qquad G(0)=p_0G(1)=k∑​pk​=1,G(0)=p0​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    G(1)=\sum_kp_k=1,\qquad G(0)=p_0
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

若 P(X=0)=1/4、P(X=1)=1/2、P(X=2)=1/4，则 G(z)=(1+z)²/4。

If X has probabilities 1/4, 1/2, 1/4 at 0, 1, 2, then G(z)=(1+z)²/4.

  1. 分布在 0、1、2 的质量依次为 1/4、1/2、1/4，直接写出编码多项式。

    Masses at zero, one, and two are 1/4, 1/2, and 1/4. Write the encoding polynomial.

    G(z)=14+12z+14z2=(1+z)24G(z)=\frac14+\frac12z+\frac14z^2=\frac{(1+z)^2}{4}G(z)=41​+21​z+41​z2=4(1+z)2​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    G(z)=\frac14+\frac12z+\frac14z^2=\frac{(1+z)^2}{4}

  2. 若只拿到生成函数，求一阶、二阶导数并在零点读取系数。

    If given only the PGF, differentiate and evaluate at zero to recover masses.

    G′(z)=1+z2,G′′(z)=12,p2=G′′(0)2!=14G^\prime(z)=\frac{1+z}{2},\quad G^{\prime\prime}(z)=\frac12,\quad p_2=\frac{G^{\prime\prime}(0)}{2!}=\boxed{\frac14}G′(z)=21+z​,G′′(z)=21​,p2​=2!G′′(0)​=41​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    G^\prime(z)=\frac{1+z}{2},\quad G^{\prime\prime}(z)=\frac12,\quad p_2=\frac{G^{\prime\prime}(0)}{2!}=\boxed{\frac14}

  3. 检查所有系数非负且代入 1 得 1。最高次数是 2，说明不会出现大于 2 的取值。

    Check nonnegative coefficients and G(1)=1. Degree two means values above two have probability zero.

    G(1)=1,P(X>2)=0G(1)=1,\qquad P(X>2)=0G(1)=1,P(X>2)=0
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    G(1)=1,\qquad P(X>2)=0
!

生成函数不是概率密度；函数值 G(z) 一般不是事件概率。

A generating function is not a density, and G(z) is not generally an event probability.

4.6

生成函数求矩与求和

Moments and sums from a PGF

对幂级数求导，指数会被带下来。在 z=1 处，一阶导数给出期望，二阶导数给出阶乘矩 E[X(X−1)]，需要再加上 E[X] 才是二阶原点矩。独立和的生成函数是各生成函数的乘积，这使很多分布族的封闭性一眼可见。

Differentiating a PGF brings down powers. At z=1, the first derivative gives the mean and the second gives the factorial moment E[X(X−1)], not E[X²]. Add the first moment to recover E[X²]. For independent variables, the PGF of their sum is the product of their PGFs, exposing many distributional closure properties.

E[X]=G′(1),Var⁡(X)=G′′(1)+G′(1)−G′(1)2E[X]=G^\prime(1),\quad\operatorname{Var}(X)=G^{\prime\prime}(1)+G^\prime(1)-G^\prime(1)^2E[X]=G′(1),Var(X)=G′′(1)+G′(1)−G′(1)2
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
E[X]=G^\prime(1),\quad\operatorname{Var}(X)=G^{\prime\prime}(1)+G^\prime(1)-G^\prime(1)^2

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 逐项求导再令 z 接近 1，从而把幂变为 1，留下 k 或 k(k−1) 的加权和。有限相应矩保证这些结果有意义。

    Differentiate termwise and approach one, leaving weighted sums of k and k(k−1). The corresponding moments must be finite.

    G′(1)=∑kkpk,G′′(1)=∑kk(k−1)pkG^\prime(1)=\sum_kkp_k,\quad G^{\prime\prime}(1)=\sum_kk(k-1)p_kG′(1)=k∑​kpk​,G′′(1)=k∑​k(k−1)pk​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    G^\prime(1)=\sum_kkp_k,\quad G^{\prime\prime}(1)=\sum_kk(k-1)p_k

  2. 由于 X²=X(X−1)+X，二阶阶乘矩补上一阶矩才是二阶原点矩。独立和的幂可以拆成独立因子的乘积。

    Since X²=X(X−1)+X, add the first moment to the second factorial moment. For independent sums, factor the expectation of the product.

    E[zX+Y]=E[zXzY]=GX(z)GY(z)E[z^{X+Y}]=E[z^Xz^Y]=G_X(z)G_Y(z)E[zX+Y]=E[zXzY]=GX​(z)GY​(z)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[z^{X+Y}]=E[z^Xz^Y]=G_X(z)G_Y(z)
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

Bernoulli(p) 的 G(z)=1−p+pz；n 次独立相加得到 (1−p+pz)ⁿ，正是二项分布的生成函数。

A Bernoulli(p) variable has PGF 1−p+pz. The sum of n independent copies has PGF (1−p+pz)ⁿ, identifying the binomial law.

  1. 单个伯努利变量只有 0 和 1，因此其生成函数为 q+pz，其中 q=1−p。

    A Bernoulli variable takes zero and one, giving PGF q+pz with q=1−p.

    GI(z)=q+pzG_I(z)=q+pzGI​(z)=q+pz
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    G_I(z)=q+pz

  2. n 个独立变量之和，生成函数乘 n 次。分别求导到二阶。

    For the sum of n independent copies, multiply n PGFs and differentiate twice.

    GX(z)=(q+pz)n,GX′(1)=np,GX′′(1)=n(n−1)p2G_X(z)=(q+pz)^n,\quad G_X^\prime(1)=np,\quad G_X^{\prime\prime}(1)=n(n-1)p^2GX​(z)=(q+pz)n,GX′​(1)=np,GX′′​(1)=n(n−1)p2
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    G_X(z)=(q+pz)^n,\quad G_X^\prime(1)=np,\quad G_X^{\prime\prime}(1)=n(n-1)p^2

  3. 代入矩公式并化简得到二项方差，注意二阶导数本身并不是方差。

    Substitute and simplify to get binomial variance; the second derivative alone is not the variance.

    Var⁡(X)=n(n−1)p2+np−n2p2=np(1−p)\operatorname{Var}(X)=n(n-1)p^2+np-n^2p^2=\boxed{np(1-p)}Var(X)=n(n−1)p2+np−n2p2=np(1−p)​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \operatorname{Var}(X)=n(n-1)p^2+np-n^2p^2=\boxed{np(1-p)}
!

在 z=1 求导并取期望需要相应矩存在；发散的期望不能被形式运算掩盖。

Derivatives at one require the corresponding moments to exist; formal algebra cannot conceal a divergent expectation.

4.7

常见分布的生成函数与随机和

Specific PGFs and compound sums

识别标准生成函数，能迅速确定随机和的分布。固定数量独立伯努利变量相加得到二项，独立泊松变量相加参数相加，独立但成功率不同的伯努利和则称为泊松二项分布。若项目数量 N 自己也随机，每项贡献 Yᵢ 独立同分布且与 N 独立，可使用生成函数复合。

Recognizing standard PGFs quickly identifies sums. Independent Bernoulli variables with a common p sum to a binomial law; independent Poisson parameters add. Unequal Bernoulli probabilities instead produce a Poisson-binomial law. If the number N of contributions is itself random, with iid contributions independent of N, their total is described by composition of generating functions.

GS(z)=GN(GY(z)),S=∑i=1NYiG_S(z)=G_N(G_Y(z)),\quad S=\sum_{i=1}^NY_iGS​(z)=GN​(GY​(z)),S=i=1∑N​Yi​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
G_S(z)=G_N(G_Y(z)),\quad S=\sum_{i=1}^NY_i

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 给定 N=m，随机和变成固定 m 项独立和，生成函数为 G_Y(z) 的 m 次幂。

    Condition on N=m. The random sum becomes a fixed sum of m independent terms with PGF G_Y(z)^m.

    E[zS∣N=m]=GY(z)mE[z^S\mid N=m]=G_Y(z)^mE[zS∣N=m]=GY​(z)m
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[z^S\mid N=m]=G_Y(z)^m

  2. 再对 N 平均，恰好得到 N 的生成函数在 G_Y(z) 处的值。需要各贡献同分布并与 N 独立。

    Average over N to get its PGF evaluated at G_Y(z). Contributions must be iid and independent of N.

    E[zS]=∑mP(N=m)GY(z)m=GN(GY(z))E[z^S]=\sum_mP(N=m)G_Y(z)^m=G_N(G_Y(z))E[zS]=m∑​P(N=m)GY​(z)m=GN​(GY​(z))
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[z^S]=\sum_mP(N=m)G_Y(z)^m=G_N(G_Y(z))
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

每天顾客数 N∼Pois(λ)，每人独立以概率 p 购买，则购买人数的生成函数为 exp[λp(z−1)]，所以服从 Pois(λp)。

If daily customers are Poisson(λ) and each independently buys with probability p, the buyer count is Poisson(λp).

  1. 顾客数 N∼Pois(λ)，每位以概率 p 购买，令 Yᵢ 为购买指示变量。

    Let N be Poisson(λ) customers and Yᵢ indicate an independent purchase with probability p.

    GN(u)=eλ(u−1),GY(z)=1−p+pzG_N(u)=e^{\lambda(u-1)},\qquad G_Y(z)=1-p+pzGN​(u)=eλ(u−1),GY​(z)=1−p+pz
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    G_N(u)=e^{\lambda(u-1)},\qquad G_Y(z)=1-p+pz

  2. 代入复合公式，指数中的常数项相消。

    Compose the two PGFs and cancel the constants inside the exponent.

    GS(z)=exp⁡ ⁣(λ[(1−p+pz)−1])=eλp(z−1)G_S(z)=\exp\!\left(\lambda[(1-p+pz)-1]\right)=e^{\lambda p(z-1)}GS​(z)=exp(λ[(1−p+pz)−1])=eλp(z−1)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    G_S(z)=\exp\!\left(\lambda[(1-p+pz)-1]\right)=e^{\lambda p(z-1)}

  3. 识别为参数 λp 的泊松生成函数。若每天平均 10 位顾客、购买率 0.3，购买人数均值与方差都为 3。

    Recognize a Poisson(λp) PGF. With ten expected customers and purchase rate 0.3, buyer count has both mean and variance three.

    S∼Pois⁡(λp),λ=10, p=0.3⇒E[S]=Var⁡(S)=3\boxed{S\sim\operatorname{Pois}(\lambda p)},\qquad\lambda=10,\ p=0.3\Rightarrow E[S]=\operatorname{Var}(S)=3S∼Pois(λp)​,λ=10, p=0.3⇒E[S]=Var(S)=3
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \boxed{S\sim\operatorname{Pois}(\lambda p)},\qquad\lambda=10,\ p=0.3\Rightarrow E[S]=\operatorname{Var}(S)=3
!

二项和要继续是二项，通常要求相同成功概率；不能只把样本量相加。

To combine binomial counts into a binomial law, the success probabilities must match.

4.8

矩生成函数

Moment generating functions

矩生成函数 M(t)=E[eᵗˣ] 适用于更一般的实值变量。它在零点的各阶导数给出原点矩。如果 M 在零点附近某个开区间内有限，就可以用它唯一确定分布。不是每个分布都有这样的矩生成函数，即使某些甚至全部矩存在，也不能随意假定 M 存在。

The moment generating function M(t)=E[eᵗˣ] extends the transform idea to real-valued variables. Derivatives at zero give raw moments. If M is finite on an open interval around zero, it uniquely determines the distribution. Such an MGF need not exist for every distribution, even when some or all moments exist.

MX(t)=E[etX],MX(r)(0)=E[Xr]M_X(t)=E[e^{tX}],\quad M_X^{(r)}(0)=E[X^r]MX​(t)=E[etX],MX(r)​(0)=E[Xr]
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
M_X(t)=E[e^{tX}],\quad M_X^{(r)}(0)=E[X^r]

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 在零点邻域 M 有限且允许交换求导与期望时，指数函数每次求导会带下一个 X。

    When the MGF is finite near zero and differentiation may pass through expectation, each derivative contributes a factor X.

    MX(r)(t)=E[XretX]M_X^{(r)}(t)=E[X^re^{tX}]MX(r)​(t)=E[XretX]
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    M_X^{(r)}(t)=E[X^re^{tX}]

  2. 令 t=0，指数因子为 1，所以得到原点矩。存在域是定义的一部分，不能忽略积分收敛条件。

    At t=0 the exponential factor equals one, leaving a raw moment. Convergence and the domain of finiteness are part of the definition.

    MX(r)(0)=E[Xr]M_X^{(r)}(0)=E[X^r]MX(r)​(0)=E[Xr]
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    M_X^{(r)}(0)=E[X^r]
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

速率 λ 的指数分布 M(t)=λ/(λ−t)，只在 t<λ 时有限；求导得 E[X]=1/λ。

An exponential(rate λ) variable has M(t)=λ/(λ−t) for t<λ. Differentiation gives mean 1/λ.

  1. 指数密度 λe⁻λx 在 x≥0，先按定义写 MGF 积分。

    For the exponential density λe⁻λx on x≥0, write the defining MGF integral.

    M(t)=∫0∞etxλe−λx dx=λ∫0∞e−(λ−t)x dxM(t)=\int_0^\infty e^{tx}\lambda e^{-\lambda x}\,dx=\lambda\int_0^\infty e^{-(\lambda-t)x}\,dxM(t)=∫0∞​etxλe−λxdx=λ∫0∞​e−(λ−t)xdx
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    M(t)=\int_0^\infty e^{tx}\lambda e^{-\lambda x}\,dx=\lambda\int_0^\infty e^{-(\lambda-t)x}\,dx

  2. 积分只在 λ−t>0 时收敛，结果为 λ/(λ−t)。

    The integral converges only for λ−t>0, yielding λ/(λ−t).

    M(t)=λλ−t,t<λM(t)=\frac\lambda{\lambda-t},\quad t<\lambdaM(t)=λ−tλ​,t<λ
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    M(t)=\frac\lambda{\lambda-t},\quad t<\lambda

  3. 分别求一阶与二阶导数并代零，得到均值和二阶矩，进而得到方差。

    Differentiate once and twice at zero to obtain the mean and second moment, then variance.

    M′(0)=1λ,M′′(0)=2λ2,Var⁡(X)=1λ2M^\prime(0)=\frac1\lambda,\quad M^{\prime\prime}(0)=\frac2{\lambda^2},\quad\operatorname{Var}(X)=\boxed{\frac1{\lambda^2}}M′(0)=λ1​,M′′(0)=λ22​,Var(X)=λ21​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    M^\prime(0)=\frac1\lambda,\quad M^{\prime\prime}(0)=\frac2{\lambda^2},\quad\operatorname{Var}(X)=\boxed{\frac1{\lambda^2}}
!

在存在域以外代入代数表达式，不代表得到合法的期望。

Substituting outside the domain of finiteness does not produce a valid expectation.

4.9

矩生成函数的变换法则

Transformation rules for MGFs

线性变换的 MGF 只需重新缩放自变量并乘以一个指数因子。独立和的 MGF 相乘；如果辨认出乘积属于某个已知分布，就得到和的精确分布。取对数得到累积量生成函数，独立和的累积量因而直接相加，前两项就是均值与方差。

An affine transformation rescales the MGF argument and adds an exponential factor. MGFs multiply for independent sums. Recognizing the resulting product identifies an exact sum distribution. Taking logarithms yields the cumulant generating function, making cumulants additive under independence; its first two derivatives are the mean and variance.

MaX+b(t)=ebtMX(at),KX(t)=log⁡MX(t)M_{aX+b}(t)=e^{bt}M_X(at),\quad K_X(t)=\log M_X(t)MaX+b​(t)=ebtMX​(at),KX​(t)=logMX​(t)
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
M_{aX+b}(t)=e^{bt}M_X(at),\quad K_X(t)=\log M_X(t)

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 把 aX+b 代入指数，利用指数相乘与常数可提出期望，得到线性变换规则。

    Substitute aX+b into the exponential and factor out the constant exponential.

    E[et(aX+b)]=ebtE[eatX]=ebtMX(at)E[e^{t(aX+b)}]=e^{bt}E[e^{atX}]=e^{bt}M_X(at)E[et(aX+b)]=ebtE[eatX]=ebtMX​(at)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[e^{t(aX+b)}]=e^{bt}E[e^{atX}]=e^{bt}M_X(at)

  2. 独立和的 MGF 相乘，取对数后相加；对数一、二阶导数分别给出均值与方差。

    MGFs of independent sums multiply; their logarithms add. The first two log derivatives give the mean and variance.

    K′(0)=M′(0),K′′(0)=M′′(0)−M′(0)2K^\prime(0)=M^\prime(0),\quad K^{\prime\prime}(0)=M^{\prime\prime}(0)-M^\prime(0)^2K′(0)=M′(0),K′′(0)=M′′(0)−M′(0)2
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    K^\prime(0)=M^\prime(0),\quad K^{\prime\prime}(0)=M^{\prime\prime}(0)-M^\prime(0)^2
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

若 X∼N(2,3²)，Y=4X−1，则 Y∼N(7,12²)。

If X is normal with mean 2 and standard deviation 3, then 4X−1 is normal with mean 7 and standard deviation 12.

  1. X∼N(2,9)，因此其 MGF 为 exp(2t+9t²/2)。要求 Y=4X−1 的分布。

    For X normal with mean two and variance nine, M_X(t)=exp(2t+9t²/2). Find the law of Y=4X−1.

    MX(t)=e2t+9t2/2M_X(t)=e^{2t+9t^2/2}MX​(t)=e2t+9t2/2
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    M_X(t)=e^{2t+9t^2/2}

  2. 使用变换公式，先乘 e⁻ᵗ，再将自变量替换为 4t。

    Multiply by e⁻ᵗ and replace the argument by 4t.

    MY(t)=e−tMX(4t)=e−t+8t+144t2/2=e7t+144t2/2M_Y(t)=e^{-t}M_X(4t)=e^{-t+8t+144t^2/2}=e^{7t+144t^2/2}MY​(t)=e−tMX​(4t)=e−t+8t+144t2/2=e7t+144t2/2
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    M_Y(t)=e^{-t}M_X(4t)=e^{-t+8t+144t^2/2}=e^{7t+144t^2/2}

  3. 与正态 MGF 的标准形式比较，均值为 7，方差为 144，标准差是 12。

    Compare with the normal MGF: the mean is seven, variance 144, and standard deviation twelve.

    Y∼N(7,144)\boxed{Y\sim N(7,144)}Y∼N(7,144)​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \boxed{Y\sim N(7,144)}
!

MGF 相乘对应独立和，相关变量不能只拿各自 MGF 相乘。

The product rule describes independent sums; correlated variables require their joint structure.

4.10

常见独立和的精确分布

Exact distributions of familiar sums

有些分布族在独立求和下保持形式：正态加正态仍为正态，泊松加泊松仍为泊松，同速率伽马相加仍为伽马。均值总能相加，方差在独立时相加。正态总体的样本均值仍然精确正态，样本量不大时也成立；这与中心极限定理的渐近近似不同。

Several families are closed under independent addition: normals, Poissons, and gammas sharing a rate. Means add generally; variances add under independence. A sample mean from a normal population is exactly normal for any sample size. This is an exact result, unlike the asymptotic approximation supplied by the central limit theorem.

∑iXi∼N ⁣(∑iμi,∑iσi2)for independent normal Xi\sum_iX_i\sim N\!\left(\sum_i\mu_i,\sum_i\sigma_i^2\right)\quad\text{for independent normal }X_ii∑​Xi​∼N(i∑​μi​,i∑​σi2​)for independent normal Xi​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
\sum_iX_i\sim N\!\left(\sum_i\mu_i,\sum_i\sigma_i^2\right)\quad\text{for independent normal }X_i

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 独立正态变量的 MGF 相乘，指数里的线性项与二次项分别相加，因此仍是正态 MGF。

    Multiply independent normal MGFs. Their linear and quadratic exponent terms add, retaining the normal form.

    ∏ieμit+σi2t2/2=et∑iμi+(t2/2)∑iσi2\prod_i e^{\mu_it+\sigma_i^2t^2/2}=e^{t\sum_i\mu_i+(t^2/2)\sum_i\sigma_i^2}i∏​eμi​t+σi2​t2/2=et∑i​μi​+(t2/2)∑i​σi2​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \prod_i e^{\mu_it+\sigma_i^2t^2/2}=e^{t\sum_i\mu_i+(t^2/2)\sum_i\sigma_i^2}

  2. 均值再除以 n，用线性变换规则，方差要除以 n²，得到样本均值的精确分布。

    Divide the sum by n and apply affine scaling. The variance divides by n², yielding the exact sample-mean law.

    Xi∼iidN(μ,σ2)⟹X‾∼N(μ,σ2/n)X_i\overset{\rm iid}{\sim}N(\mu,\sigma^2)\Longrightarrow\overline X\sim N(\mu,\sigma^2/n)Xi​∼iidN(μ,σ2)⟹X∼N(μ,σ2/n)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    X_i\overset{\rm iid}{\sim}N(\mu,\sigma^2)\Longrightarrow\overline X\sim N(\mu,\sigma^2/n)
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

独立测量误差各为 N(0,4)，16 次平均误差为 N(0,1/4)，标准差从 2 降到 0.5。

Averaging sixteen independent N(0,4) errors gives N(0,1/4), reducing standard deviation from two to one half.

  1. 16 次独立误差，每次 N(0,4)。先求总误差 S 的分布。

    Take sixteen independent N(0,4) errors. Find the distribution of their sum S first.

    S=∑i=116Xi∼N(0,16⋅4)=N(0,64)S=\sum_{i=1}^{16}X_i\sim N(0,16\cdot4)=N(0,64)S=i=1∑16​Xi​∼N(0,16⋅4)=N(0,64)

    The average is S/16, so divide the mean by sixteen and variance by sixteen squared.

伽马分布相加的速率必须一致；正态变量相加也要说明独立或给出协方差。

Gamma rate parameters must match. Normal sums also require independence or an explicit covariance structure.

4.11

中心极限定理

The central limit theorem

独立同分布、有限均值和正方差的样本，在样本量趋于无穷时，标准化样本均值趋近标准正态。定理近似的是总和或均值的分布，不是说原始数据会变正态。偏斜、厚尾与所考察的尾部位置会影响需要多大的样本量，不能把某个固定 n 当作万能门槛。

For iid observations with finite mean and positive finite variance, the standardized sample mean converges in distribution to a standard normal. The theorem concerns sums or means; it does not make the raw observations normal. Skewness, tail behavior, and the probability region of interest affect the sample size needed for an accurate approximation.

Zn=n(X‾−μ)σ ⇒ N(0,1)Z_n=\frac{\sqrt n(\overline X-\mu)}{\sigma}\ \Rightarrow\ N(0,1)Zn​=σn​(X−μ)​ ⇒ N(0,1)
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
Z_n=\frac{\sqrt n(\overline X-\mu)}{\sigma}\ \Rightarrow\ N(0,1)

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 设 iid 样本有有限均值 μ 和正的有限方差 σ²，先把每一项标准化。有限二阶矩使其特征函数在零点有二阶展开。

    For iid observations with finite mean and positive finite variance, standardize each term. Its characteristic function has a second-order expansion at zero.

    Yi=Xi−μσ,E[Yi]=0,E[Yi2]=1,φY(u)=1−u22+o(u2)Y_i=\frac{X_i-\mu}{\sigma},\quad E[Y_i]=0,\quad E[Y_i^2]=1,\quad\varphi_Y(u)=1-\frac{u^2}{2}+o(u^2)Yi​=σXi​−μ​,E[Yi​]=0,E[Yi2​]=1,φY​(u)=1−2u2​+o(u2)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    Y_i=\frac{X_i-\mu}{\sigma},\quad E[Y_i]=0,\quad E[Y_i^2]=1,\quad\varphi_Y(u)=1-\frac{u^2}{2}+o(u^2)

  2. 利用独立性，标准化和的特征函数是单项特征函数在 t/√n 处的 n 次幂。取对数并用 log(1+v)=v+o(v)。

    Independence gives the nth power of the individual characteristic function at t/√n. Take logarithms and use log(1+v)=v+o(v).

    φZn(t)=[1−t22n+o(n−1)]n⟶e−t2/2\varphi_{Z_n}(t)=\left[1-\frac{t^2}{2n}+o(n^{-1})\right]^n\longrightarrow e^{-t^2/2}φZn​​(t)=[1−2nt2​+o(n−1)]n⟶e−t2/2
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \varphi_{Z_n}(t)=\left[1-\frac{t^2}{2n}+o(n^{-1})\right]^n\longrightarrow e^{-t^2/2}

  3. 极限是标准正态特征函数。由特征函数的连续性定理推出分布收敛。有限 n 的正态概率仍是近似，不是等号。

    The limit is the standard-normal characteristic function. The continuity theorem yields convergence in distribution. Normal probabilities for a finite n remain approximations.

    X1+⋯+Xn−nμσn⇒N(0,1)\frac{X_1+\cdots+X_n-n\mu}{\sigma\sqrt n}\Rightarrow N(0,1)σn​X1​+⋯+Xn​−nμ​⇒N(0,1)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \frac{X_1+\cdots+X_n-n\mu}{\sigma\sqrt n}\Rightarrow N(0,1)

For exponential observations with mean and standard deviation two, the mean of one hundred has standard error 0.2, giving P(X̄≤2.4)≈Φ(2).

Infinite-variance laws and strongly dependent samples fall outside this stated version.

4.12

弱大数定律

The weak law of large numbers

大数定律说明平均值在概率意义上接近真实期望；中心极限定理进一步描述误差的形状与尺度。有限方差下，可由切比雪夫不等式直接证明弱大数定律。它保证的是偏差超过固定阈值的概率趋于零，而不是每一条样本路径都单调接近期望。

The law of large numbers says an average becomes close to its expectation in probability. The CLT further describes the shape and scale of fluctuations. With finite variance, Chebyshev’s inequality proves the weak law directly. The guarantee is that the probability of a fixed-size error vanishes, not that every observed running average approaches its limit monotonically.

P(∣X‾−μ∣≥ε)≤σ2nε2⟶0P(|\overline X-\mu|\ge\varepsilon)\le\frac{\sigma^2}{n\varepsilon^2}\longrightarrow0P(∣X−μ∣≥ε)≤nε2σ2​⟶0
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
P(|\overline X-\mu|\ge\varepsilon)\le\frac{\sigma^2}{n\varepsilon^2}\longrightarrow0

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. iid 且方差有限时，样本均值的期望为 μ，方差为 σ²/n。将切比雪夫不等式应用于这个随机变量。

    For iid finite-variance observations, the sample mean has mean μ and variance σ²/n. Apply Chebyshev to that random variable.

    P(∣X‾−μ∣≥ε)≤Var⁡(X‾)ε2P(|\overline X-\mu|\ge\varepsilon)\le\frac{\operatorname{Var}(\overline X)}{\varepsilon^2}P(∣X−μ∣≥ε)≤ε2Var(X)​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

  2. 固定任意正的 ε，分母 n 越来越大，因此右侧趋于零。这正是依概率收敛的定义。

    For every fixed positive ε, the bound tends to zero as n grows. This is exactly convergence in probability.

    ∀ε>0:P(∣X‾−μ∣≥ε)→0\forall\varepsilon>0:\quad P(|\overline X-\mu|\ge\varepsilon)\to0∀ε>0:P(∣X−μ∣≥ε)→0
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

A fair-coin head proportion approaches one half, yet the next toss may move it farther away. The absolute head–tail count difference need not approach zero.

大数定律不补偿过去的结果；独立试验没有“追平历史”的机制。

The law does not compensate for past results; independent trials have no mechanism for correcting history.

4.13

样本方差的抽样分布

The sampling distribution of sample variance

样本方差用 n−1 作为分母，是因为先用同一份数据估计了均值，残差之和被约束为零。对独立正态样本，缩放后的样本方差精确服从 n−1 自由度的卡方分布，而且与样本均值独立。这种独立性是正态样本的特殊性质，不应推广到任意总体。

The sample variance divides by n−1 because estimating the mean imposes a zero-sum constraint on residuals. For an independent normal sample, the scaled variance is exactly chi-square with n−1 degrees of freedom and is independent of the sample mean. This independence is special to normal sampling and is not universal.

(n−1)S2σ2∼χn−12,S2=∑i(Xi−X‾)2n−1\frac{(n-1)S^2}{\sigma^2}\sim\chi^2_{n-1},\quad S^2=\frac{\sum_i(X_i-\overline X)^2}{n-1}σ2(n−1)S2​∼χn−12​,S2=n−1∑i​(Xi​−X)2​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
\frac{(n-1)S^2}{\sigma^2}\sim\chi^2_{n-1},\quad S^2=\frac{\sum_i(X_i-\overline X)^2}{n-1}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 用真实均值中心化的平方和，可分解成围绕样本均值的残差平方和，加上均值偏离项。交叉项因残差和为零而消失。

    The squared deviations from the true mean split into residual variation around the sample mean and a mean-deviation term. The cross term vanishes because residuals sum to zero.

    ∑i(Xi−μ)2=∑i(Xi−X‾)2+n(X‾−μ)2\sum_i(X_i-\mu)^2=\sum_i(X_i-\overline X)^2+n(\overline X-\mu)^2i∑​(Xi​−μ)2=i∑​(Xi​−X)2+n(X−μ)2
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \sum_i(X_i-\mu)^2=\sum_i(X_i-\overline X)^2+n(\overline X-\mu)^2

  2. 在 iid 正态条件下，正交分解让残差方向与均值方向独立。标准化后的残差平方和是 n−1 个独立标准正态的平方和。

    For iid normal data, an orthogonal decomposition makes residual directions independent of the mean direction. The standardized residual sum is a sum of n−1 independent squared standard normals.

    ∑i(Xi−X‾)2σ2∼χn−12,E[S2]=σ2\frac{\sum_i(X_i-\overline X)^2}{\sigma^2}\sim\chi^2_{n-1},\qquad E[S^2]=\sigma^2σ2∑i​(Xi​−X)2​∼χn−12​,E[S2]=σ2
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \frac{\sum_i(X_i-\overline X)^2}{\sigma^2}\sim\chi^2_{n-1},\qquad E[S^2]=\sigma^2

正态样本 n=10，观测 s²=4。检验总体方差是否为 2 时，统计量为 9×4/2=18，应与 χ²₉ 比较。

For n=10 normal observations with s²=4, testing a population variance of two uses statistic 18 compared with χ²₉.

  1. n=10，s²=4，检验零假设 σ²=2。先确定自由度为 9。

    With n=10 and s²=4, test σ²=2. The degrees of freedom are nine.

    ν=n−1=9\nu=n-1=9ν=n−1=9
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \nu=n-1=9

  2. 代入卡方枢轴量，得到统计量 18。

    Substitute into the chi-square pivot to obtain eighteen.

    Q=9⋅42=18Q=\frac{9\cdot4}{2}=\boxed{18}Q=29⋅4​=18​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    Q=\frac{9\cdot4}{2}=\boxed{18}

    For a 5% two-sided test, compare with the 2.5% and 97.5% χ²₉ quantiles. Eighteen lies inside approximately [2.700,19.023], so do not reject; this does not prove variance two.

    2.700<18<19.023⟹do not reject at α=0.052.700<18<19.023\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\text{do not reject at }\alpha=0.052.700<18<19.023⟹do not reject at α=0.05

卡方方差区间通常不对称；不要按正态区间机械地写成估计值加减同一个数。

Chi-square variance intervals are generally asymmetric and are not a simple estimate plus or minus one common margin.

4.14

单总体均值：检验与区间

Inference for one population mean

总体标准差已知且样本均值正态时使用 Z；总体标准差未知，独立正态样本使用 t 分布，自由度 n−1。t 分布通过较厚的尾部表达估计 σ 引入的额外不确定性。双侧区间和双侧检验相互对应：某个零假设均值不在区间内，就会被相同水平的检验拒绝。

Use a Z statistic when the population standard deviation is known and the mean is normal. With unknown standard deviation and iid normal data, use Student’s t with n−1 degrees of freedom. Its heavier tails account for estimating σ. A two-sided confidence interval and the corresponding two-sided test agree about which null means to reject.

T=X‾−μS/n∼tn−1,CI: x‾±t1−α/2,n−1snT=\frac{\overline X-\mu}{S/\sqrt n}\sim t_{n-1},\quad\mathrm{CI}:\ \overline x\pm t_{1-\alpha/2,n-1}\frac{s}{\sqrt n}T=S/n​X−μ​∼tn−1​,CI: x±t1−α/2,n−1​n​s​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
T=\frac{\overline X-\mu}{S/\sqrt n}\sim t_{n-1},\quad\mathrm{CI}:\ \overline x\pm t_{1-\alpha/2,n-1}\frac{s}{\sqrt n}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

    For an iid normal sample, the standardized mean is Z∼N(0,1), independent of the standardized variance U∼χ²ₙ₋₁. Their ratio defines Student’s t.

    T=ZU/(n−1)=X‾−μS/nT=\frac{Z}{\sqrt{U/(n-1)}}=\frac{\overline X-\mu}{S/\sqrt n}T=U/(n−1)​Z​=S/n​X−μ​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

    For a two-sided critical value t*, the event −t*≤T≤t* has probability 1−α. Solve the inequalities for μ.

    P ⁣(X‾−t∗Sn≤μ≤X‾+t∗Sn)=1−αP\!\left(\overline X-t^*\frac S{\sqrt n}\le\mu\le\overline X+t^*\frac S{\sqrt n}\right)=1-\alphaP(X−t∗n​S​≤μ≤X+t∗n​S​)=1−α

4.15

两组样本的比较

Comparing two samples

比较两组均值时，先确定两组独立还是配对。独立样本的均值差方差等于两个均值方差之和；未知且不假设相同方差时可用 Welch 方法。配对数据应先计算每一对的差，再对差做单样本 t 推断。F 检验比较正态总体方差，但对偏离正态较敏感。

First decide whether two samples are independent or paired. Independent mean differences have variance equal to the sum of the mean variances. Welch inference avoids assuming equal unknown variances. For paired observations, analyze within-pair differences with a one-sample procedure. An F ratio compares normal-population variances but is sensitive to nonnormality.

TW=X‾1−X‾2−δ0S12/n1+S22/n2T_W=\frac{\overline X_1-\overline X_2-\delta_0}{\sqrt{S_1^2/n_1+S_2^2/n_2}}TW​=S12​/n1​+S22​/n2​​X1​−X2​−δ0​​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
T_W=\frac{\overline X_1-\overline X_2-\delta_0}{\sqrt{S_1^2/n_1+S_2^2/n_2}}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 两组独立时，均值差的方差是两个均值方差之和。用各自样本方差估计，即得到 Welch 分母。

    For independent groups, the variance of their mean difference is the sum of their mean variances. Estimate each separately for the Welch denominator.

    Var⁡(X‾1−X‾2)=σ12n1+σ22n2\operatorname{Var}(\overline X_1-\overline X_2)=\frac{\sigma_1^2}{n_1}+\frac{\sigma_2^2}{n_2}Var(X1​−X2​)=n1​σ12​​+n2​σ22​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \operatorname{Var}(\overline X_1-\overline X_2)=\frac{\sigma_1^2}{n_1}+\frac{\sigma_2^2}{n_2}

  2. 配对时应先作差，差的方差包含协方差项。正相关配对可降低差的方差，因此不能直接当作独立两组。

    For paired data, form differences first. Their variance contains covariance; positive pairing correlation can reduce it, so an independent-groups analysis discards information.

    Di=Yi−Xi,Var⁡(D)=σY2+σX2−2Cov⁡(X,Y)D_i=Y_i-X_i,\quad\operatorname{Var}(D)=\sigma_Y^2+\sigma_X^2-2\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)Di​=Yi​−Xi​,Var(D)=σY2​+σX2​−2Cov(X,Y)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    D_i=Y_i-X_i,\quad\operatorname{Var}(D)=\sigma_Y^2+\sigma_X^2-2\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)

4.16

最小二乘线性回归

Least-squares linear regression

简单线性回归用直线表示给定 x 时 Y 的条件均值。最小二乘选择截距与斜率，使残差平方和最小。斜率描述 x 增加一个单位时平均响应的变化。对系数进行经典 t、F 推断还需要误差模型，例如独立、相同方差和正态误差；计算拟合线本身不需要正态性。

Simple linear regression models the conditional mean of Y as a straight line in x. Least squares chooses intercept and slope to minimize squared residuals. The slope describes the change in mean response per unit of x. Classical t and F inference needs additional error assumptions such as independence, constant variance, and normality; computing the fitted line itself does not require normal errors.

4.17

均值控制图

Control charts for a process mean

控制图利用稳定过程下统计量的波动范围监测过程变化。每次取一个大小为 n 的子组，画出子组均值；已知稳定中心 μ 与标准差 σ 时，可用 μ±3σ/√n 作为三西格玛界限。控制限描述过程行为，规格限则由产品要求决定，两者不是同一对象。

A control chart monitors departures from the variation expected in a stable process. Plot successive subgroup means of size n. If the stable mean and standard deviation are known, three-sigma limits are μ±3σ/√n. Control limits describe process behavior; specification limits describe product requirements and answer a different question.

UCL=μ+3σn,CL=μ,LCL=μ−3σn\mathrm{UCL}=\mu+3\frac\sigma{\sqrt n},\quad\mathrm{CL}=\mu,\quad\mathrm{LCL}=\mu-3\frac\sigma{\sqrt n}UCL=μ+3n​σ​,CL=μ,LCL=μ−3n​σ​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
\mathrm{UCL}=\mu+3\frac\sigma{\sqrt n},\quad\mathrm{CL}=\mu,\quad\mathrm{LCL}=\mu-3\frac\sigma{\sqrt n}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 稳定过程且子组内独立时，每个子组均值的标准差为 σ/√n。正态条件下，标准化均值超出 ±3 的概率约 0.0027。

    For a stable process with independent observations within each subgroup, subgroup means have SD σ/√n. Under normality, standardized means exceed ±3 with probability about 0.0027.

    P ⁣(∣X‾−μ∣>3σn)=2[1−Φ(3)]P\!\left(|\overline X-\mu|>3\frac\sigma{\sqrt n}\right)=2[1-\Phi(3)]P(∣X−μ∣>3n​σ​)=2[1−Φ(3)]

    Convert three standard errors back to original units. Across m independent subgroups, the probability of at least one false signal accumulates.

    P(at least one false signal)=1−(1−0.0027)mP(\text{at least one false signal})=1-(1-0.0027)^mP(at least one false signal)=1−(1−0.0027)m
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(\text{at least one false signal})=1-(1-0.0027)^m

CHAPTER 05

二维概率分布

Bivariate probability distributions

同时描述两个随机量，区分边缘、条件与联合关系，理解协方差和变量变换。

Describe two variables together and distinguish marginal, conditional, and joint behavior.

5.1

从一个变量到两个变量

From one variable to two

单个变量的分布只能描述它自身的行为，无法回答两个变量是否一同变大。联合分布保留变量间的依赖关系。在平面中，事件成为区域，连续概率对应区域上的二重积分。建立模型时需要同时写出支持区域与密度；一个简单公式配上不同区域会给出不同分布。

A univariate distribution describes one variable but cannot tell whether two variables tend to rise together. A joint distribution retains their dependence. Events become regions in the plane, with continuous probabilities given by double integrals. Specify both the density and its support: the same algebraic formula on a different region defines a different model.

FX,Y(x,y)=P(X≤x,Y≤y),P((X,Y)∈A)=∬Af(x,y) dx dyF_{X,Y}(x,y)=P(X\le x,Y\le y),\quad P((X,Y)\in A)=\iint_Af(x,y)\,dx\,dyFX,Y​(x,y)=P(X≤x,Y≤y),P((X,Y)∈A)=∬A​f(x,y)dxdy
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
F_{X,Y}(x,y)=P(X\le x,Y\le y),\quad P((X,Y)\in A)=\iint_Af(x,y)\,dx\,dy

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 联合密度把平面上的微小面积 dxdy 赋予约 f(x,y)dxdy 的概率。把区域分成小块相加，极限给出二重积分。

    A small area dxdy carries approximately f(x,y)dxdy probability. Sum over a partition of the region and pass to the limit for a double integral.

    P((X,Y)∈A)=lim⁡∑i,jf(xi,yj)ΔxiΔyjP((X,Y)\in A)=\lim\sum_{i,j}f(x_i,y_j)\Delta x_i\Delta y_jP((X,Y)∈A)=limi,j∑​f(xi​,yj​)Δxi​Δyj​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P((X,Y)\in A)=\lim\sum_{i,j}f(x_i,y_j)\Delta x_i\Delta y_j

  2. 整个支持区域积分应为 1；一维累计概率推广为左下矩形内的二重累计。

    The density integrates to one over its support. A joint CDF accumulates over a lower-left rectangle.

    FX,Y(x,y)=∫−∞x∫−∞yf(u,v) dv duF_{X,Y}(x,y)=\int_{-\infty}^x\int_{-\infty}^y f(u,v)\,dv\,duFX,Y​(x,y)=∫−∞x​∫−∞y​f(u,v)dvdu
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    F_{X,Y}(x,y)=\int_{-\infty}^x\int_{-\infty}^y f(u,v)\,dv\,du

在单位正方形内均匀取点时，f(x,y)=1。点位于三角区域 x+y≤1 的概率等于三角形面积 1/2。

A point uniformly sampled from the unit square has joint density one. The probability x+y≤1 is the triangular area 1/2.

  1. 单位正方形内均匀，联合密度为 1。要求 x+y≤1，与原支持相交后形成三角形。

    The unit square has uniform joint density one. Intersect x+y≤1 with the support to form a triangle.

    0<x<1,0<y<1−x0<x<1,\qquad0<y<1-x0<x<1,0<y<1−x
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    0<x<1,\qquad0<y<1-x

    Fix x and integrate y from zero to 1−x to obtain the vertical strip length.

    ∫01−x1 dy=1−x\int_0^{1-x}1\,dy=1-x∫01−x​1dy=1−x
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \int_0^{1-x}1\,dy=1-x

    Integrate x from zero to one; the result equals the triangle’s area.

    P(X+Y≤1)=∫01(1−x) dx=12P(X+Y\le1)=\int_0^1(1-x)\,dx=\boxed{\frac12}P(X+Y≤1)=∫01​(1−x)dx=21​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

!

两个边缘分布相同，不代表联合分布相同。

Identical marginals do not imply identical joint distributions.

5.2

联合分布与边缘分布

Joint and marginal distributions

边缘分布通过把另一个变量的所有可能值合并得到。离散型对联合概率求和，连续型对联合密度积分。如果联合函数在整个支持上能分解为两个边缘函数的乘积，则变量独立。仅在某些点看到乘积关系，或者仅检验均值与协方差，不足以证明独立。

Marginalization eliminates the other variable by summing or integrating over all of its values. Independence holds when the joint law factorizes into the two marginal laws over the full support. Checking a few points or checking only means and covariance is insufficient.

fX(x)=∫−∞∞f(x,y) dy,fY(y)=∫−∞∞f(x,y) dxf_X(x)=\int_{-\infty}^\infty f(x,y)\,dy,\quad f_Y(y)=\int_{-\infty}^\infty f(x,y)\,dxfX​(x)=∫−∞∞​f(x,y)dy,fY​(y)=∫−∞∞​f(x,y)dx
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
f_X(x)=\int_{-\infty}^\infty f(x,y)\,dy,\quad f_Y(y)=\int_{-\infty}^\infty f(x,y)\,dx

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 只问 X 落在哪个区间时，Y 的所有可能值都要包含。因此先把联合密度沿 y 方向累加，得到边缘密度。

    If only X is constrained, include every possible Y. Integrating the joint density along y produces the marginal.

    P(a<X<b)=∫ab[∫f(x,y) dy]dxP(a<X<b)=\int_a^b\left[\int f(x,y)\,dy\right]dxP(a<X<b)=∫ab​[∫f(x,y)dy]dx
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(a<X<b)=\int_a^b\left[\int f(x,y)\,dy\right]dx

  2. 独立意味着每个矩形事件概率分解；有密度时等价于联合密度几乎处处为边缘密度乘积。只比均值不足以检验这个条件。

    Independence factorizes probabilities for every rectangle; with densities it is equivalent to factorization almost everywhere, not merely matching moments.

    f(x,y)=fX(x)fY(y)a.e.f(x,y)=f_X(x)f_Y(y)\quad\text{a.e.}f(x,y)=fX​(x)fY​(y)a.e.
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    f(x,y)=f_X(x)f_Y(y)\quad\text{a.e.}

For density two on 0<x<y<1, the marginals are 2(1−x) and 2y. The triangular support prevents independence.

  1. 取 f=2，支持为 0<x<y<1。固定 x 时，y 必须从 x 积到 1。

    Take density two on 0<x<y<1. With x fixed, y ranges from x to one.

    fX(x)=∫x12 dy=2(1−x),0<x<1f_X(x)=\int_x^1 2\,dy=\boxed{2(1-x)},\quad0<x<1fX​(x)=∫x1​2dy=2(1−x)​,0<x<1

    With y fixed, x ranges from zero to y.

    fY(y)=∫0y2 dx=2y,0<y<1f_Y(y)=\int_0^y2\,dx=\boxed{2y},\quad0<y<1fY​(y)=∫0y​2dx=2y​,0<y<1
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

    Both marginals are positive where 0<y<x<1, but the joint density is zero there. Factorization fails.

    fX(x)fY(y)=4y(1−x)>0≠f(x,y)=0(0<y<x<1)f_X(x)f_Y(y)=4y(1-x)>0\ne f(x,y)=0\quad(0<y<x<1)fX​(x)fY​(y)=4y(1−x)>0=f(x,y)=0(0<y<x<1)

积分界限来自支持集；在 y>x 的模型中不能总是把 y 从 0 积到 1。

Read integration limits from the support; a restriction y>x must remain in the calculation.

5.3

条件分布与条件密度

Conditional distributions and densities

联合密度除以条件变量的边缘密度，得到固定条件下的分布。在连续模型中，事件 Y=y 的概率为零，条件密度仍有意义；它由联合分布的局部比例定义，不能直接按两个零概率相除。求出的条件密度应在自己的支持上积分为 1。

Divide the joint density by the conditioning variable’s marginal density to obtain a conditional law. Although P(Y=y)=0 for a continuous variable, conditional densities remain meaningful through the local structure of the joint distribution. They are not ratios of two zero point probabilities. Verify that each conditional density integrates to one on its conditional support.

fX∣Y(x∣y)=f(x,y)fY(y),fY(y)>0f_{X\mid Y}(x\mid y)=\frac{f(x,y)}{f_Y(y)},\quad f_Y(y)>0fX∣Y​(x∣y)=fY​(y)f(x,y)​,fY​(y)>0
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
f_{X\mid Y}(x\mid y)=\frac{f(x,y)}{f_Y(y)},\quad f_Y(y)>0

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 条件密度应使联合密度等于“条件密度×条件变量的边缘密度”，对应离散乘法公式的密度版本。

    A conditional density must factor the joint density into a conditional density times the conditioning marginal, paralleling the discrete multiplication rule.

    f(x,y)=fX∣Y(x∣y)fY(y)f(x,y)=f_{X\mid Y}(x\mid y)f_Y(y)f(x,y)=fX∣Y​(x∣y)fY​(y)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    f(x,y)=f_{X\mid Y}(x\mid y)f_Y(y)

  2. 对 x 积分验证归一化：分子积分正好是分母。连续情形并非计算 P(X=x,Y=y)/P(Y=y) 的零除零。

    Integrating over x normalizes it because the numerator integrates to the denominator. This is not a ratio of zero point probabilities.

    ∫fX∣Y(x∣y) dx=∫f(x,y) dxfY(y)=1\int f_{X\mid Y}(x\mid y)\,dx=\frac{\int f(x,y)\,dx}{f_Y(y)}=1∫fX∣Y​(x∣y)dx=fY​(y)∫f(x,y)dx​=1
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \int f_{X\mid Y}(x\mid y)\,dx=\frac{\int f(x,y)\,dx}{f_Y(y)}=1
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

三角模型 f=2、0<x<y<1 中，给定 Y=y 后 X 在 (0,y) 上均匀，因此条件均值为 y/2。

In the triangular model, conditioning on Y=y makes X uniform on (0,y), with conditional mean y/2.

  1. 三角模型中 f_Y(y)=2y，且 0<y<1。固定 y 后，X 的支持为 (0,y)。

    In the triangular model f_Y(y)=2y for 0<y<1. Conditional support for X is (0,y).

    fX∣Y(x∣y)=22y=1y,0<x<yf_{X\mid Y}(x\mid y)=\frac2{2y}=\frac1y,\quad0<x<yfX∣Y​(x∣y)=2y2​=y1​,0<x<y
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    f_{X\mid Y}(x\mid y)=\frac2{2y}=\frac1y,\quad0<x<y

  2. 条件密度是常数，故为 U(0,y)。也可直接积分条件均值。

    The constant conditional density is uniform on (0,y). Integrate to obtain its mean.

    E[X∣Y=y]=∫0yx1y dx=y2E[X\mid Y=y]=\int_0^y x\frac1y\,dx=\boxed{\frac y2}E[X∣Y=y]=∫0y​xy1​dx=2y​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[X\mid Y=y]=\int_0^y x\frac1y\,dx=\boxed{\frac y2}

  3. 例如给定 Y=0.8，条件均值为 0.4，且 X≤0.2 的条件概率为区间长度比例。

    For Y=0.8 the conditional mean is 0.4, and the chance X≤0.2 is an interval-length ratio.

    P(X≤0.2∣Y=0.8)=∫00.210.8 dx=14P(X\le0.2\mid Y=0.8)=\int_0^{0.2}\frac1{0.8}\,dx=\boxed{\frac14}P(X≤0.2∣Y=0.8)=∫00.2​0.81​dx=41​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(X\le0.2\mid Y=0.8)=\int_0^{0.2}\frac1{0.8}\,dx=\boxed{\frac14}
!

条件密度的支持通常随条件值变化，不能只除一个常数而忽略区间。

A conditional support often changes with the conditioning value; do not ignore its limits.

5.4

协方差与相关系数

Covariance and correlation

协方差是两个中心化变量乘积的期望，描述线性同向变化。相关系数除以两个标准差后消去单位，范围为 [−1,1]。相关为零只表示无线性关联，非线性依赖仍可能很强。独立且二阶矩有限时协方差为零，逆命题通常不成立。

Covariance is the expected product of centered variables and measures linear co-movement. Dividing by both standard deviations produces a unitless correlation in [−1,1]. Zero correlation rules out linear association, not nonlinear dependence. Independence with finite second moments implies zero covariance, but the converse generally fails.

Cov⁡(X,Y)=E[XY]−E[X]E[Y],ρ=Cov⁡(X,Y)σXσY\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)=E[XY]-E[X]E[Y],\quad\rho=\frac{\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)}{\sigma_X\sigma_Y}Cov(X,Y)=E[XY]−E[X]E[Y],ρ=σX​σY​Cov(X,Y)​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)=E[XY]-E[X]E[Y],\quad\rho=\frac{\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)}{\sigma_X\sigma_Y}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 展开中心化乘积，利用期望线性性得到协方差公式。再展开 (X+Y−E[X+Y])² 得方差相加时的交叉项。

    Expand the centered product and use linearity. Expanding the squared centered sum gives its covariance cross-term.

    Var⁡(X+Y)=Var⁡(X)+Var⁡(Y)+2Cov⁡(X,Y)\operatorname{Var}(X+Y)=\operatorname{Var}(X)+\operatorname{Var}(Y)+2\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)Var(X+Y)=Var(X)+Var(Y)+2Cov(X,Y)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \operatorname{Var}(X+Y)=\operatorname{Var}(X)+\operatorname{Var}(Y)+2\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)

  2. 柯西–施瓦茨不等式约束中心化乘积的期望，除以两个正标准差后得到相关系数绝对值不超过 1。

    Cauchy–Schwarz bounds the centered product expectation; divide by positive standard deviations to bound correlation.

    ∣E[(X−μX)(Y−μY)]∣≤σXσY⟹∣ρ∣≤1|E[(X-\mu_X)(Y-\mu_Y)]|\le\sigma_X\sigma_Y\quad\Longrightarrow\quad|\rho|\le1∣E[(X−μX​)(Y−μY​)]∣≤σX​σY​⟹∣ρ∣≤1
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    |E[(X-\mu_X)(Y-\mu_Y)]|\le\sigma_X\sigma_Y\quad\Longrightarrow\quad|\rho|\le1
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

X∼U(−1,1)，令 Y=X²。对称性使 Cov(X,Y)=0，但知道 X 就完全知道 Y，因此显然不独立。

If X is uniform on (−1,1) and Y=X², covariance is zero by symmetry, yet Y is completely determined by X.

  1. X∼U(−1,1)，Y=X²。对称区间上的奇函数积分为零，所以 E[X]=0、E[X³]=0。

    For X uniform on (−1,1) and Y=X², odd-function integrals over the symmetric interval vanish.

    E[X]=0,E[Y]=E[X2]=13,E[XY]=E[X3]=0E[X]=0,\quad E[Y]=E[X^2]=\frac13,\quad E[XY]=E[X^3]=0E[X]=0,E[Y]=E[X2]=31​,E[XY]=E[X3]=0
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[X]=0,\quad E[Y]=E[X^2]=\frac13,\quad E[XY]=E[X^3]=0

  2. 代入协方差公式得到 0；两变量都不是常数，因此相关系数也为 0。

    Substitution gives zero covariance; both variances are positive, so correlation is zero too.

    Cov⁡(X,Y)=0−0⋅13=0,ρ=0\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)=0-0\cdot\frac13=0,\quad\rho=0Cov(X,Y)=0−0⋅31​=0,ρ=0
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \operatorname{Cov}(X,Y)=0-0\cdot\frac13=0,\quad\rho=0

  3. 但 Y≤1/4 等价于 |X|≤1/2。给定这个 X 事件后，该 Y 事件概率是 1，而其原概率只有 1/2，故不独立。

    Yet Y≤1/4 is equivalent to |X|≤1/2. Conditioning on that X event makes the Y event certain, unlike its original probability one half.

    P(Y≤1/4)=12,P(Y≤1/4∣∣X∣≤1/2)=1P(Y\le1/4)=\frac12,\quad P(Y\le1/4\mid |X|\le1/2)=1P(Y≤1/4)=21​,P(Y≤1/4∣∣X∣≤1/2)=1
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(Y\le1/4)=\frac12,\quad P(Y\le1/4\mid |X|\le1/2)=1
!

常数变量的标准差为零，它与其他变量的相关系数未定义。

A constant variable has zero standard deviation, so its correlation with another variable is undefined.

5.5

条件期望与全方差

Conditional expectation and total variance

条件期望先在每个已知条件下求平均，再把结果视为条件变量的函数。再次取期望就回到总体均值，这是塔式法则。全方差把总波动分成组内波动与组间均值的波动。这个分解既能简化计算，也能解释混合群体为何表现出比单一群体更大的变化。

Conditional expectation averages within a given condition and becomes a function of the conditioning variable. Averaging it again recovers the unconditional mean, the tower property. Total variance splits variability into within-condition variance and between-condition variation in conditional means. This explains why heterogeneous mixtures can vary more than their component groups.

E[X]=E[E[X∣Y]],Var⁡(X)=E[Var⁡(X∣Y)]+Var⁡(E[X∣Y])E[X]=E[E[X\mid Y]],\quad\operatorname{Var}(X)=E[\operatorname{Var}(X\mid Y)]+\operatorname{Var}(E[X\mid Y])E[X]=E[E[X∣Y]],Var(X)=E[Var(X∣Y)]+Var(E[X∣Y])
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
E[X]=E[E[X\mid Y]],\quad\operatorname{Var}(X)=E[\operatorname{Var}(X\mid Y)]+\operatorname{Var}(E[X\mid Y])

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 条件期望对 y 再加权，联合密度中的边缘因子恢复原联合密度，交换可积函数的积分次序就回到 E[X]。

    Average the conditional mean over y. Multiplying by its marginal restores the joint density, and exchanging integrals recovers E[X].

    E[E[X∣Y]]=∬xf(x,y) dx dy=E[X]E[E[X\mid Y]]=\iint x f(x,y)\,dx\,dy=E[X]E[E[X∣Y]]=∬xf(x,y)dxdy=E[X]
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[E[X\mid Y]]=\iint x f(x,y)\,dx\,dy=E[X]

  2. 令 m(Y)=E[X|Y]。将 X−μ 拆为 X−m(Y) 与 m(Y)−μ，两项乘积的条件期望为零。

    Let m(Y)=E[X|Y]. Split X−μ into X−m(Y) and m(Y)−μ; their cross-product has zero conditional expectation.

    E[(X−m(Y))(m(Y)−μ)]=0E[(X-m(Y))(m(Y)-\mu)]=0E[(X−m(Y))(m(Y)−μ)]=0
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[(X-m(Y))(m(Y)-\mu)]=0

  3. 平方取期望，剩下的两项分别是组内方差平均和组间均值方差。

    Square and average; the remaining terms are expected within-group variance and between-group mean variance.

    E[(X−μ)2]=E[(X−m(Y))2]+E[(m(Y)−μ)2]E[(X-\mu)^2]=E[(X-m(Y))^2]+E[(m(Y)-\mu)^2]E[(X−μ)2]=E[(X−m(Y))2]+E[(m(Y)−μ)2]
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[(X-\mu)^2]=E[(X-m(Y))^2]+E[(m(Y)-\mu)^2]
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

若 N 是随机顾客数，每位独立消费 Yᵢ 且与 N 独立，则总额 S 的均值为 E[N]E[Y]，方差为 E[N]Var(Y)+Var(N)E[Y]²。

For an independent random customer count N and iid spending amounts Yᵢ, total spending has mean E[N]E[Y] and variance E[N]Var(Y)+Var(N)E[Y]².

  1. 设顾客数 N 与 iid 消费 Yᵢ 独立，单人消费均值 μ、方差 σ²。给定 N=m，消费总额是固定 m 项和。

    Let N be independent of iid spending Yᵢ with mean μ and variance σ². Given N=m, total spending is a fixed sum.

    E[S∣N]=Nμ,Var⁡(S∣N)=Nσ2E[S\mid N]=N\mu,\qquad\operatorname{Var}(S\mid N)=N\sigma^2E[S∣N]=Nμ,Var(S∣N)=Nσ2
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[S\mid N]=N\mu,\qquad\operatorname{Var}(S\mid N)=N\sigma^2

  2. 全期望给出总额均值；全方差把人数不确定性额外引入一个 μ²Var(N) 项。

    Total expectation gives the mean; total variance adds the customer-count uncertainty term μ²Var(N).

    E[S]=μE[N],Var⁡(S)=σ2E[N]+μ2Var⁡(N)E[S]=\mu E[N],\quad\operatorname{Var}(S)=\sigma^2E[N]+\mu^2\operatorname{Var}(N)E[S]=μE[N],Var(S)=σ2E[N]+μ2Var(N)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[S]=\mu E[N],\quad\operatorname{Var}(S)=\sigma^2E[N]+\mu^2\operatorname{Var}(N)

  3. 例如 N∼Pois(10)，消费均值 20、标准差 5，代入得均值 200、方差 4250。只算 10×25 会遗漏人数波动。

    For Poisson(10) customers with spending mean twenty and SD five, the total mean is 200 and variance 4250. Using only 10×25 misses count variation.

    E[S]=200,Var⁡(S)=10(25)+10(400)=4250E[S]=\boxed{200},\qquad\operatorname{Var}(S)=10(25)+10(400)=\boxed{4250}E[S]=200​,Var(S)=10(25)+10(400)=4250​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[S]=\boxed{200},\qquad\operatorname{Var}(S)=10(25)+10(400)=\boxed{4250}
!

Var(E[X|Y]) 不是 E[Var(X|Y)]；二者表示不同来源的变动。

Variance of a conditional mean and mean conditional variance describe different sources of variation.

5.6

二维正态分布

The bivariate normal distribution

二维正态模型由两个均值、两个方差和一个相关系数确定，等密度线通常为椭圆。在非退化模型中，条件分布仍正态，条件均值是已知变量的线性函数，条件方差不依赖具体条件值。二维联合正态是一个重要特例：相关为零可以推出独立。

A bivariate normal model is specified by two means, two variances, and one correlation. Its density contours are ellipses. In the nondegenerate case, a conditional distribution remains normal, with a linear conditional mean and a conditional variance independent of the observed conditioning value. Joint normality is an important special case where zero correlation implies independence.

Y∣X=x∼N ⁣(μY+ρσYσX(x−μX), σY2(1−ρ2))Y\mid X=x\sim N\!\left(\mu_Y+\rho\frac{\sigma_Y}{\sigma_X}(x-\mu_X),\ \sigma_Y^2(1-\rho^2)\right)Y∣X=x∼N(μY​+ρσX​σY​​(x−μX​), σY2​(1−ρ2))
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
Y\mid X=x\sim N\!\left(\mu_Y+\rho\frac{\sigma_Y}{\sigma_X}(x-\mu_X),\ \sigma_Y^2(1-\rho^2)\right)

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 先标准化 U=(X−μ_X)/σ_X、V=(Y−μ_Y)/σ_Y。二维正态指数中的二次式可对 v 配方。

    Standardize both variables. Complete the square in v inside the bivariate normal exponent.

    u2−2ρuv+v2=(v−ρu)2+(1−ρ2)u2u^2-2\rho uv+v^2=(v-\rho u)^2+(1-\rho^2)u^2u2−2ρuv+v2=(v−ρu)2+(1−ρ2)u2
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    u^2-2\rho uv+v^2=(v-\rho u)^2+(1-\rho^2)u^2

  2. 固定 u 后，第二项只参与归一化。余下部分是均值 ρu、方差 1−ρ² 的正态核，再换回 Y 的单位。

    At fixed u the second term only affects normalization. The remaining normal kernel has mean ρu and variance 1−ρ²; rescale to Y.

    V∣U=u∼N(ρu,1−ρ2),∣ρ∣<1V\mid U=u\sim N(\rho u,1-\rho^2),\quad |\rho|<1V∣U=u∼N(ρu,1−ρ2),∣ρ∣<1
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    V\mid U=u\sim N(\rho u,1-\rho^2),\quad |\rho|<1
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

μ_X=μ_Y=0、σ_X=σ_Y=1、ρ=0.6，给定 X=2 后，Y 的均值为 1.2，方差为 0.64。

For standardized jointly normal variables with correlation 0.6, conditioning on X=2 gives Y mean 1.2 and variance 0.64.

  1. 两个变量均为标准化正态，相关为 0.6，给定 X=2；因此 u=2。

    Both variables are standardized normal with correlation 0.6. Conditioning on X=2 gives u=2.

    μX=μY=0,σX=σY=1,ρ=0.6\mu_X=\mu_Y=0,\quad\sigma_X=\sigma_Y=1,\quad\rho=0.6μX​=μY​=0,σX​=σY​=1,ρ=0.6
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \mu_X=\mu_Y=0,\quad\sigma_X=\sigma_Y=1,\quad\rho=0.6

  2. 条件均值为 0.6×2，条件方差为 1−0.6²。

    The conditional mean is 0.6×2 and variance 1−0.6².

    E[Y∣X=2]=1.2,Var⁡(Y∣X=2)=0.64E[Y\mid X=2]=\boxed{1.2},\quad\operatorname{Var}(Y\mid X=2)=\boxed{0.64}E[Y∣X=2]=1.2​,Var(Y∣X=2)=0.64​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[Y\mid X=2]=\boxed{1.2},\quad\operatorname{Var}(Y\mid X=2)=\boxed{0.64}

  3. 条件标准差为 0.8。再问 Y≤2，只需在这个条件正态内标准化，而不是继续按原均值零计算。

    The conditional SD is 0.8. To find P(Y≤2|X=2), standardize within this conditional law, not the original marginal.

    P(Y≤2∣X=2)=Φ ⁣(2−1.20.8)=Φ(1)≈0.841345P(Y\le2\mid X=2)=\Phi\!\left(\frac{2-1.2}{0.8}\right)=\Phi(1)\approx0.841345P(Y≤2∣X=2)=Φ(0.82−1.2​)=Φ(1)≈0.841345
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(Y\le2\mid X=2)=\Phi\!\left(\frac{2-1.2}{0.8}\right)=\Phi(1)\approx0.841345
!

各自边缘正态并不自动意味着联合正态。

Normal marginal distributions do not automatically establish joint normality.

5.7

二维变换与雅可比

Bivariate transformations and the Jacobian

把 (X,Y) 变为 (U,V)，需要追踪面积如何变化。若变换一一对应，联合密度乘以反变换雅可比行列式的绝对值。若只是求和或比值，可以引入一个辅助变量形成二维变换，再把辅助变量积分掉。多对一变换需要按分支相加。

A transformation from (X,Y) to (U,V) changes area. For a one-to-one smooth transformation, multiply by the absolute determinant of the inverse Jacobian. To find a sum or ratio distribution, add a convenient auxiliary variable, transform jointly, and integrate it out. Multiple inverse branches require summing their contributions.

fU,V(u,v)=fX,Y(x(u,v),y(u,v))∣∂(x,y)∂(u,v)∣f_{U,V}(u,v)=f_{X,Y}(x(u,v),y(u,v))\left|\frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(u,v)}\right|fU,V​(u,v)=fX,Y​(x(u,v),y(u,v))​∂(u,v)∂(x,y)​​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
f_{U,V}(u,v)=f_{X,Y}(x(u,v),y(u,v))\left|\frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(u,v)}\right|

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 同一块区域变换前后的概率必须相同。反变换把新面积 dudv 放大或缩小为 |J|dudv，因此密度乘以 |J|。

    Probability is preserved by a change of coordinates. The inverse map changes area dudv into |J|dudv, so the density receives that factor.

    fU,V(u,v) du dv=fX,Y(x,y) dx dyf_{U,V}(u,v)\,du\,dv=f_{X,Y}(x,y)\,dx\,dyfU,V​(u,v)dudv=fX,Y​(x,y)dxdy
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    f_{U,V}(u,v)\,du\,dv=f_{X,Y}(x,y)\,dx\,dy

  2. 反变换必须在所用区域一一对应。遇到多分支，分开变换后相加；新支持集也由反变换确定。

    The inverse must be one-to-one on the region used. Handle multiple branches separately and add them; transform the support as well.

    J=det⁡(∂x/∂u∂x/∂v∂y/∂u∂y/∂v)J=\det\begin{pmatrix}\partial x/\partial u&\partial x/\partial v\\\partial y/\partial u&\partial y/\partial v\end{pmatrix}J=det(∂x/∂u∂y/∂u​∂x/∂v∂y/∂v​)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    J=\det\begin{pmatrix}\partial x/\partial u&\partial x/\partial v\\\partial y/\partial u&\partial y/\partial v\end{pmatrix}
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

极坐标 x=r cosθ、y=r sinθ 的面积元素是 r dr dθ；这个 r 是雅可比，不可省略。

The polar transformation x=r cosθ, y=r sinθ has area element r dr dθ. The factor r is the Jacobian and cannot be omitted.

  1. 极坐标反变换 x=r cosθ、y=r sinθ。写出对 r、θ 的偏导矩阵。

    For polar coordinates x=r cosθ and y=r sinθ, write the derivative matrix in r and θ.

    ∂(x,y)∂(r,θ)=(cos⁡θ−rsin⁡θsin⁡θrcos⁡θ)\frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(r,\theta)}=\begin{pmatrix}\cos\theta&-r\sin\theta\\\sin\theta&r\cos\theta\end{pmatrix}∂(r,θ)∂(x,y)​=(cosθsinθ​−rsinθrcosθ​)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \frac{\partial(x,y)}{\partial(r,\theta)}=\begin{pmatrix}\cos\theta&-r\sin\theta\\\sin\theta&r\cos\theta\end{pmatrix}

  2. 行列式为 r(cos²θ+sin²θ)=r。r≥0，所以绝对值仍为 r。

    The determinant is r(cos²θ+sin²θ)=r. For r≥0 its absolute value is r.

    ∣J∣=r,dx dy=r dr dθ|J|=r,\qquad dx\,dy=r\,dr\,d\theta∣J∣=r,dxdy=rdrdθ
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    |J|=r,\qquad dx\,dy=r\,dr\,d\theta

  3. 以单位圆内均匀点为例，原密度为 1/π。积分消去 θ 后，半径密度为 2r，而不是均匀密度。

    For a uniform point in the unit disk, the original density is 1/π. Integrating out θ gives radial density 2r, not a uniform radius.

    fR(r)=∫02πrπ dθ=2r,0<r<1f_R(r)=\int_0^{2\pi}\frac r\pi\,d\theta=\boxed{2r},\quad0<r<1fR​(r)=∫02π​πr​dθ=2r​,0<r<1
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    f_R(r)=\int_0^{2\pi}\frac r\pi\,d\theta=\boxed{2r},\quad0<r<1
!

密度变换要用反变换雅可比；同时给出变换后的支持集。

Use the inverse transformation’s Jacobian and specify the transformed support.

CHAPTER 06

递推与马尔可夫链

Recurrences and Markov chains

用“下一步会怎样”建立方程，解决等待时间、随机游走和长期状态问题。

Use first-step reasoning to solve waiting times, random walks, and long-run state behavior.

6.1

第一步分析

First-step analysis

复杂随机过程常可在走出第一步后变成较小的同类问题。选择能概括未来所需信息的状态，再对第一步的结果分类。概率方程不增加时间，期望等待时间方程通常先加 1。递推式还必须配合起始条件或边界条件，否则一般不能唯一确定答案。

A complicated random process often becomes the same kind of problem after its first step. Choose a state containing the information needed for the future, then condition on the first transition. Probability recurrences do not add elapsed time; expected hitting-time recurrences usually add one. Initial or boundary conditions are essential for a unique solution.

u(i)=∑jPiju(j),m(i)=1+∑jPijm(j)u(i)=\sum_jP_{ij}u(j),\quad m(i)=1+\sum_jP_{ij}m(j)u(i)=j∑​Pij​u(j),m(i)=1+j∑​Pij​m(j)

    Condition on the next state j. A success probability has no elapsed-time term; weight future success by each first-step probability.

    A hitting time uses one step before the remaining wait from the new state. Remaining time at the target is zero; solve with these boundary values.

若每次以概率 p 完成任务，否则重新开始，m=1+(1−p)m，所以 m=1/p。

If each attempt finishes a task with probability p and otherwise restarts, m=1+(1−p)m, giving m=1/p.

Too little state information loses dependence; too much makes the model unnecessarily large.

6.2

递推关系的解法

Solving recurrences

一阶线性递推 aₙ=c+raₙ₋₁，可先求不动点 L=c/(1−r)，再分析与 L 的偏差。偏差按 r 的幂变化，因此 |r|<1 时趋于稳定，负 r 还会交替振荡。高阶常系数递推可尝试指数形式 λⁿ，得到特征方程，并由初值确定系数。

For a first-order linear recurrence aₙ=c+raₙ₋₁, first find the fixed point L=c/(1−r). Deviations from L follow powers of r. Thus |r|<1 gives convergence, with alternating deviations when r is negative. Higher-order constant-coefficient recurrences use exponential trial solutions and a characteristic equation; initial conditions determine coefficients.

an=L+(a1−L)rn−1,L=c1−r,an=c+ran−1a_n=L+(a_1-L)r^{n-1},\quad L=\frac c{1-r},\quad a_n=c+ra_{n-1}an​=L+(a1​−L)rn−1,L=1−rc​,an​=c+ran−1​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
a_n=L+(a_1-L)r^{n-1},\quad L=\frac c{1-r},\quad a_n=c+ra_{n-1}

    Find the fixed point L=c+rL. Subtract it to remove the constant term.

    an−L=r(an−1−L)a_n-L=r(a_{n-1}-L)an​−L=r(an−1​−L)

6.3

随机游走与破产问题

Random walks and gambler’s ruin

资本每次独立增加 1 或减少 1，直到达到 0 或 N，形成有限区间上的随机游走。令 uᵢ 是从 i 出发先到 N 的概率，则它满足相邻状态的加权平均方程。公平时解是直线 i/N；不公平时是等比形式。边界大小与初始位置和单次胜率一样重要。

A fortune that independently rises or falls by one until reaching zero or N is a random walk with absorbing boundaries. Let uᵢ be the probability of reaching N first from i. It satisfies a weighted average of neighboring values. In the fair case the solution is linear; in the biased case it is geometric. Initial position and boundary distance matter alongside the single-step win probability.

ui=1−(q/p)i1−(q/p)N (p≠q),ui=iN (p=q),q=1−pu_i=\frac{1-(q/p)^i}{1-(q/p)^N}\ (p\ne q),\quad u_i=\frac iN\ (p=q),\quad q=1-pui​=1−(q/p)N1−(q/p)i​ (p=q),ui​=Ni​ (p=q),q=1−p
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
u_i=\frac{1-(q/p)^i}{1-(q/p)^N}\ (p\ne q),\quad u_i=\frac iN\ (p=q),\quad q=1-p

    Condition on the first win or loss, with boundary probabilities zero and one. Try uᵢ=rⁱ to obtain a characteristic equation.

    ui=pui+1+qui−1,pr2−r+q=0,r∈{1,q/p}u_i=pu_{i+1}+qu_{i-1},\quad pr^2-r+q=0,\quad r\in\{1,q/p\}ui​=pui+1​+qui−1​,pr2−r+q=0,r∈{1,q/p}

    Fair absorption times satisfy mᵢ=1+(mᵢ₊₁+mᵢ₋₁)/2. Verify the quadratic i(N−i) and its zero boundary values.

6.4

等待指定模式

Waiting for specified patterns

等待一串正反面时，状态应记录当前序列末尾与目标前缀的最长匹配。失败不一定回到零：某些后缀仍可作为下一次尝试的开头。这种重叠结构解释了不同等长模式为何平均等待时间不同。用每个部分匹配状态的剩余期望，建立小型线性方程组即可。

When waiting for a coin pattern, track the longest suffix of the current sequence that matches a prefix of the target. A failed completion need not reset all progress; a useful suffix may remain. Such overlaps explain why equally long patterns have different expected waits. Assign an expected remaining time to each partial-match state and solve the resulting linear system.

6.5

马尔可夫链与长期分布

Markov chains and long-run distributions

马尔可夫性质表示给定当前状态后，下一步分布不再依赖更早历史。转移矩阵每行非负且和为 1；采用行概率向量时，下一步是 πP，n 步使用 Pⁿ。平稳分布满足 π=πP，但“存在平稳分布”和“每个初始状态都收敛到它”是不同结论。有限不可约非周期链具备后者。

The Markov property says the next-state distribution depends on the present state, not earlier history once the present is known. A transition matrix has nonnegative rows summing to one. With row probability vectors, evolution is πP and n-step evolution uses Pⁿ. A stationary distribution solves π=πP, but stationarity alone does not ensure convergence from every starting state. Finite irreducible aperiodic chains do converge.

πn+1=πnP,π=πP,∑iπi=1\pi_{n+1}=\pi_nP,\quad\pi=\pi P,\quad\sum_i\pi_i=1πn+1​=πn​P,π=πP,i∑​πi​=1
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
\pi_{n+1}=\pi_nP,\quad\pi=\pi P,\quad\sum_i\pi_i=1

  1. 按当前状态分类，用全概率公式求下一步概率。将这些方程排成行向量形式，就是 πₙ₊₁=πₙP。

    Condition on the current state and apply total probability to the next-state probability. Collect equations into row-vector form.

    P(Xn+1=j)=∑iP(Xn=i)PijP(X_{n+1}=j)=\sum_iP(X_n=i)P_{ij}P(Xn+1​=j)=i∑​P(Xn​=i)Pij​

    Stationarity means one transition leaves the law unchanged. Solve π=πP with normalization; convergence needs additional conditions such as irreducibility and aperiodicity.

CHAPTER 07

挑战问题与计算思维

Challenging problems and computational thinking

把计数、等待时间、递推与统计诊断结合起来，检查直觉并验证计算。

Combine counting, waiting times, recurrences, and statistical diagnostics to test intuition and verify calculations.

7.1

抽袜子与首次配对

Socks and the first matching pair

抽屉有 n 双互不混色的袜子，每种颜色恰有两只，随机不放回抽取，直到第一次配成一双。设 T 为抽取数，范围为 2 到 n+1。求 T 的分布时，先求前 k 只都不成对的概率：从 n 个颜色选 k 个，再从每个颜色选一只，除以全部 k 只子集数。

A drawer contains n pairs, with two socks of each distinct color. Draw uniformly without replacement until the first pair appears. The draw count T ranges from two to n+1. Start with its survival probability: to have no pair among k socks, choose k colors and one of the two socks in each, then divide by all k-sock subsets.

Sk=P(T>k)=2k(nk)(2nk),P(T=t)=St−1t−12n−t+1S_k=P(T>k)=\frac{2^k\binom nk}{\binom{2n}k},\quad P(T=t)=S_{t-1}\frac{t-1}{2n-t+1}Sk​=P(T>k)=(k2n​)2k(kn​)​,P(T=t)=St−1​2n−t+1t−1​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
S_k=P(T>k)=\frac{2^k\binom nk}{\binom{2n}k},\quad P(T=t)=S_{t-1}\frac{t-1}{2n-t+1}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 前 k 只没有配对，必须来自 k 个不同颜色。先选颜色，再从每种颜色的两只里任选一只；总样本是所有 k 只袜子的无序子集。

    No pair among k draws requires k distinct colors. Choose those colors, then one of two socks of each color; divide by all k-sock subsets.

    #no-pair subsets=(nk)2k,Sk=2k(nk)(2nk)\#\text{no-pair subsets}=\binom nk2^k,\quad S_k=\frac{2^k\binom nk}{\binom{2n}k}#no-pair subsets=(kn​)2k,Sk​=(k2n​)2k(kn​)​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \#\text{no-pair subsets}=\binom nk2^k,\quad S_k=\frac{2^k\binom nk}{\binom{2n}k}

  2. 若前 t−1 只都不配对，剩余 2n−t+1 只中恰有 t−1 只可与已有袜子配对。乘条件概率即可。

    Given no pair in t−1 draws, exactly t−1 of the remaining 2n−t+1 socks match an already drawn sock. Multiply by that conditional probability.

    P(T=t)=P(T>t−1)P(T=t∣T>t−1)P(T=t)=P(T>t-1)P(T=t\mid T>t-1)P(T=t)=P(T>t−1)P(T=t∣T>t−1)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(T=t)=P(T>t-1)P(T=t\mid T>t-1)
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

n=3 时，T=2、3、4 的概率分别为 1/5、2/5、2/5。前两只不配对的概率为 4/5。

For three pairs, probabilities for T=2,3,4 are 1/5,2/5,2/5. The first two socks fail to match with probability 4/5.

  1. n=3，6 只袜子。从第二次抽取开始计算，首次配对不可能早于 2，也不可能晚于 4。

    For three pairs, T ranges from two to four: a pair cannot occur on the first draw, and four socks must contain a pair.

    T∈{2,3,4},S1=1T\in\{2,3,4\},\quad S_1=1T∈{2,3,4},S1​=1
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    T\in\{2,3,4\},\quad S_1=1

  2. T=2 时，第一只任意，余下五只中一只匹配。T=3 时，前两只不匹配概率 4/5，再从四只中抽中两只匹配者之一。

    At T=2 one of five remaining socks matches. At T=3 the first two fail to match with probability 4/5, then two of four remaining socks match.

    P(T=2)=15,P(T=3)=4524=25P(T=2)=\frac15,\quad P(T=3)=\frac45\frac24=\frac25P(T=2)=51​,P(T=3)=54​42​=52​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(T=2)=\frac15,\quad P(T=3)=\frac45\frac24=\frac25

  3. 前 3 只都不同色的概率为 (4/5)(2/4)=2/5，此时下一只一定配对，因此最后概率为 2/5。三项和为 1。

    Three distinct colors occur with probability (4/5)(2/4)=2/5. The next sock must match, giving the remaining mass.

    P(T=4)=4524⋅1=25,15+25+25=1P(T=4)=\frac45\frac24\cdot1=\boxed{\frac25},\quad\frac15+\frac25+\frac25=1P(T=4)=54​42​⋅1=52​​,51​+52​+52​=1
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(T=4)=\frac45\frac24\cdot1=\boxed{\frac25},\quad\frac15+\frac25+\frac25=1
!

虽然每种颜色有两只，但 T 不服从固定成功概率的几何分布。

T is not geometric: the chance of matching changes as unmatched colors accumulate.

7.2

用尾和求平均配对时间

Mean pairing time from survival probabilities

非负整数等待时间的期望可通过尾概率求和。这通常比逐项乘 t 再求和更简洁。对袜子模型，尾和还能化成一个中心二项系数的倒数。使用斯特林近似可看到平均等待时间按 √n 增长，这与生日碰撞问题具有相似的平方根尺度。

For a nonnegative integer waiting time, summing survival probabilities gives the expectation. This is often simpler than weighting each mass by t. In the socks model, the sum simplifies to a ratio involving the central binomial coefficient. Stirling’s approximation reveals growth on a square-root scale, echoing the birthday collision phenomenon.

E[T]=∑k=0nSk=4n(2nn)∼πnE[T]=\sum_{k=0}^nS_k=\frac{4^n}{\binom{2n}n}\sim\sqrt{\pi n}E[T]=k=0∑n​Sk​=(n2n​)4n​∼πn​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
E[T]=\sum_{k=0}^nS_k=\frac{4^n}{\binom{2n}n}\sim\sqrt{\pi n}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 对每个正整数 t，t 等于从 k=0 到 t−1 的指示数之和。交换有限求和与期望，得到尾和公式。

    For each positive integer t, sum indicators over k=0,…,t−1. Interchange the finite sum and expectation for the survival-sum identity.

    T=∑k=0n1{T>k}⟹E[T]=∑k=0nSkT=\sum_{k=0}^n\mathbf1_{\{T>k\}}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad E[T]=\sum_{k=0}^nS_kT=k=0∑n​1{T>k}​⟹E[T]=k=0∑n​Sk​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    T=\sum_{k=0}^n\mathbf1_{\{T>k\}}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad E[T]=\sum_{k=0}^nS_k

  2. 将 S_k 的阶乘形式代入并令 j=n−k，把求和化为以下二项系数和。

    Insert the factorial expression for S_k and substitute j=n−k to obtain a finite binomial sum.

    ∑k=0nSk=2n(n!)2(2n)!∑j=0n(n+jj)2−j\sum_{k=0}^nS_k=\frac{2^n(n!)^2}{(2n)!}\sum_{j=0}^n\binom{n+j}{j}2^{-j}k=0∑n​Sk​=(2n)!2n(n!)2​j=0∑n​(jn+j​)2−j
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \sum_{k=0}^nS_k=\frac{2^n(n!)^2}{(2n)!}\sum_{j=0}^n\binom{n+j}{j}2^{-j}

  3. 公平硬币中，“第 n+1 个正面先于第 n+1 个反面”由对称性概率为 1/2。按最终前有 j 个反面分类，其概率为 C(n+j,j)/2ⁿ⁺ʲ⁺¹，因此求和项等于 2ⁿ，证明精确期望。

    By symmetry, the (n+1)st head precedes the (n+1)st tail with probability one half. If j tails precede the final head, its probability is C(n+j,j)/2ⁿ⁺ʲ⁺¹, proving the needed identity.

    ∑j=0n(n+jj)2n+j+1=12⟹E[T]=4n(2nn)\sum_{j=0}^n\frac{\binom{n+j}{j}}{2^{n+j+1}}=\frac12\quad\Longrightarrow\quad E[T]=\frac{4^n}{\binom{2n}n}j=0∑n​2n+j+1(jn+j​)​=21​⟹E[T]=(n2n​)4n​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \sum_{j=0}^n\frac{\binom{n+j}{j}}{2^{n+j+1}}=\frac12\quad\Longrightarrow\quad E[T]=\frac{4^n}{\binom{2n}n}
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

n=7，E[T]=4⁷/C(14,7)=2048/429≈4.7739。n=100 时约为 17.747。

With seven pairs the mean is 2048/429≈4.7739; with one hundred pairs it is about 17.747.

  1. n=7，先算中心二项系数 C(14,7)=3432，分子 4⁷=16384。

    For n=7, compute C(14,7)=3432 and 4⁷=16384.

    E[T]=163843432E[T]=\frac{16384}{3432}E[T]=343216384​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[T]=\frac{16384}{3432}

  2. 约分得到 2048/429，约为 4.773893 次。这是平均抽取数，不是最可能抽取数。

    Reduce to 2048/429, approximately 4.773893 draws. A mean is not necessarily the most likely count.

    E[T]=2048429≈4.773893\boxed{E[T]=\frac{2048}{429}\approx4.773893}E[T]=4292048​≈4.773893​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \boxed{E[T]=\frac{2048}{429}\approx4.773893}

  3. 若 n=100，直接公式得约 17.747。斯特林展开给 √(πn)[1+1/(8n)+O(n⁻²)]，解释平方根尺度并提供更好近似。

    For n=100 the exact formula gives about 17.747. Stirling’s expansion explains the square-root scale and improves the approximation.

    4n(2nn)=πn(1+18n+O(n−2))\frac{4^n}{\binom{2n}n}=\sqrt{\pi n}\left(1+\frac1{8n}+O(n^{-2})\right)(n2n​)4n​=πn​(1+8n1​+O(n−2))
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \frac{4^n}{\binom{2n}n}=\sqrt{\pi n}\left(1+\frac1{8n}+O(n^{-2})\right)
!

√(πn) 是渐近近似，不是有限 n 下的精确值。

√(πn) is asymptotic, not an exact finite-n identity.

7.3

配对时间的方差

Variance of the pairing time

只有均值不足以描述等待时间的稳定程度。对正整数 T，把 t² 展开为前 t 个奇数之和，可将二阶矩也写成尾和。由同一组 S_k 就能同时计算均值、二阶矩和方差，无需调用复杂特殊函数。数值实现时需要足够精度，避免两个接近的大数相减导致损失。

A mean alone does not describe waiting-time variability. Since t² is the sum of the first t odd numbers, the second moment also has a survival-sum representation. The same survival probabilities give the mean, second moment, and variance without special functions. Numerical implementations should guard against precision loss when subtracting nearby large quantities.

E[T2]=∑k=0n(2k+1)Sk,Var⁡(T)=E[T2]−E[T]2E[T^2]=\sum_{k=0}^n(2k+1)S_k,\quad\operatorname{Var}(T)=E[T^2]-E[T]^2E[T2]=k=0∑n​(2k+1)Sk​,Var(T)=E[T2]−E[T]2
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
E[T^2]=\sum_{k=0}^n(2k+1)S_k,\quad\operatorname{Var}(T)=E[T^2]-E[T]^2

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 平方 t² 等于前 t 个奇数之和，因此可以像上一节一样把二阶矩写成带权指示变量和。

    A square t² is the sum of the first t odd numbers. Use weighted indicators as in the previous section.

    t2=∑k=0t−1(2k+1),T2=∑k=0n(2k+1)1{T>k}t^2=\sum_{k=0}^{t-1}(2k+1),\quad T^2=\sum_{k=0}^n(2k+1)\mathbf1_{\{T>k\}}t2=k=0∑t−1​(2k+1),T2=k=0∑n​(2k+1)1{T>k}​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    t^2=\sum_{k=0}^{t-1}(2k+1),\quad T^2=\sum_{k=0}^n(2k+1)\mathbf1_{\{T>k\}}

  2. 取期望得到二阶尾和，再扣除均值平方。袜子问题的等待时间有有限上界，所以所有交换都是有限求和。

    Take expectations for the second-moment survival sum, then subtract the squared mean. All sums are finite because the waiting time is bounded.

    E[T2]=∑k=0n(2k+1)P(T>k)E[T^2]=\sum_{k=0}^n(2k+1)P(T>k)E[T2]=k=0∑n​(2k+1)P(T>k)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[T^2]=\sum_{k=0}^n(2k+1)P(T>k)
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

三双袜子时 E[T]=16/5，E[T²]=54/5，因此 Var(T)=54/5−(16/5)²=14/25。

For three pairs, E[T]=16/5 and E[T²]=54/5, giving variance 14/25.

  1. 三双袜子的完整分布已知：T=2、3、4 对应概率 1/5、2/5、2/5。先算均值。

    For three pairs, T=2,3,4 has probabilities 1/5,2/5,2/5. Compute its mean.

    E[T]=215+325+425=165E[T]=2\frac15+3\frac25+4\frac25=\frac{16}{5}E[T]=251​+352​+452​=516​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[T]=2\frac15+3\frac25+4\frac25=\frac{16}{5}

  2. 将取值平方后加权，得到二阶矩 54/5。

    Square the values before weighting to obtain the second moment.

    E[T2]=415+925+1625=545E[T^2]=4\frac15+9\frac25+16\frac25=\frac{54}{5}E[T2]=451​+952​+1652​=554​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[T^2]=4\frac15+9\frac25+16\frac25=\frac{54}{5}

  3. 扣除均值平方，得到方差 14/25 和标准差 √14/5。方差单位是抽取次数的平方。

    Subtract the squared mean for variance 14/25 and SD √14/5. Variance is in squared draw-count units.

    Var⁡(T)=545−25625=1425,SD⁡(T)=145\operatorname{Var}(T)=\frac{54}{5}-\frac{256}{25}=\boxed{\frac{14}{25}},\quad\operatorname{SD}(T)=\frac{\sqrt{14}}5Var(T)=554​−25256​=2514​​,SD(T)=514​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \operatorname{Var}(T)=\frac{54}{5}-\frac{256}{25}=\boxed{\frac{14}{25}},\quad\operatorname{SD}(T)=\frac{\sqrt{14}}5
!

等待时间取值范围有限，均值与方差都应落在与该范围相容的尺度内。

The waiting time is bounded, so computed moments should be compatible with its support.

7.4

袜子问题的变体与指示变量

Sock variations and indicators

若同一颜色有超过两只袜子，首次颜色匹配与首次抽到某个原配对不再相同。另一个问题是抽 k 只后已有多少完整原配对。对每一双设置“是否全部抽中”的指示变量，即使这些指示变量相互依赖，期望仍可直接相加。

If a color appears more than twice, the first color match is no longer the same as completing an original labeled pair. Another question asks how many complete original pairs appear among k drawn socks. Assign an indicator to each pair. These indicators need not be independent for their expectations to add.

E[complete original pairs]=(k2)2n−1E[\text{complete original pairs}]=\frac{\binom k2}{2n-1}E[complete original pairs]=2n−1(2k​)​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
E[\text{complete original pairs}]=\frac{\binom k2}{2n-1}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 对每双原配袜子设指示 Iᵢ。两只都在 k 只样本中的概率，可用先固定这一双，再从其余 2n−2 只中选 k−2 只来计算。

    Let Iᵢ indicate whether original pair i is included. Fix its two socks, then choose k−2 from the remaining 2n−2.

    E[Ii]=P(Ii=1)=(2n−2k−2)(2nk)=k(k−1)2n(2n−1)E[I_i]=P(I_i=1)=\frac{\binom{2n-2}{k-2}}{\binom{2n}k}=\frac{k(k-1)}{2n(2n-1)}E[Ii​]=P(Ii​=1)=(k2n​)(k−22n−2​)​=2n(2n−1)k(k−1)​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[I_i]=P(I_i=1)=\frac{\binom{2n-2}{k-2}}{\binom{2n}k}=\frac{k(k-1)}{2n(2n-1)}

  2. 总配对数是 n 个指示之和，期望相加不要求指示独立。乘 n 后化简即得结果。

    The total is a sum of n indicators; linearity of expectation needs no independence. Multiply by n and simplify.

    E ⁣[∑i=1nIi]=nE[Ii]=k(k−1)2(2n−1)E\!\left[\sum_{i=1}^nI_i\right]=nE[I_i]=\frac{k(k-1)}{2(2n-1)}E[i=1∑n​Ii​]=nE[Ii​]=2(2n−1)k(k−1)​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E\!\left[\sum_{i=1}^nI_i\right]=nE[I_i]=\frac{k(k-1)}{2(2n-1)}

7 双袜子抽 5 只，完整原配对的期望数量是 C(5,2)/13=10/13。这不是“至少一双”的概率。

Drawing five socks from seven pairs gives an expected 10/13 complete pairs. This is not the probability of at least one pair.

  1. 7 双袜子共 14 只，随机不放回抽 5 只。对于某一双，样本同时包含它的概率如下。

    There are fourteen socks in seven pairs; draw five without replacement. The inclusion probability of a specified pair is:

    P(Ii=1)=5⋅414⋅13=1091P(I_i=1)=\frac{5\cdot4}{14\cdot13}=\frac{10}{91}P(Ii​=1)=14⋅135⋅4​=9110​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(I_i=1)=\frac{5\cdot4}{14\cdot13}=\frac{10}{91}

  2. 共有 7 双原配，所以平均完整配对数为 7×10/91。

    There are seven original pairs, so multiply this probability by seven.

    E[pairs]=71091=1013E[\text{pairs}]=7\frac{10}{91}=\boxed{\frac{10}{13}}E[pairs]=79110​=1310​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[\text{pairs}]=7\frac{10}{91}=\boxed{\frac{10}{13}}

  3. 至少一双的概率需另算。前 5 只全部来自不同颜色的概率为 2⁵C(7,5)/C(14,5)，取补即可；它不等于期望。

    At least one pair needs a separate calculation. Complement the probability of five distinct colors; it is not the expected count.

    P(at least one pair)=1−25(75)(145)=1−6722002=6651001P(\text{at least one pair})=1-\frac{2^5\binom75}{\binom{14}5}=1-\frac{672}{2002}=\frac{665}{1001}P(at least one pair)=1−(514​)25(57​)​=1−2002672​=1001665​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(\text{at least one pair})=1-\frac{2^5\binom75}{\binom{14}5}=1-\frac{672}{2002}=\frac{665}{1001}
!

期望次数与至少一次发生的概率不同，只有 0–1 变量二者才相等。

Expected counts and probabilities of at least one occurrence coincide only for a zero–one count.

7.5

优惠券收集问题

The coupon collector problem

每次独立得到 n 类之一，目标是集齐全部类型。等概率时，已有 k 类后，再获得一种新类型的概率是 (n−k)/n，因此每个阶段等待时间是几何变量。各阶段期望相加得到 nHₙ。非均匀概率下，稀有类型常主导等待时间，可用容斥计算尾概率或期望。

Each independent draw produces one of n types, and collection ends when every type has appeared. With equal probabilities, after k types the chance of a new type is (n−k)/n, so each stage is geometric. Summing stage means gives nHₙ. With unequal type probabilities, rare types often dominate; inclusion–exclusion gives survival probabilities and expectations.

E[T]=nHn,Var⁡(T)=n2∑j=1n1j2−nHnE[T]=nH_n,\quad\operatorname{Var}(T)=n^2\sum_{j=1}^n\frac1{j^2}-nH_nE[T]=nHn​,Var(T)=n2j=1∑n​j21​−nHn​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
E[T]=nH_n,\quad\operatorname{Var}(T)=n^2\sum_{j=1}^n\frac1{j^2}-nH_n

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 已有 k 种类型后，新类型概率为 (n−k)/n。每阶段在首次新类型处结束，等待是几何变量；独立抽取使阶段等待相互独立。

    After k distinct types, a new type has probability (n−k)/n. Each stage ends at its first new type; independence of draws makes these stage waits independent.

    Wk∼Geom⁡ ⁣(n−kn),T=∑k=0n−1WkW_k\sim\operatorname{Geom}\!\left(\frac{n-k}{n}\right),\quad T=\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}W_kWk​∼Geom(nn−k​),T=k=0∑n−1​Wk​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    W_k\sim\operatorname{Geom}\!\left(\frac{n-k}{n}\right),\quad T=\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}W_k

  2. 相加各阶段均值；对方差代入几何方差并整理。最后一种类型阶段的均值为 n。

    Add stage means; for variance insert the geometric variance and simplify. The last stage alone has mean n.

    E[T]=∑k=0n−1nn−k=nHn,Var⁡(T)=∑j=1n1−j/n(j/n)2E[T]=\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}\frac n{n-k}=nH_n,\quad\operatorname{Var}(T)=\sum_{j=1}^n\frac{1-j/n}{(j/n)^2}E[T]=k=0∑n−1​n−kn​=nHn​,Var(T)=j=1∑n​(j/n)21−j/n​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    E[T]=\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}\frac n{n-k}=nH_n,\quad\operatorname{Var}(T)=\sum_{j=1}^n\frac{1-j/n}{(j/n)^2}
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

集齐六面公平骰子的全部点数，平均需要 6(1+1/2+…+1/6)=14.7 次。集齐前三种很快，最后一种平均单独还要 6 次。

Collecting all six faces of a fair die takes 14.7 rolls on average. Once only one type remains, that final stage alone averages six rolls.

两枚骰子的“和”有不同概率，不能当作 11 种等概率优惠券。

The sums of two dice have unequal probabilities and are not eleven equally likely coupons.

7.6

把探索变成验证

Turning exploration into verification

计算实验适合发现规律，但发现规律与证明规律是两步。对等待时间，先检查分布是否归一化，再比较递推、尾和和模拟三种独立途径。截断无限级数时，未累计的尾部概率会影响期望，不能仅因为前几项概率很小就断言结果精确。

Computation helps discover patterns, but discovery and proof are separate steps. For waiting times, check normalization and compare recurrence, survival sums, and simulation. Truncating an infinite series leaves a tail that can materially affect a mean even when individual terms are small. Report numerical approximations at a precision supported by the remaining error.

E[T]=∑k=0∞P(T>k),remainderK=∑k=K+1∞P(T>k)E[T]=\sum_{k=0}^\infty P(T>k),\quad\mathrm{remainder}_K=\sum_{k=K+1}^\infty P(T>k)E[T]=k=0∑∞​P(T>k),remainderK​=k=K+1∑∞​P(T>k)
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
E[T]=\sum_{k=0}^\infty P(T>k),\quad\mathrm{remainder}_K=\sum_{k=K+1}^\infty P(T>k)

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 截断尾和只能得到期望的下界。要说明精度，必须约束剩余尾部，而不能只展示前几项很小。

    A truncated survival sum is only a lower bound on the mean. Accuracy needs a bound on the entire omitted tail, not merely a few small terms.

    E[T]=∑k=0KP(T>k)+remainderKE[T]=\sum_{k=0}^K P(T>k)+\mathrm{remainder}_KE[T]=k=0∑K​P(T>k)+remainderK​

    For uniform coupons, T>k means at least one type is missing. The union bound gives n(1−1/n)ᵏ; sum its geometric tail.

Numerical agreement supports a result but does not replace assumptions, boundary conditions, or proof.

7.7

删一回归与刀切法

Leave-one-out regression and the jackknife

依次删去一个观察并重新拟合，可以看出哪些点对斜率、截距或其他统计量具有强影响。把删一统计量作为一组系统变化，还可构造刀切法的方差和偏差估计。这个方法评估样本内稳定性，不能只因删掉一个点后拟合更好就自动认定该点错误。

Refit after deleting each observation to see which points strongly affect slopes, intercepts, or other statistics. The collection of leave-one-out estimates also supplies jackknife variance and bias estimates. This diagnoses within-sample sensitivity; an improved fit after deletion does not automatically mean the observation is erroneous.

Var⁡^jack(θ^)=n−1n∑i=1n(θ^(i)−θ‾(⋅))2\widehat{\operatorname{Var}}_{\rm jack}(\widehat\theta)=\frac{n-1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n(\widehat\theta_{(i)}-\overline\theta_{(\cdot)})^2Varjack​(θ)=nn−1​i=1∑n​(θ(i)​−θ(⋅)​)2
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
\widehat{\operatorname{Var}}_{\rm jack}(\widehat\theta)=\frac{n-1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n(\widehat\theta_{(i)}-\overline\theta_{(\cdot)})^2

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 删一统计量彼此高度相关，因此不能把它们视为 n 个独立估计直接用通常样本方差。刀切法使用 (n−1)/n 的特定缩放。

    Leave-one-out statistics are highly dependent, so their ordinary sample variance is not the variance of n independent estimates. The jackknife uses a specific (n−1)/n scaling.

    θ‾(⋅)=1n∑iθ^(i)\overline\theta_{(\cdot)}=\frac1n\sum_i\widehat\theta_{(i)}θ(⋅)​=n1​i∑​θ(i)​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

  2. 用样本均值检查这个缩放：删一均值与全均值的差为 (x̄−xᵢ)/(n−1)。代入后恰好得到 s²/n。

    Check the scaling for a sample mean: its leave-one-out deviation is (x̄−xᵢ)/(n−1). Substitution recovers s²/n.

    Var⁡^jack(X‾)=n−1n∑i(xi−x‾)2(n−1)2=s2n\widehat{\operatorname{Var}}_{\rm jack}(\overline X)=\frac{n-1}{n}\sum_i\frac{(x_i-\overline x)^2}{(n-1)^2}=\frac{s^2}{n}Varjack​(X)=nn−1​i∑​(n−1)2(xi​−x)2​=ns2​
