Influential observations, outliers, and data-entry errors are distinct concepts requiring context.

7.8

杠杆值与库克距离

Leverage and Cook’s distance

杠杆值描述某个 x 在设计空间中有多特别，残差描述 y 偏离拟合线多少。库克距离把两者结合，衡量删去该点会怎样改变整体拟合。一般线性回归中，p 表示包含截距的系数个数，MSE 采用完整模型残差均方。阈值只是筛查启发，不能当作自动删除指令。

Leverage describes how unusual an x position is in the design, while a residual measures disagreement in y. Cook’s distance combines them to measure influence on the overall fit. In the usual linear-model formula, p is the number of coefficients including the intercept, and MSE is the full-model residual mean square. Screening thresholds are heuristics, not automatic deletion rules.

hii=1n+(xi−x‾)2Sxx,Di=ei2p MSEhii(1−hii)2h_{ii}=\frac1n+\frac{(x_i-\overline x)^2}{S_{xx}},\quad D_i=\frac{e_i^2}{p\,\mathrm{MSE}}\frac{h_{ii}}{(1-h_{ii})^2}hii​=n1​+Sxx​(xi​−x)2​,Di​=pMSEei2​​(1−hii​)2hii​​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
h_{ii}=\frac1n+\frac{(x_i-\overline x)^2}{S_{xx}},\quad D_i=\frac{e_i^2}{p\,\mathrm{MSE}}\frac{h_{ii}}{(1-h_{ii})^2}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 写拟合值为 Hy，H 是投影到设计矩阵列空间的帽子矩阵。对角 hᵢᵢ 衡量第 i 个响应对自身拟合值的权重，迹为模型参数个数 p。

    Write fitted values as Hy. The hat matrix projects onto the design space; its diagonal measures self-weight and its trace is the coefficient count p.

    H=X(X⊤X)−1X⊤,∑ihii=tr⁡(H)=pH=X(X^\top X)^{-1}X^\top,\quad\sum_ih_{ii}=\operatorname{tr}(H)=pH=X(X⊤X)−1X⊤,i∑​hii​=tr(H)=p
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    H=X(X^\top X)^{-1}X^\top,\quad\sum_ih_{ii}=\operatorname{tr}(H)=p

  2. 删一拟合的变化与 eᵢ/(1−hᵢᵢ) 成比例。以完整模型 MSE 标准化总体拟合变化，可化成库克距离公式。

    The deletion-induced fit change is proportional to eᵢ/(1−hᵢᵢ). Standardizing total fitted-value change by the full-model MSE yields Cook’s formula.

    Di=∑j(y^j−y^j(i))2p MSED_i=\frac{\sum_j(\widehat y_j-\widehat y_{j(i)})^2}{p\,\mathrm{MSE}}Di​=pMSE∑j​(y​j​−y​j(i)​)2​

7.9

自助法

The bootstrap

自助法把经验分布当作未知总体的近似，从原样本有放回抽取同样大小的新样本，反复计算统计量。统计量的重复变化用于估计标准误、偏差或区间。普通非参数自助法依赖原观察可视为独立同分布；时间序列、聚类或回归数据常需要专门的重抽样结构。

The nonparametric bootstrap treats the empirical distribution as an approximation to the population. Repeatedly sample n observations with replacement from the original n values and recompute a statistic. Variation across replicates estimates standard error, bias, or intervals. Ordinary resampling assumes iid observations; time series, clusters, and regression settings may require specialized schemes.

SEboot=1B−1∑b=1B(θ^b∗−θ‾∗)2\mathrm{SE}_{\rm boot}=\sqrt{\frac1{B-1}\sum_{b=1}^B(\widehat\theta_b^*-\overline\theta^*)^2}SEboot​=B−11​b=1∑B​(θb∗​−θ∗)2​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
\mathrm{SE}_{\rm boot}=\sqrt{\frac1{B-1}\sum_{b=1}^B(\widehat\theta_b^*-\overline\theta^*)^2}

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 经验分布对 n 个原观察分别赋质量 1/n。有放回独立重抽，等价于从这个经验总体抽 iid 样本。

    The empirical distribution puts mass 1/n on each observation. Independent replacement sampling is iid sampling from that empirical population.

    F^n=1n∑i=1nδxi\widehat F_n=\frac1n\sum_{i=1}^n\delta_{x_i}Fn​=n1​i=1∑n​δxi​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \widehat F_n=\frac1n\sum_{i=1}^n\delta_{x_i}

  2. 重复估计量的标准差近似原统计量的抽样标准误。对均值可精确求条件自助方差：经验总体方差除以 n。

    The SD of replicate estimates approximates the original statistic’s sampling SE. For a mean, its conditional bootstrap variance is exactly the empirical population variance divided by n.

    Var⁡∗(X‾∗)=1n[1n∑i(xi−x‾)2]\operatorname{Var}_*(\overline X^*)=\frac1n\left[\frac1n\sum_i(x_i-\overline x)^2\right]Var∗​(X∗)=n1​[n1​i∑​(xi​−x)2]
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    \operatorname{Var}_*(\overline X^*)=\frac1n\left[\frac1n\sum_i(x_i-\overline x)^2\right]

要估计样本中位数的误差，可重复生成 2000 份有放回样本，计算每份的中位数，再看这些中位数的离散程度。

To estimate a median’s uncertainty, generate two thousand replacement samples, compute each median, and summarize their spread.

More bootstrap replicates reduce simulation noise but cannot repair a seriously unrepresentative original sample.

7.10

沃尔德格雷夫问题：三人比赛

Waldegrave’s problem: three players

三人 A、B、C 按既定轮转规则比赛，单局双方胜率均为 1/2。有人连续击败另外两人就结束。第一局确定当前胜者，从第二局开始，只要当前胜者再赢就结束；否则新的胜者接续挑战。这使比赛长度等于一次初始比赛加一个成功率 1/2 的几何等待时间。

Three players follow a fixed rotation, with each individual game fair. The series ends when one player defeats both opponents consecutively. The first game establishes an incumbent. Each subsequent game ends the series if that incumbent wins again; otherwise a new incumbent takes over. Thus length is one initial game plus a geometric waiting time with success probability one half.

P(N=n)=2−(n−1), n≥2,E[N]=3,Var⁡(N)=2P(N=n)=2^{-(n-1)},\ n\ge2,\quad E[N]=3,\quad\operatorname{Var}(N)=2P(N=n)=2−(n−1), n≥2,E[N]=3,Var(N)=2
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
P(N=n)=2^{-(n-1)},\ n\ge2,\quad E[N]=3,\quad\operatorname{Var}(N)=2

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

The series ends after two, three, and four games with probabilities 1/2, 1/4, and 1/8 respectively.

7.11

三人的最终胜率

Winning probabilities for three players

初始先比赛的 A 与 B 对称，第三人 C 较晚入场。枚举导致各人获胜的有限序列，并把可重复的失败循环用几何级数合并，得到不同的最终胜率。也可以把当前胜者、下一位挑战者和连胜长度当作状态，建立吸收概率方程。

The two initial players A and B are symmetric, while C enters later. Enumerating winning paths and summing repeatable nonterminal cycles gives unequal final winning probabilities. Alternatively, encode the incumbent, next challenger, and consecutive wins as a state and solve absorption-probability equations.

7.12

更多玩家与广义斐波那契结构

More players and generalized Fibonacci structure

r+1 名玩家时，冠军需要连续赢 r 局。第一局之后当前冠军已有一场胜利，随后要积累或重置连胜计数。只研究结束时间时可记录当前连胜长度；要算每个人的胜率则还须记录身份与轮转位置。四人模型中终止序列计数呈 2、2、4、6、10 等斐波那契型递推。

With r+1 players, the champion needs r consecutive wins. The first game starts a winning run; subsequent games either extend it or install a new incumbent with run length one. A run-length state suffices for duration, while player-specific winning probabilities also need identities and rotation. For four players, terminal-path counts follow a Fibonacci-type sequence 2,2,4,6,10,… .

E[N]=2r−1for r+1 players needing r consecutive winsE[N]=2^r-1\quad\text{for }r+1\text{ players needing }r\text{ consecutive wins}E[N]=2r−1for r+1 players needing r consecutive wins

7.13

从有限状态到可计算答案

From finite states to computable answers

挑战问题不必总追求简短闭式。先构造正确的有限状态模型，再用线性方程求吸收概率和期望，往往更可靠。若 Q 是暂态子矩阵，基本矩阵 F=(I−Q)⁻¹ 给出每个暂态的预期访问次数；把每行相加得到吸收前平均步数。模拟可作为检查。

A short closed form is not always the most useful goal. A correct finite-state model followed by linear algebra often provides a reliable answer. For transient matrix Q, the fundamental matrix F=(I−Q)⁻¹ gives expected visits to transient states. Its row sums give mean time to absorption. Simulation supplies an independent check.

F=(I−Q)−1=I+Q+Q2+⋯ ,t=F1,B=FRF=(I-Q)^{-1}=I+Q+Q^2+\cdots,\quad t=F\mathbf1,\quad B=FRF=(I−Q)−1=I+Q+Q2+⋯,t=F1,B=FR

F=(I-Q)^{-1}=I+Q+Q^2+\cdots,\quad t=F\mathbf1,\quad B=FR

  1. 把吸收链暂态排在前面，转移矩阵分块为 Q、R 与吸收单位块。Qⁿ 的行和是在 n 步后仍暂态的概率。

    Order transient states first, giving blocks Q and R and an absorbing identity block. Row sums of Qⁿ are probabilities of remaining transient at step n.

    P=(QR0I)P=\begin{pmatrix}Q&R\\0&I\end{pmatrix}P=(Q0​RI​)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P=\begin{pmatrix}Q&R\\0&I\end{pmatrix}

  2. 若最终必吸收，有限状态下 Qⁿ 趋零，矩阵几何级数收敛。对每个时刻的暂态占用概率求和，得到预期访问次数矩阵。

    With almost-sure absorption in a finite chain, Qⁿ tends to zero and the matrix geometric series converges. Summing occupancy probabilities gives expected visit counts.

    (I−Q)(I+Q+⋯+Qm)=I−Qm+1→I(I-Q)(I+Q+\cdots+Q^m)=I-Q^{m+1}\to I(I−Q)(I+Q+⋯+Qm)=I−Qm+1→I
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

7.14

惠更斯问题与出场次序

Huygens’ problem and turn order

A 每次掷两枚骰子争取点数和 6，B 争取点数和 7，谁先达到目标谁赢。单次成功概率分别为 5/36 与 1/6，但最终胜率还依赖出场次序。对周期 ABBA，先算一个周期内 A 获胜的概率，再把整个周期全部失败后重新开始的概率作为等比公比。

Player A seeks a sum of six with two dice, and B seeks seven; the first success wins. Their per-turn success probabilities are 5/36 and 1/6, but the final outcome also depends on the schedule. For a repeating ABBA cycle, compute A’s success probability within one cycle and divide by one minus the probability that the entire cycle fails.

PAABBA=pA+qAqB2pA1−qA2qB2,qA=1−pA, qB=1−pBP_A^{ABBA}=\frac{p_A+q_Aq_B^2p_A}{1-q_A^2q_B^2},\quad q_A=1-p_A,\ q_B=1-p_BPAABBA​=1−qA2​qB2​pA​+qA​qB2​pA​​,qA​=1−pA​, qB​=1−pB​
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
P_A^{ABBA}=\frac{p_A+q_Aq_B^2p_A}{1-q_A^2q_B^2},\quad q_A=1-p_A,\ q_B=1-p_B

  1. 把 ABBA 看作四轮周期。A 可在第一轮直接成功，或在 A、B、B 都失败后于第四轮成功，两条事件互斥。

    Treat ABBA as a four-turn cycle. A succeeds either immediately or on turn four after A,B,B all fail; these paths are disjoint.

    a=pA+qAqB2pAa=p_A+q_Aq_B^2p_Aa=pA​+qA​qB2​pA​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source

    A whole failed cycle has probability q=q_A²q_B². Restarting after failure gives u=a+qu.

    u_{ABAB}=\frac{5/36}{1-(31/36)(5/6)}=\boxed{\frac{30}{61}\approx0.491803}
!

“轮流”必须写成确切序列；ABAB 与 ABBA 会给出不同答案。

Write the precise turn sequence; ABAB and ABBA give different answers.

7.15

改变目标与非周期出场

Changing targets and nonperiodic schedules

两骰点数和 s 的成功概率由 6−|7−s| 个有序结果给出。改变任一玩家目标时，将新的单次概率代入相同的出场模型。对于非周期的长短块序列，可以逐次累积“仍未结束”的概率；每轮 A 的获胜贡献等于之前全失败概率乘以该轮成功率，数值截断误差由剩余未结束概率控制。

A two-dice sum s has 6−|7−s| ordered outcomes. Substitute new per-turn success probabilities when targets change, while retaining the scheduling model. For nonperiodic blocks, accumulate the probability of still being in play before each turn. A’s contribution is that survival probability times A’s current success chance, and the remaining survival bounds truncation error.

P(A wins)=∑t: at=ApA∏j<t(1−paj)P(A\text{ wins})=\sum_{t:\,a_t=A}p_A\prod_{j<t}(1-p_{a_j})P(A wins)=t:at​=A∑​pA​j<t∏​(1−paj​​)
LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
P(A\text{ wins})=\sum_{t:\,a_t=A}p_A\prod_{j<t}(1-p_{a_j})

公式推导与成立条件Derivation and assumptions

  1. 对任意给定出场序列，A 在第 t 轮首次成功，需要之前所有轮都失败。不同终止轮次互斥，因此可直接求和。

    For a fixed schedule, A first succeeds on turn t only if every earlier turn fails. Different terminal turns are disjoint, so add their probabilities.

    P(A wins at t)=pA∏j<tqaj(at=A)P(\text{A wins at }t)=p_A\prod_{j<t}q_{a_j}\quad(a_t=A)P(A wins at t)=pA​j<t∏​qaj​​(at​=A)
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(\text{A wins at }t)=p_A\prod_{j<t}q_{a_j}\quad(a_t=A)

  2. 有限截断后的未结束概率是此前全部失败的乘积，它同时界定了尚未计入的 A 获胜概率，因而提供可计算误差界。

    The probability of no success by a finite cutoff is the product of all prior failure probabilities. It bounds the omitted A-winning contribution.

    0≤P(A wins)−∑t≤K: at=ApA∏j<tqaj≤∏j=1Kqaj0\le P(A\text{ wins})-\sum_{t\le K:\,a_t=A}p_A\prod_{j<t}q_{a_j}\le\prod_{j=1}^Kq_{a_j}0≤P(A wins)−t≤K:at​=A∑​pA​j<t∏​qaj​​≤j=1∏K​qaj​​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    0\le P(A\text{ wins})-\sum_{t\le K:\,a_t=A}p_A\prod_{j<t}q_{a_j}\le\prod_{j=1}^Kq_{a_j}
例题与完整解法 / FULLY WORKED EXAMPLE

ABAB 次序、双方单次成功率都为 p 时，A 的胜率为 p/[1−(1−p)²]=1/(2−p)。p=1/2 时是 2/3，不是 1/2。

Under ABAB with equal success probability p, A wins with probability 1/(2−p). At p=1/2 this is 2/3, reflecting first-move advantage.

  1. ABAB 轮流且双方成功率相同 p。A 可以在首轮、第三轮、第五轮等获胜，每次多两个失败。

    Under ABAB with equal per-turn probability p, A can win on turns one, three, five, and so on, each pair of extra turns adding two failures.

    P(A)=p+q2p+q4p+⋯ ,q=1−pP(A)=p+q^2p+q^4p+\cdots,\quad q=1-pP(A)=p+q2p+q4p+⋯,q=1−p
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(A)=p+q^2p+q^4p+\cdots,\quad q=1-p

  2. 求等比和，分母 1−q²=(1−q)(1+q)=p(2−p)。约去 p，条件为 p>0。

    Sum the geometric series and factor 1−q²=p(2−p). Cancel p, assuming p>0.

    P(A)=p1−q2=12−pP(A)=\frac p{1-q^2}=\frac1{2-p}P(A)=1−q2p​=2−p1​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    P(A)=\frac p{1-q^2}=\frac1{2-p}

  3. 若 p=0.2，概率为 1/1.8=5/9；p=0.5 时为 2/3。先手可以在对手尚未获得机会时结束比赛。

    At p=0.2 the chance is 5/9, and at p=0.5 it is 2/3. The first player can finish before the opponent gets a turn.

    p=0.2⇒P(A)=59≈0.555556,p=0.5⇒P(A)=23p=0.2\Rightarrow P(A)=\boxed{\frac59\approx0.555556},\qquad p=0.5\Rightarrow P(A)=\frac23p=0.2⇒P(A)=95​≈0.555556​,p=0.5⇒P(A)=32​
    LaTeX 源码 / LaTeX source
    p=0.2\Rightarrow P(A)=\boxed{\frac59\approx0.555556},\qquad p=0.5\Rightarrow P(A)=\frac23
!

单次成功率相同也不保证整场公平；机会次序与停止规则都是模型的一部分。

Equal per-turn success rates do not guarantee a fair series; scheduling and stopping are part of the model.

Bar heights are point probabilities and sum to one.

比较 P(B) 与 P(B | 次品)。
Compare the prior with the posterior given a defect.

CHECK YOUR UNDERSTANDING

每章两个小问题 Two questions per chapter

先自己作答，再展开解答。题目是本学习版新编，用于检查核心方法。

Try each question before revealing the solution. These original practice questions check the core methods in this study edition.

CH 1 · PRACTICE 01

条件信息 / Conditioning

两次公平抛币。已知至少一次正面，两次都是正面的概率是多少？

Toss a fair coin twice. Given at least one head, what is the probability of two heads?

查看推导 / Reveal solution

条件样本空间为 HH、HT、TH，三者等可能，答案 1/3。

The conditional outcomes HH, HT, TH are equally likely, giving 1/3.

CH 1 · PRACTICE 02

系统可靠性 / Reliability

两个独立部件可靠性均为 0.8，求串联与并联系统可靠性。

Two independent components each have reliability 0.8. Find series and parallel reliability.

查看推导 / Reveal solution

串联 0.8²=0.64；并联 1−0.2²=0.96。

Series: 0.64. Parallel: 0.96.

CH 2 · PRACTICE 03

等待时间 / Waiting

每次独立成功率为 0.2，等到第二次成功的平均次数和方差是多少？

Independent trials succeed with probability 0.2. Find the mean and variance of trials to the second success.

查看推导 / Reveal solution

采用包含成功次数的负二项约定，均值 2/0.2=10，方差 2×0.8/0.2²=40。

Using the total-trials convention, mean=10 and variance=40.

CH 2 · PRACTICE 04

有限抽样 / Finite sampling

10 件产品中有 2 件次品，抽 3 件不放回，全部合格的概率是多少？

Ten items contain two defects. Sample three without replacement. Find the chance all are good.

查看推导 / Reveal solution

C(8,3)/C(10,3)=56/120=7/15。

C(8,3)/C(10,3)=7/15.

CH 3 · PRACTICE 05

指数寿命 / Exponential lifetime

平均寿命 10 小时，采用指数模型，活到 20 小时的概率是多少？

For an exponential lifetime with mean ten hours, find survival at twenty hours.

查看推导 / Reveal solution

速率 λ=0.1/小时，R(20)=e⁻²≈0.1353。

The rate is 0.1 per hour, so survival is e⁻²≈0.1353.

CH 3 · PRACTICE 06

密度归一化 / Normalization

f(x)=cx²，0<x<1，求 c 与 E[X]。

For density f(x)=cx² on (0,1), find c and E[X].

查看推导 / Reveal solution

积分为 1 要求 c/3=1，因此 c=3；E[X]=∫₀¹3x³dx=3/4。

Normalization gives c=3; the mean is ∫₀¹3x³dx=3/4.

CH 4 · PRACTICE 07

均值与误差 / Mean and error

独立观察的标准差为 12，平均 36 次观察的标准误是多少？

Independent observations have standard deviation twelve. What is the standard error of their mean for n=36?

查看推导 / Reveal solution

12/√36=2。这里不需要正态性即可计算方差，但精确分布还取决于总体。

The standard error is 12/√36=2. This variance calculation does not require normality.

CH 4 · PRACTICE 08

变量变换 / Transformation

X∼U(0,1)，Y=2X+3，写出 Y 的分布及均值。

If X is uniform on (0,1) and Y=2X+3, give the law and mean of Y.

查看推导 / Reveal solution

Y∼U(3,5)，均值为 4，密度为 1/2。

Y is uniform on (3,5), with mean four and density one half.

CH 5 · PRACTICE 09

条件期望 / Conditional expectation

联合密度为 2，支持 0<x<y<1。求 E[X|Y=y] 和 E[X]。

The joint density is two on 0<x<y<1. Find E[X|Y=y] and E[X].

查看推导 / Reveal solution

X|Y=y 为 U(0,y)，条件均值 y/2；f_Y(y)=2y，故 E[X]=∫₀¹(y/2)2y dy=1/3。

The conditional mean is y/2. Integrating against f_Y(y)=2y gives E[X]=1/3.

CH 5 · PRACTICE 10

相关与方差 / Correlation and variance

Var(X)=4，Var(Y)=9，Cov(X,Y)=−1，求 Var(X+Y)。

Given variances four and nine and covariance −1, find Var(X+Y).

查看推导 / Reveal solution

4+9+2(−1)=11。

4+9+2(−1)=11.

CH 6 · PRACTICE 11

公平随机游走 / Fair random walk

从资本 4 开始，在 0 与 12 停止，求先到 12 的概率及平均步数。

A fair walk starts at four and stops at zero or twelve. Find the chance of reaching twelve and expected duration.

查看推导 / Reveal solution

概率 4/12=1/3；平均步数 4(12−4)=32。

Success probability=1/3; expected duration=32 steps.

CH 6 · PRACTICE 12

平稳分布 / Stationarity

P 的两行为 (0.9,0.1)、(0.2,0.8)，求平稳分布。

A transition matrix has rows (0.9,0.1), (0.2,0.8). Find its stationary distribution.

查看推导 / Reveal solution

由 0.1π₁=0.2π₂ 和 π₁+π₂=1，得到 (2/3,1/3)。

Balance 0.1π₁=0.2π₂ and normalize, obtaining (2/3,1/3).

CH 7 · PRACTICE 13

收集全部类型 / Collecting types

每次等概率得到 4 类之一，集齐全部类型平均需要多少次？

Each draw gives one of four equally likely types. Find the mean number of draws to collect all four.

查看推导 / Reveal solution

4(1+1/2+1/3+1/4)=25/3≈8.3333。

4H₄=25/3≈8.3333.

CH 7 · PRACTICE 14

先手优势 / First-move advantage

ABAB 出场，两人每次成功率均为 0.2，求 A 最终获胜的概率。

Under ABAB, both players succeed on each turn with probability 0.2. Find A’s ultimate winning probability.

查看推导 / Reveal solution

0.2/[1−0.8²]=5/9≈0.5556。

0.2/[1−0.8²]=5/9≈0.5556.

APPENDIX A

计算工具：把模型写进代码 Computing with the model

原书附录介绍 Mathematica。下面保留相同的计算思路，给出独立编写的命令示例：建立分布、求概率与矩、模拟数据、解平稳方程。运行前先确认参数和单位。

The source book’s computing appendix uses Mathematica. These independently written examples retain the same workflow: specify a distribution, calculate probabilities and moments, simulate observations, and solve stationary equations. Verify parameter meanings and units first.

(* Wolfram Language / Mathematica *)
d = BinomialDistribution[20, 0.3];
PDF[d, 6]                 (* P(X = 6) *)
CDF[d, 6]                 (* P(X ≤ 6) *)
Mean[d]; Variance[d];

(* ExponentialDistribution uses a rate parameter *)
SurvivalFunction[ExponentialDistribution[0.2], 5]

(* Reproducible simulation *)
SeedRandom[2026];
sample = RandomVariate[NormalDistribution[0, 1], 1000];
Mean[sample]; Histogram[sample, Automatic, "PDF"]

(* A stationary row distribution *)
Solve[{a == 0.8 a + 0.3 b, a + b == 1}, {a, b}]

独立验证：概率应在 [0,1]，质量函数求和应为 1，密度积分应为 1，方差不能为负。模拟均值随重复次数波动，用标准误评估误差。

Validate independently: probabilities lie in [0,1], masses sum to one, densities integrate to one, and variance is nonnegative. Simulation averages fluctuate; assess uncertainty with a standard error.

APPENDIX B

标准正态速查 Standard normal reference

Φ(z)=P(Z≤z)，右尾为 1−Φ(z)。负值用 Φ(−z)=1−Φ(z)。以下按 0.1 递增；常用分位数：1.645（单侧 95%）、1.960（双侧 95%）、2.576（双侧 99%）。

Φ(z) is the left-tail probability, and 1−Φ(z) the right tail. For negative values use symmetry. The table increments by 0.1. Common critical values are 1.645 for a one-sided 95% bound, 1.960 for a two-sided 95% interval, and 2.576 for 99%.
